Our advanced manufacturing process allows us to produce high-quality precast concrete panels with precision, speed, and consistency. Visit our website to learn more about our precast concrete solutions and manufacturing capabilities.

businesses.name: Acute Laser – Brisbane
businesses.description:
Established in 1999, Acute Laser is a leading provider of precision metal processing solutions based in Carole Park, Queensland. As a fully Australian-owned and operated company, we specialize in high-quality laser cutting and metal fabrication, utilizing state-of-the-art TRUMPF technology to deliver superior results for complex industrial requirements.

Our comprehensive suite of services includes:

Flat Bed Laser Cutting: High-speed precision for mild steel (up to 25mm), stainless steel, aluminum, and yellow metals.

Tube Laser Cutting: Specialized processing for tubular sections and pipes.

CNC Metal Folding: Expert bending and forming of components up to 12mm thick.

Value-Added Services: Including edge rounding, deburring, drilling, and tapping to provide 'ready-to-assemble' parts.

We pride ourselves on our technical expertise and commitment to quality, supporting key Australian industries from mining and construction to medical and defense. With a focus on fast lead times and reliable local delivery across the Brisbane and Ipswich regions, Acute Laser is the trusted partner for precision manufacturing in Queensland.

businesses.name: A&J Australia
businesses.description:
A&J Australia started out in 1993 as a distributor of toiletries, cleaning products, plastic jerry can for water, and packaging to the hospitality and food industries. Since then, we’ve grown into one of the largest packaging manufacturers and packaging companies nationwide. Our team is comprised of some of the most experienced people in their chosen field, and we use state-of-the-art robotic machines to maintain a technological edge over our competitors. Our uncompromising commitment to quality, innovation and superior service makes us one of the best choices of plastic, paper and packaging suppliers.

We have no shortage of packaging materials available, including packaging tape, pallet cardboard, hand wrap, machine wrap and more. We can also provide you with tape dispensers and wrapping machines. In addition, we stock an impressive selection of plastic and paper products ranging from 60l plastic drum and bottles to cubes, drums, tissues and hand towels. As a trusted spray trigger supplier, we also cater to clients looking for efficient dispensing solutions. You can rely on us to recycle and reuse materials, helping to minimise harm to the environment and reduce costs, which are then passed on to our customers. We work side by side with our clients, building long-term relationships based on mutual trust and respect. Get in touch with the leading plastic manufacturers and plastic recyclers today to find out more.

businesses.name: Earmold Sydney
businesses.description:
Earmold Sydney provides custom made ear plugs designed for people who want reliable hearing protection, long-lasting comfort, and a secure personalised fit. As Australia’s leading custom ear plugs provider, we create high-quality custom earplugs suitable for different lifestyles and environments.

With more than a decade of industry experience, Earmold Sydney focuses on delivering professional fitting services and advanced noise protection technology that supports everyday comfort and hearing safety. Our earplugs are made using durable and long-lasting materials to ensure dependable performance for regular use.

We offer premium custom swimming ear plugs designed to help prevent water from entering the ears during swimming and water activities. These earplugs provide a comfortable fit and are suitable for regular swimmers looking for reliable ear protection.

For riders, our custom motorcycle ear plugs help reduce wind and road noise while improving comfort during long rides. Designed to fit securely under helmets, they support a safer and more comfortable riding experience.

Music lovers and event attendees can enjoy live performances more safely with our custom concert ear plugs. These earplugs lower harmful sound levels while maintaining sound clarity, helping protect hearing without affecting the listening experience.

Customers looking for better rest can benefit from our comfortable custom earplugs for sleeping. Designed for overnight use, they help reduce background noise and support peaceful uninterrupted sleep at home or while travelling.

Trusted by individuals and businesses across Australia, Earmold Sydney is committed to high standards of quality, safety, and personalised service. Our goal is to provide hearing protection solutions that improve comfort, support hearing health, and deliver long-term value for every customer.

Freedom Tech provides crypto-ready laptops and privacy-focused computers designed for users who value security, anonymity, and control.

Our systems come pre-installed with Linux operating systems, eliminating the need for Windows and reducing exposure to tracking, telemetry, and unnecessary software. Every device is configured for performance, privacy, and secure digital use.

We specialise in laptops and desktops built for cryptocurrency users, developers, and privacy-conscious individuals who want a clean, secure computing environment from day one.

What Makes Freedom Tech Different:

Linux-based systems (No Microsoft tracking)

Encrypted storage using Linux Unified Key Setup (LUKS)

Crypto wallet-ready environments

No bloatware or intrusive background processes

Optimised for privacy, speed, and reliability

Ideal For:

Crypto traders and investors

Privacy-focused users

Developers and tech professionals

Anyone seeking a secure alternative to traditional laptops

businesses.name: KAD3D
businesses.description:
Who We Are

KAD3D is a Melbourne-based 3D printing and design company specialising in rapid prototyping, end-use parts, and short-run manufacturing. Established with a focus on precision, reliability, and speed, we’ve grown to become Australia’s highest-rated 3D printing service, with over 300 five-star Google reviews and a reputation for delivering outstanding results.

Our Capabilities

We provide a full suite of modern fabrication and design services, including:

- FDM 3D Printing – strong, affordable parts for prototypes and end-use applications.

- SLA Resin Printing – high-resolution parts with smooth surface finish.

- SLS and MJF Nylon Printing – durable, functional components ideal for production runs.

- SLM Metal 3D Printing – stainless steel, aluminium, and titanium parts for industrial use.

- Vacuum Casting & Injection Moulding – small-batch manufacturing with production-grade finishes.

- CNC Machining & Laser Cutting – precision engineering for metals, plastics, and composites.

Our team also offers CAD design, 3D scanning, and reverse engineering, allowing clients to turn physical parts, sketches, or ideas into fully manufacturable 3D models.

Industries We Serve

Based in Reservoir, Victoria, we specialise in professional 3D printing services including FDM, SLA, SLS, MJF, and SLM (metal) manufacturing solutions for prototypes, end-use parts, and low-volume production.
Founded in 2013, KAD3D began with a simple goal: to bridge the gap between engineering precision and practical manufacturing. What started as a small garage setup has grown into one of Australia’s highest-rated 3D printing services, trusted by startups, engineers, architects, manufacturers, and enterprise clients across multiple industries.
We provide complete support from concept to production, including CAD design, reverse engineering, 3D scanning, rapid prototyping, and short-run manufacturing. Whether clients need a same-day prototype, functional engineering components, presentation models, or production-ready parts, our team focuses on delivering fast turnaround times, material expertise, and dependable results.
Our Melbourne facility allows us to offer fast local support, including 24-hour express FDM printing, detailed SLA resin printing, and engineering-grade nylon parts using SLS and MJF technologies. For specialised manufacturing requirements, we also support CNC machining, vacuum casting and injection moulding.
With over 400+ five-star Google reviews, KAD3D has built its reputation on quality, speed, and customer service. We work closely with clients to recommend the most cost-effective manufacturing method first—ensuring the right balance of price, performance, and lead time for every project.

businesses.description:
VeganicSKN is the leading Australian manufacturer of vegan and organic sunscreen formulations. We specialize in high-quality private label products, offering an extensive range that includes tinted mineral options and broad-spectrum zinc-based sunscreens. Certified vegan and organic by VegeCert and ISO 9001:2015 compliant, our products prioritize dermatological safety by excluding harmful allergens and chemicals, ensuring they are safe for all skin types. Our reef-safe and cruelty-free sunscreens provide effective protection against UVA/UVB/UVC rays.

Trusted by over 50 global brands, VeganicSKN is at the forefront of ethical skincare innovation with sustainable packaging and rapid lead times. Our products are made with eco-friendly materials and non-nano zinc oxide, offering 40 minutes of water resistance. Developed in TGA and FDA-compliant facilities in Australia, each batch undergoes rigorous SPF testing to ensure quality and effectiveness.

We offer flexible packaging options and low minimum order quantities, making us an ideal partner for brands seeking certified organic and vegan sun protection. Our services include custom label design and a variety of formulations to meet diverse market needs.

VeganicSKN's commitment to sustainability extends to our manufacturing processes, which minimize environmental impact. Our products are free from synthetic pesticides, herbicides, and petrochemicals, promoting skin health and environmental preservation. With a focus on innovation and quality, VeganicSKN has established itself as a trusted leader in the suncare industry, delivering superior products that meet the highest standards of safety and efficacy.

businesses.name: Perth Restoration Services
businesses.description:
Perth Restoration Services stands as a beacon of excellence in property and water restoration and emergency assistance in Perth, Western Australia. We specialize in high-quality loss mitigation and restoration work, helping the community recover from devastating setbacks caused by water, fire, mould, sewage, trauma, deceased estates, and other property damage conditions.

As a family-owned business, we offer professional services for both domestic and commercial investigations. With over 18 years of experience, expertise, and knowledge in the trade, we have built a reputation for excellence, reliability, and customer satisfaction both locally and beyond.

We are fully trained and certified by prestigious organizations such as The IICRC, Restoration Industry Association (RIA), Australian Cleaning Restoration Academy, Restoration Learning Institute, The Carpet Cleaning Association of WA, Nation Training, Woolsafe, 3M, and Prochem, to name a few. We continually update our skills and knowledge through new courses and training programs from reputable institutions and associations. Additionally, we use state-of-the-art technology and respond rapidly to your call.

Our experience, understanding, and compassion during the recovery process have made us the provider of choice for many throughout the Perth area. We pledge to do whatever it takes to respond, restore, and rescue properties in all the communities we serve.

Founded in 1991, China UK Valves Manufacturer Co., Ltd. (https://www.valves-uk.com/) is a leading specialist in producing high-quality forged steel valves. Our extensive product line includes Forged Steel Gate Valves, Globe Valves, Check Valves, Forged Steel Ball Valves, and Valve Actuators & Switches, each designed with distinctive features to meet the diverse needs of various industries.

With over three decades of experience, we have built a reputation for delivering reliable and competitively priced forged steel valves. Our products are widely used across numerous industrial sectors, including Chemical, Petrochemical, Oil & Natural Gas, Power Generation, Refineries, and Industrial Plants.

Operating on a 23,400-square-meter site with 22,000 square meters of advanced manufacturing space, we are equipped with fully integrated in-house production facilities. Our annual output capacity of 25,000 tons of forged steel valves allows us to provide superior quality products while maintaining competitive pricing, ensuring we meet the evolving demands of our global clients.

businesses.name: House Extensions Brisbane
businesses.description:
When your home is getting too small, and you don't want to move to another house you need a home extension. House Extensions Brisbane is your local home extensions builder helping Brisbane homeowners unlock the full potential of their property with a custom house extension tailored to perfectly suit your needs.

Whether it be an extra living area, an addition of several bedrooms or a simple upgrade and extension to expand your outdoor living space we have the know-how and experience to deliver your dream outcome on time and budget. We're experienced in all kinds of house extension projects across the suburbs of Brisbane including single story house extensions, second story house extensions, raise and build-under of Queenslander homes, granny flats, and expansions of outdoor entertainment areas.

We're a full-service builder which means we take care of the entire extension process for you from initial designs to engineering plans, council approvals, and all aspects of the construction phase. Rest easy knowing your home expansion plans will be carried out with ease and you'll have one point of contact throughout the project making it simpler and easier to communicate your concerns and ensure that the final outcome meets your expectations.

We're QBCC licensed and proud members of the master builders association of QLD so you can rest easy you're in safe hands. We offer a free initial consultation, which includes a free concept floor plan, project timeline estimates and project cost estimates.

Call today to book a free consultation and project estimate and experience the seamless, hassle-free experience and get started on creating your dream house extension.

businesses.name: Safe Direction Melbourne
businesses.description: Safe Direction® design, manufacture, supply and install innovative guardrails and safety barriers for roads, car parks, warehouses and pedestrians. Founded in Sydney in 2012 we are an Australian-owned manufacturer with a strong focus on research and a relentless pursuit of new product development – all Safe Direction® products are crash tested to ensure compliance with local and international standards. Our RAMSHIELD® guardrail barrier and range of RHINO-STOP® car park barriers are widely recognised as industry leaders in their markets. With in-house roll-forming manufacturing and engineering design expertise, Safe Direction® are well-positioned to respond to the needs of the Australian constructor. Safe Direction® became the first Australian company to offer an approved end to end fully MASH compliant steel beam guardrail. The system comprises of our RAMSHIELD® guardrail barrier terminated at each end of an installation with MSKT guardrail end terminals. We continue to expand our range of innovative products, recently launching CLAW – a people-friendly mobile hostile vehicle barrier – as well as becoming the exclusive Australian distributor of the only MASH compliant modular bridge barrier available in the country.

businesses.name: Dienamics
businesses.description:
Dienamics is a pioneering family-owned and operated business established in 1997 by its managing directors. Located in Brisbane, we offer a complete service of Industrial Design, Toolmaking, and Manufacturing. Our dynamic team of young and enthusiastic staff, combined with our in-house designers and engineers, is dedicated to delivering tailored solutions that meet all your project requirements.

With over 30 years' experience in design and manufacturing across various industries—medical, consumer, mining, construction, health, cosmetics, military, and agriculture—our design team adapts to diverse customer needs, from international enterprises to local businesses.

Our comprehensive services cover every stage of the process, from concept design and prototyping to tooling and manufacturing of packaged goods. At Dienamics, we streamline the design and manufacturing process, ensuring your product is efficiently developed and market-ready. We pride ourselves on our ability to offer a one-stop shop that brings your ideas to life, working closely with you to prepare solutions that meet your and your customers' needs.

Whether you're an inventor or a multinational organisation, we make your journey exciting and manageable. We love what we do, and we are passionate about transforming your ideas into high-quality, successful products.

At Iconic Solar, we believe that every step towards energy independence counts, and we're proud to be at the forefront of this movement in Wollongong and beyond.

We can guarantee that in addition to getting a solar or battery solution – you're also gaining a trusted installer committed to your long-term success and sustainability.

businesses.description:
For over 55 years Harrop Engineering has been at the forefront of designing, developing and manufacturing precision components. Competencies include turnkey project management, aluminium casting, precision milling & turning, CNC Machining, fabrication & assembly and ISO9001 quality accreditation.
MANUFACTURING
In-house manufacturing processes include tool and pattern design and machining, CNC finish machining of parts, assembly, verification and testing.

Harrop Casting Technologies specialise in non ferrous castings, blown isocure cores, in-house heat treatment and shot peening for all our aluminium products.

Purpose built for precision engineering design and manufacturing technology. The machining facility is air conditioned and protected by constant video surveillance and machine monitoring equipment. Consumables and tools are managed by an on-line automated inventory management system.
A comprehensive integrated factory and commercial system provides all areas of the business with live data logging and on-line status reporting. Computer technology throughout the organisation is synchronised with the most current applications being used by business today.
CAPABILITIES:
-3D SCANNING, CO-ORDINATE MEASURING AND REVERSE ENGINEERING
-AUTOMATED ASSEMBLY CELL
-LEAN MANUFACTURING WITH TOTAL COST MANAGEMENT PRINCIPLES

-GEAR & SPLINE CUTTING & BROACHING
-FABRICATION, PROFILE CUTTING AND SPARK EROSION
-CERTIFICATION TO ISO 9001:2008

businesses.description:
At Zambrero, we serve delicious and authentic Mexican cuisine right in Warnbro, WA. Our menu is loved by everyone, especially for our classic burritos, healthy burrito bowls, tasty nachos, delicious quesadillas, and cheese tacos. We offer Mexican food options for all diets, with vegan and vegetarian choices and meals free of gluten, soybeans, eggs, milk, peanuts, and tree nuts.

If you enjoyed your visit to Zambrero, we'd greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to leave us a review.

businesses.name: Natural Shine Hair and Beauty
businesses.address: 20 Marketsfield Ave, North Kellyville NSW 2155, Australia
businesses.description:
"We are a small family owned and run salon who pride ourselves on providing a holistic and natural service.

We believe that the natural way is the best way and although we may not be able to provide a totally natural or organic experience the products used are less toxic and have as many certified organic ingredients as possible.

The team at Natural Shine are skilled in the latest and techniques in the industry.

Our Natural Shine journey began 13 years ago when our founder was diagnosed with an auto immune disease known as Fibromyalgia and Cold Urticaria.

Through the use of organic and low toxic products Heidi was able to overcome her day to day challenges and was inspired to help others live a healthier and happier life.

During her health journey Heidi was determined to return to work with products that she knew and trusted and this was when she discovered Naturlique, a company that produces products that is free from parabens, SLS, phthalates, mineral oils, GMOs, and is always cruelty-free."

Conveniently located in Osborne Park, near Hutton Street and the Mitchell Freeway, we stock a wide range of high-quality wheels and castor wheels from local and international brands such as Tente and Lag to suit every industry and application. This includes stainless steel, heat resistant, cast iron, zinc plated and nylon wheels and castors.

Need a trolley to transport large or heavy objects safely and easily? We stock several trolleys and hand trolleys in all shapes and sizes.

What about a ladder to help you reach high areas? Blyth Enterprises is your place for all types of ladders from fibreglass ladders to aluminium ladders suitable for either domestic or industrial applications.

Need a place to store items? We stock many plastic products including plastic tubs, plastic buckets and plastic crates. This includes food-grade produce crates, butcher crates and milk crates among others.

We also supply an extensive range of adjustable levelling feet and corner buffers for any application, as well as gravity conveyors, drum handling equipment, pallet trucks and lift tables for the efficient handling of goods.

businesses.name: Aarons Removals
businesses.description: Aarons Removals is a family-owned business that has been working since 1975 to provide our customers with stress free and smooth relocations – within the city, region, interstate, or international. Since the business started operating nearly four decades ago, we’ve been striving to deliver a high quality of service and stress free moving. We’ve been changing to keep up with changing times, technology, equipment, and processes in the industry, and evolved over this time, continually changing for the better. Our operations are now more efficient, professional and customer focused than it was years ago, yet retaining our good old values of always being on hand to give you that personal touch and expert advice that’s so important at a time like moving. Our staff are well trained and our moving trucks are well equipped with all that is required to carry out relocations effectively and efficiently. At Aarons Removals we realise how stressful relocation could be and we work to make your move as hassle and stress free as possible. We manage all kinds of removals, from Corporate to Home Removals, working with all sizes of removals, big or small. Our services include door to door local moving (suburb to suburb), Country and Interstate relocations across Australia and Overseas removals via air or sea.

businesses.description: Bullocks Freightmasters International is a Western Australian, family-run business, established in Fremantle 33 years ago. If you are seeking to import or export, we have the worldwide resources to service all your international freight needs. Our services include; customs broker, trade & tariff consultancy, warehousing and distribution, import and export freight forwarders for international, local and interstate destinations. We have state-of-the-art cargo tracking. Whether by air, sea, rail or road, we deliver your consignment to your destination on time, every time. International customs clearance service we provide as we are a highly trained customs broker in Australia. Talk to us about importing from China or importing into Australia.

businesses.name: Chamberlains Auto Electrics
businesses.description:
Conveniently located in Welshpool, Chamberlain’s Auto Electrics has provided professional auto electric and air-conditioning services, including auto lighting, batteries and car alarms, to commercial and private clients throughout the Perth metropolitan area and right across regional Western Australia since our establishment in 1983.

Over the past thirty years, we’ve worked hard to build a solid reputation for delivering a wide range of services for Perth and WA vehicle owners, including car, truck and boat owners, which are defined by professionalism, punctuality and good old-fashioned customer service that you can rely upon and trust. Our highly-skilled team of auto electricians, certified repairers, and authorised air-conditioning specialists receive regular training and have the industry experience and the know-how to get your vehicle running smoothly again in no time at all.

If you’re looking for an unparalleled selection of high-quality auto electrical supplies in Perth or require the expertise of an auto electrician in Osborne Park, you’re looking for Chamberlain’s Auto Electrics. With over thirty years’ industry experience, a highly-skilled team, a fleet of well-equipped vans and a modern workshop, we have all your auto electrical and air-conditioning needs covered."

businesses.name: New Age Veneers
businesses.description:
New Age Veneers (NAV) delivers top-quality designer surfaces for commercial and residential projects. As an Australian-owned and operated company since 1962, NAV is dedicated to transforming the design of functional and beautiful spaces in workplaces, communities, and homes.

Leadership:

Kevin Kelly, the passionate owner of NAV, has guided the company through significant innovations. He has transitioned NAV’s product line from traditional veneer manufacturing to advanced, pre-finished, wood grain effect veneers.

Environmental Responsibility:

Sustainability is a core value at NAV. The company ethically sources raw timber materials from sustainably managed forests, upholding its long-standing commitment to environmental stewardship.

Product Innovation:

NAV excels in crafting cutting-edge veneer products that combine the natural beauty of real timber with enhanced durability, longevity, and design flexibility. Their wood grain veneers offer a tactile experience that appeals to both the eye and the touch.

Collaborative Approach:

NAV partners with architects, interior designers, and builders to bring technically advanced veneer surfaces to the Australian building industry. Their collaboration ensures that the products meet the high standards and innovative demands of modern design.

Mission:

While the industry has evolved since the 1980s, NAV’s mission has remained unchanged: to lead the way in premium surface engineering and design, continually staying ahead of the curve in innovation and quality.

businesses.name: Atlantic Insurance
businesses.description:
Proudly privately owned, Atlantic Insurance has been providing Insurance solutions Australia Wide from our head office located in Melbourne, Victoria since the early 1980’s. The previous generations involved with Atlantic Insurance have instilled a level of client service that’s become the benchmark. All of us at Atlantic Insurance have this front of mind and treat every client interaction as an opportunity to provide an exceptional experience.

Atlantic Insurance is a trading name of Atlantic Insurance Brokers Pty Ltd and holds AFSL 246369, which also comprises Atlantic Aged Care Insurance, Atlantic Plumbers Insurance, Atlantic Trades Insurance and Atlantic Short Stay Insurance.

We have been members of Steadfast since 1997 and NIBA (National Insurance Brokers Association) since 1986. These affiliations are a testament to our standing and commitment in the insurance broking industry.

Our strong relationship with insurers–both locally and overseas–has enabled us to develop unique insurance products that are not widely available on the open market. We understand that off-the-shelf insurance products can be cheaper. But relying on ‘cheap’ to protect your most valuable business and personal assets, at the time when you need it most, could have a disastrous long term impact.

businesses.name: Manufacturing Catalyst
businesses.description:
Manufacturing Catalyst is a boutique manufacturing and material flow advisory business, founded with one goal : to help people who make things, make things better.

Dr. Michael Lucas FIEAust CPEng, Founder and Principal Advisor at Manufacturing Catalyst, is a Chartered Professional Engineer and Fellow of Engineers Australia with three decades of experience in manufacturing and material flow optimisation and automation across four continents and a diverse array of industries. He has had pivotal roles in landmark manufacturing projects such as Tesla's gigafactory design and supply chain optimisation in California. He led the Industrialisation team at solar innovator 5B, significantly speeding up their manufacturing and assembly systems, and was the Global Engineering Manager for Transformer oil re-refiner Hydrodec, responsible for the deployment of a world first modular oil re-refining facility in Canton, Ohio enabling grid level transformers to be refilled with better quality oils. Michael has a past project portfolio with several billion in capital value, including automotive, clean energy, food and beverage, furniture, and prefabricated construction projects. With several patents arising from his work, he has been at the forefront of advancing sustainable manufacturing and material flow technologies with robotics, AI, and automation.

Michael started Manufacturing Catalyst with one goal – to help people who make things, make things better.

businesses.name: Jason Signmakers
businesses.description:
Jason Signmakers is a pioneering company based in Western Australia that is dedicated to engineering effective solutions for guiding West Australians safely to their destinations. As a 100% Australian-owned organization, we take immense pride in our commitment to innovation and quality. Our core focus is on delivering the best for our clients and ensuring the well-being of our people and communities.

Our primary area of expertise lies in signage solutions for various industries and infrastructure projects. From single supply orders to sophisticated, in-line, integrated, project-managed solutions, we have the capabilities to meet a wide range of signage needs. Our comprehensive approach encompasses every aspect of the signage lifecycle, from design and engineering to manufacturing, installation, and maintenance.

One of our distinguishing features is our unwavering dedication to meeting Australian Standards and State Authority certifications. This commitment ensures that our products not only meet but exceed the highest quality and safety standards in the industry. When you choose Jason, you can trust that you are investing in signage solutions that are reliable, durable, and built to withstand the unique challenges of the Australian environment.

Our clients are at the heart of everything we do. We view every project through a client lens, striving for excellence in every aspect of our work. We work closely with our clients to understand their specific needs and tailor our solutions to meet those requirements precisely. Our client-focused approach has earned us a reputation for delivering on our promises and exceeding expectations.

Our team is the driving force behind our success. We collaborate with the best professionals in the industry, fostering a supportive and nurturing environment where they can excel. We believe in enabling our people to be the best they can be, which in turn enables us to deliver outstanding results to our clients.

But our commitment goes beyond just business. We recognize our responsibility to the welfare of our people and communities. We have a steadfast covenant to go beyond workplace Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ) standards. This means that not only do we prioritize the safety and well-being of our employees, but we also actively engage in initiatives that contribute to the betterment of our local communities.

Innovation is ingrained in our DNA. It's not just a buzzword; it's a way of life at Jason. We continuously fuel ongoing development, improvement, and sustainability in our quest for the better. Our dedication to innovation ensures that our solutions remain at the cutting edge of technology, providing our clients with the best tools to achieve their goals.

In summary, Jason Signmakers is more than just a signage solutions provider. We are a partner committed to guiding West Australians safely and efficiently to their destinations while ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety, and innovation. Our unwavering focus on clients, people, and communities sets us apart, making us the preferred choice for signage solutions in Western Australia.

In the fast-paced world of property transactions in Perth, one company stands out for its commitment to excellence and professionalism: SURE Building Inspections Perth. Founded by Richard Edwards, our company has quickly become the go-to choice for clients seeking reliable and comprehensive inspection services.

Richard's own experience as an investor underscores our company's dedication to delivering superior service. Faced with the challenge of finding a quality inspection service, Richard recognized the need for a better solution. Determined to fill this gap in the market, he established SURE Building Inspections with a mission to provide clients with the peace of mind they deserve.

At SURE Building Inspections, we understand that buying or building a property is a significant investment. That's why we leave no stone unturned in our quest to provide our clients with accurate and insightful inspection reports. Using state-of-the-art digital reporting systems, our inspectors deliver detailed reports within 24 hours, covering every aspect of a property's condition.

From structural integrity to pest infestations, we provide expert analysis and recommendations to help our clients make informed decisions. With SURE Building Inspections, you can trust that you're getting the most comprehensive and reliable inspection services available.

Don't leave your property transaction to chance – choose SURE Building Inspections Perth and experience the peace of mind that comes from working with the best in the business. Contact us today to schedule your inspection and take the first step towards a smoother, more informed property transaction.

businesses.name: Zenko Energy
businesses.description:
A Beacon of Light in a Changing World

In an era defined by uncertainty and upheaval, one thing remains constant: the sun will rise each morning, casting its golden rays upon the earth below. At Zenko Energy, we see this daily spectacle not just as a reminder of nature's beauty, but as a source of endless potential. With Michael at the helm, our team of dedicated professionals is harnessing the power of the sun to illuminate a path towards a more sustainable future.

Our journey began with a simple yet profound realization: that the transition to renewable energy isn't just a choice; it's a moral imperative. Armed with this conviction, we set out to revolutionize the way households and businesses in the South West approach energy consumption. Through a combination of cutting-edge technology and unwavering dedication, we're empowering individuals to take control of their energy futures and reduce their carbon footprints.

But our commitment to sustainability extends beyond mere rhetoric; it's woven into the very fabric of our company culture. From our eco-friendly merchandise to our carbon-neutral operations, we're leading by example and proving that sustainability is not just a goal—it's a way of life.

At Zenko Energy, we believe that the key to a brighter future lies in our ability to come together as a community. That's why we're proud to partner with organizations like the Solar Village Project, whose mission aligns closely with our own. By purchasing our merchandise, you're not just supporting a local business; you're investing in a more sustainable, equitable world for generations to come.

In a changing world, let Zenko Energy be your beacon of light—a guiding force towards a greener, more resilient tomorrow. Join us, and together, let's harness the power of the sun to illuminate a path towards a brighter future for all.

businesses.name: Terra Firma Industries
businesses.description:
At Terra Firma, we imagine infrastructure differently.

Imagine halving time to deploy.

Imagine lowering capital costs by up to 60%.

Imagine infrastructure that lasts up to 10 times longer across its whole-of-life.

Imagine reducing OH&S incidents 200 fold versus traditional alternatives.

For over 30 years Terra Firma have led the transition from heavy, traditional materials to create the solution category for smarter, safer and more sustainable pit lid, access cover and FRP grating solutions based on composite designs.

Take a look next time you’re walking past your favourite restaurant, enjoying the scenery in your local park, launching a boat at your marina, refuelling your car at the local service station or performing a maintenance call at your water or energy utility. With hundreds of locations and thousands of deployments, chances are you will see Terra Firma in action.

businesses.name: China JSC Valve Manufacturer Group Co., Ltd.
businesses.address: Wuxing Industrial Zone, Oubei Town, Yongjia, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China
businesses.description:
China JSC Valve Manufacturer Group Co., Ltd.?https://www.jscvalve.com/), established in 2000, stands as a leading valve manufacturer and service provider in China. Strategically situated in the renowned "Chinese Pump & Valve Town" of Oubei, within Wenzhou city, Zhejiang province, our company covers an expansive area of 21,000 square meters. We have seamlessly integrated design, production, examination, sales, and service to offer comprehensive solutions within the valve industry.

Our diverse product portfolio includes ball valves, butterfly valves, gate valves, globe valves, check valves, plug valves, various valve components and parts, as well as pipes and fittings. Operating under working pressures ranging from Class 150 LB to 2500 LB, PN6 to PN420, and sizes from NPS 1/4 Inch to 80 Inch, DN6 to DN2000, our materials encompass castings such as WCB, LCB, LC1, CF8, CF8M, CF3M, CF3, C5, WC6, WC9, Monel, duplex, and forged materials like A105, F11, F22, F91, F304, F316, F51, F321, F347, Inconel, etc. Our valves cater to working temperatures from -196? to 680?, adhering strictly to ANSI, API, DIN, BS, JIS, EN, GOST standards. They find application in Petrochemical, Oil, Gas, Power Plant, Refining, and Metallurgy industries.

Stringent quality control measures ensure that our products not only meet but exceed customer expectations. We hold accreditation from ISO 9001:2000, PED, API 607, API 6D, and API 600. Our global reach extends to America, Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The TRIC butterfly valve and SDV ball valve, both under the JSC Valve brand, have garnered widespread approval from our esteemed customers.

businesses.name: Fire Central Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Fire Central has built a strong reputation for excellence in the fire protection system. Over the years, our company has grown steadily, evolving into a trusted partner for fire detection systems, Esm maintenance, Ewis Systems, and fire suppression systems.

At Fire Central, our mission is to ensure the safety and security of our clients by offering innovative and reliable fire protection solutions. We strive to exceed industry standards and provide peace of mind to our customers.

Our Services:

- Fire Extinguishers and Blankets: We offer a wide range of fire extinguishers tailored to specific needs, ensuring that businesses and individuals are prepared for any fire emergency.

- Fire Alarm Systems: Our advanced fire alarm systems are designed to promptly detect and alert occupants to potential fire hazards.

- Fire Sprinkler Systems: We install and maintain fire sprinkler systems that provide rapid and effective fire suppression.

- Fire Hydrant Systems: We specialise in designing fire hydrant block plans, installation, testing and commissioning of fire hydrant systems that comply with Australian Standard AS2419 and Building Code of Australia (BCA) requirements.

- Fire Suppression Systems: Fire Central can design, install, inspect and service any specialty fire suppression system that usually has four key components, i.e. Detection, Control Panel, Suppression System and Monitoring.

Why choose us for the Fire Protection System?

Our diverse clientele includes businesses of all sizes, homeowners, property managers, and industrial facilities. We cater to various sectors, including hospitality, healthcare, education, and manufacturing.

Our dedicated team of professionals at Fire Central is committed to fire safety excellence. We look forward to serving your fire protection needs and ensuring the safety of your assets and loved ones. Contact us today for a consultation or to learn more about our comprehensive fire safety solutions. Your safety is our priority.

Fire Central has built a strong reputation for excellence in the fire protection system. Over the years, our company has grown steadily, evolving into a trusted partner for fire detection systems, Esm maintenance, Ewis Systems, and fire suppression systems.

Our Services:

- Fire Extinguishers and Blankets: We offer a wide range of fire extinguishers tailored to specific needs, ensuring that businesses and individuals are prepared for any fire emergency.

- Fire Alarm Systems: Our advanced fire alarm systems are designed to promptly detect and alert occupants to potential fire hazards.

- Fire Sprinkler Systems: We install and maintain fire sprinkler systems that provide rapid and effective fire suppression.

- Fire Hydrant Systems: We specialise in designing fire hydrant block plans, installation, testing and commissioning of fire hydrant systems that comply with Australian Standard AS2419 and Building Code of Australia (BCA) requirements.

- Fire Suppression Systems: Fire Central can design, install, inspect and service any specialty fire suppression system that usually has four key components, i.e. Detection, Control Panel, Suppression System and Monitoring.

Why choose us for the Fire Protection System?

Our diverse clientele includes businesses of all sizes, homeowners, property managers, and industrial facilities. We cater to various sectors, including hospitality, healthcare, education, and manufacturing.

Our dedicated team of professionals at Fire Central is committed to fire safety excellence. We look forward to serving your fire protection needs and ensuring the safety of your assets and loved ones. Contact us today for a consultation or to learn more about our comprehensive fire safety solutions. Your safety is our priority.

businesses.name: Brisbane Brake and Clutch Supplies
businesses.description:
"Brisbane Brake and Clutch Supplies have a fully-equipped workshop that provides high-quality materials for all kinds of vehicle makes and models in Archerfield, Brisbane. Brakes and Clutch are the two important components of every vehicle that needs regular repair and maintenance services.

We have certified mechanics with more than 20 years of experience that comprehensively repair your brake, including brake pad replacement, disc brakes and drum machining, brake fluid, brake caliper overhauls, ABS diagnostics and repairs, Safety checks, and brake shoe replacement. "

"In our workshop, you will find complete brake kits, including brake pads, brake rotors, and brake boosters. Moreover, we have clutches from famous brands, such as Exedy Sports Tuff, Clutch Pro and Xtreme Outback.

Our mechanics always use high-quality brakes and clutch parts that give the optimum performance to your vehicle. If you find any problem in your vehicle, directly come to us. "

"Our clutch parts have minimum 12 months to 24 months guarantee depending upon the manufacturer. We have clutch repair services that focus on clutch replacement, upgrading your clutch performance, clutch cables, and flywheel machining.

As our workshop has a wide range of clutch and brake parts, our mechanics will get your vehicle in excellent condition in no time by always providing you with quick and reliable service to our customers. "

"We repair the brake rotors and clutcheses of cars, light trucks, heavy-duty trucks, four-wheel drives and vans. Once you visit us, you will always find your vehicle is in safe hands with our certified mechanics.

To know more about us, call us at 07 3277 7591 or mail us at sales@brisbanebrakeandclutch.com.au and get your vehicle's brake and clutch repaired and replaced by our mechanics."

businesses.name: Arb Culture
businesses.description:
Since its establishment in 2008, Arb Culture has been at the forefront of elevating tree care standards in Sydney. Our boutique arboricultural services extend across the Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, and Northern Beaches, delivering excellence under the leadership of Adam Newton and Flavio Leite. With over 15 years of experience and an AQF certificate III in arboriculture, our team stands as a symbol of quality and professionalism.

Arb Culture sets itself apart with an unwavering commitment to safety. From tree removal and pruning to emergency/storm damage rectification, hedge trimming, and building clearance pruning, safety is ingrained in every aspect of our work. Ensuring the well-being of our team, your family, and the wider community is our top priority.

Our dedication to providing a high-quality service is reflected not only in the work itself but in the cleanliness we guarantee. Despite the potential mess associated with arboricultural tasks, we leave your property as clean, if not cleaner, than before we commenced work.

Arb Culture specializes in conquering challenging or inaccessible locations, showcasing our expertise in navigating the intricacies of Sydney's diverse properties. As a boutique firm, we offer a personalized customer service experience, with Adam and Flavio ensuring your project receives the individualized attention it deserves.

Drawing from our extensive knowledge of council requirements acquired through years of collaboration with multiple councils, we provide accurate and professional arboricultural recommendations and pruning maintenance schedules. Despite our boutique status, Arb Culture maintains competitive pricing, offering free quotes to our valued clients. Choose us for a fusion of safety, quality, cleanliness, expertise in challenging locations, personalized service, and cost-effectiveness.

businesses.name: Laing Homes
businesses.description:
Founded by Samuel Laing in 2020, Laing Homes provides first-rate construction services in North Tasmania. Our team makes sure to use the highest standards of materials to ensure your investment will not decrease over time. We have successfully established ourselves as the go-to choice for those looking for custom homes in Devonport and its vicinity.

The Laing Homes difference

Our small company takes an individualized approach to each project, constructing solutions without the hassle of red tape. We recognize that everyone has a different vision for their home and provide an in-house drafting expertise to swiftly shape and refine plans to make sure they are viable and sustainable before construction can begin.

Each year we take on a limited number of projects so that we have the capacity to create the highest quality designs and builds. We firmly believe that whether you're constructing your first home or redesigning an already existing one, having us accompany you every step of the way is essential for a successful build. As locals, we are particularly knowledgeable in building with the environmental conditions specific to the North Tasmanian shoreline and its heritage, regardless of whether you are making your home in Ulverstone, Shearwater, Hawley Beach, Penguin, or Devonport itself.

Get in touch to find out more about how we can help.

businesses.name: Make My Finance
businesses.description:
Make My Finance, your trusted partner for comprehensive financial solutions. As a local Western Australian family business, we take pride in serving clients across Perth with a commitment to transparency, prompt service, and personalized advice. At Make My Finance, we have assembled a dedicated team of brokers and accountants to deliver a holistic finance solution tailored to your unique needs.

Leading our team is Nilesh Vasoya, a highly qualified and experienced professional with over 15 years in accounting, taxation, and financial advisory services. Nilesh holds certifications as a CPA, Certified Finance Broker, and business advisor. His memberships in organizations such as NTAA and ICAI (India), along with registrations as a Tax Agent and ASIC Agent, showcase his dedication to upholding the highest standards in the industry.

Nilesh's expertise spans a wide range of financial areas, including Financial Reports, Cash Flow management, Taxation advice, Internal Audit, and Account Reconciliation. He specializes in guiding small businesses on optimizing the use of accounting software such as XERO, MYOB, and QUICKBOOKS. His extensive experience with various systems allows him to develop growth strategies for small to medium-sized enterprises.

At Make My Finance, we understand that every financial journey is unique. Whether you're looking for Home Loans, Personal Loans (including car loans and holidays), Business Loans, or Asset Finance, our team leaves no stone unturned to secure the right financial solution for you. We see beyond the complexities of loan terms, offering clear and insightful advice to help you make informed decisions.

What sets us apart is our ability to see the big picture of your finances. With expertise in both finance and accounting, we can tailor solutions that align with your financial situation and goals. It's not just about finding a loan; it's about crafting a holistic finance solution that can make a significant difference in the long term, ensuring the health of your finances.

Experience the difference with Make My Finance – where transparency, expertise, and personalized service converge. If you're in need of finance, speak to our team that sees the big picture. Enquire today and let us guide you towards a brighter financial future.

Since 1973, Gino’s Panel & Paint has been a trusted name in automotive repair, weaving a story of precision and care from its base in South Fremantle. Founded and nurtured by Directors Basil Scagliotta and Aaron Scagliotta, this family-owned establishment has become a cherished institution, blending traditional values with cutting-edge techniques to deliver unparalleled service to the Perth community.

Gino’s Ethos: Quality, Service, Professionalism, Responsibility

Gino’s Panel & Paint stands tall on a foundation of core values that define its identity. These values - quality, service, professionalism, and responsibility - are not just part of a mission statement but are deeply ingrained in the company's DNA, shaping every repair, every interaction, and every relationship.

Quality - A Symphony of Craftsmanship:

Quality at Gino’s Panel & Paint is a symphony of craftsmanship, where every repair is an ode to precision. The team, driven by a passion for automotive excellence, meticulously attends to each vehicle, ensuring that it not only meets but exceeds industry standards. Gino’s commitment to quality is a nod to its heritage and a promise for the road ahead.

Service - Where Customers Are Family:

At Gino’s, the customer is not just a client; they become part of the extended family. Service is not a transaction; it's a relationship. From the first point of contact to the completion of repairs, Gino’s Panel & Paint places a premium on communication, transparency, and a genuine desire to make every customer feel valued and cared for.

Professionalism - A Tradition of Excellence:

Professionalism is not a mere virtue at Gino’s; it’s a tradition upheld with pride. The facility reflects not only a commitment to a clean and organized environment but also an ethos where every team member embodies professionalism in their conduct and work. Gino’s takes pride in maintaining an atmosphere that resonates with the trust and confidence of its customers.

Responsibility - Nurturing Community Bonds:

Gino’s Panel & Paint sees responsibility as a broader commitment beyond the repair bay. It's about nurturing bonds within the community and fostering a sense of responsibility towards employees, customers, and the environment. From community engagement initiatives to environmentally conscious practices, Gino’s is dedicated to making a positive impact beyond its business operations.

Integrated Services: Precision Meets Efficiency:

Gino’s Panel & Paint doesn't just repair cars; it crafts automotive solutions with a blend of precision and efficiency. Through integrated and coordinated services, the company ensures that repairs are not only of the highest quality but are also completed with efficiency, saving customers both time and money.

In essence, Gino’s Panel & Paint is more than an automotive repair center; it’s a legacy of craftsmanship, a haven for customers seeking a personalized touch, and a symbol of enduring family values in the realm of automotive mastery. As they continue to evolve, Gino’s remains a beacon of excellence in South Fremantle.

Comprehensive Care: Dental studios provide a wide range of services, from routine check-ups and cleanings to more specialized treatments like orthodontics, oral surgery, and cosmetic procedures.

Advanced Technology: Many dental studios invest in the latest dental technologies and equipment, allowing for more accurate diagnoses, efficient treatments, and enhanced patient comfort.

Experienced Professionals: Dental studios typically employ skilled and experienced dentists, dental hygienists, and support staff who are trained to provide high-quality care and personalized treatment plans.

Preventive Care: Regular visits to a dental studio can help prevent dental problems before they become more serious. Services like dental cleanings, fluoride treatments, and sealants can protect teeth and gums from decay and disease.

Cosmetic Treatments: Dental studios often offer cosmetic dentistry services such as teeth whitening, veneers, and dental implants, helping patients achieve a more attractive smile and improved self-confidence.

Emergency Care: Many dental studios provide emergency dental services, addressing urgent issues such as severe tooth pain, broken teeth, or other dental injuries promptly.

Convenience: With multiple services available in one location, patients can often schedule appointments for different treatments or procedures during a single visit, saving time and reducing the need for multiple trips.

Patient Education: Dental studios often prioritize patient education, providing information on oral hygiene, proper brushing and flossing techniques, and other aspects of dental care to help patients maintain optimal oral health.

businesses.name: EXBO
businesses.address: Unit 4/1 McDowell St, Welshpool WA 6106, Australia
businesses.description:
At ExBo Visual, our passion is turning your creative visions into vibrant realities. With a history spanning over 120 years in the realm of print and signage solutions, we've not only honed our craft but also embraced sustainability and inclusivity as core values.

When you partner with ExBo Visual, you're not just another client; you're a collaborator in a creative journey. We take the time to understand your unique goals and aspirations. Whether you represent a government entity, an industry leader, or a dynamic business, we respect the significance of your brand. We are here to translate your ideas into tangible, visually captivating solutions that leave a lasting impression.

ExBo Visual's legacy is a tapestry woven with the threads of excellence. For well over a century, we've been the go-to choice for discerning clients across a diverse range of sectors, including construction, property development, mining, oil and gas, hospitality, retail, healthcare, QSR (Quick Service Restaurants), events, branding, advertising, architecture, and engineering. Our history is a testament to our commitment to quality and innovation.

Sustainability is not just a buzzword at ExBo Visual; it's a guiding principle. We proudly uphold a sustainability promise that permeates every aspect of our operations. From responsibly sourced materials to eco-conscious production processes, we're dedicated to reducing our environmental impact while maintaining the highest standards of visual excellence.

As part of The Jason Group's national expansion strategy, ExBo Visual has taken bold steps to create an integrated national network. This expansion includes the recent acquisition of Artcraft in five East-Coast States, bolstering our capabilities and reach. We are now better equipped than ever to serve clients across Australia with unmatched expertise and efficiency.

Leading the charge in indigenous engagement and cultural awareness is Danny Ford OAM, ExBo's esteemed Chairperson. Danny's roots trace back to the Noongar people, with connections to the Wadjuk, Yuet, Ballardong, and Wilman clans. With nearly three decades of experience in the WA public service, his qualifications include a Bachelor of Social Work and a Diploma of Teaching. His career has spanned roles in child protection, family support, housing, mental health, and Aboriginal affairs. Danny's commitment to positive change is further evident in his roles on boards such as the Clontarf Foundation, Polly Farmer Foundation, ICEA, and the Wungening Aboriginal Corporation.

In closing, ExBo Visual is more than a provider of print and signage solutions; we are your partners in transforming ideas into vibrant realities. With a history steeped in excellence, a dedication to sustainability, and a commitment to indigenous engagement, we invite you to embark on a creative journey with us. Together, we can bring your vision to life and make a positive impact on our world.

businesses.name: Rockingham RV Centre
businesses.description:
Welcome to Rockingham RV Centre, Rockingham's trusted caravan center, where we redefine the caravan experience with exceptional service and a commitment to quality. As a local family business boasting over 20 years of hands-on experience, we take pride in offering honest advice and dedicated service to caravan enthusiasts.

Discover a world of quality caravan brands at Rockingham RV Centre. Our selection is meticulously curated, featuring hand-picked caravans built by individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence. Our focus on quality, durability, and attention to detail ensures that each caravan we offer is a testament to our uncompromising standards.

Explore the new caravans in Rockingham with Jim and our team of seasoned caravan aficionados. Step into our undercover showroom, where decades of experience come together to provide you with honest information and unparalleled customer service. Whether you are a seasoned traveler or a first-time buyer, Rockingham RV Centre is your trusted partner in finding the perfect caravan.

Looking for used caravans? Look no further. Rockingham RV Centre is your go-to destination for buying or selling. We assist in selling your van or motorhome, offering pickup services across most suburbs. Safety is paramount to us, and as part of our customer service, we collaborate with G-Force Caravan Weighing to ensure the accurate weight of every new and pre-owned vehicle we sell.

Embark on motorhome adventures with Lavinia, our knowledgeable Motorhome Specialist in Perth. With a vast client base built over years in the industry, Lavinia is dedicated to helping you find a motorhome that perfectly suits your needs. If you're looking to sell your motorhome, our extensive network can assist in connecting you with potential buyers.

Rockingham RV Centre is not just about sales; we are your comprehensive service, repair, and parts destination. Our fully-stocked Caravan Parts and Accessories Shop in Rockingham caters to your every need, with shipping available across WA and Australia-wide. As a Major Certified Repair Centre, we handle everything from repairs and upgrades to warranty work, modifications, insurance claims, and safety inspections. Caravan Insurance Repairs are our specialty, recognized by all major insurance companies. We streamline the process, ensuring a timely and professional resolution in times of emergencies.

Visit our Rockingham shop and let Rockingham RV Centre be your coastal companion for RV adventures. Immerse yourself in our range of caravans, motorhomes, and caravan parts, and let us inspire your next journey into the beauty of coastal living.

In the intricate realm of finance and commerce, Black Market shines as a guiding light, drawing from decades of management consulting experience to emerge as an indispensable partner to every company's engine room—the finance team.

They understand that the finance sector's needs are diverse, and they excel at aligning these unique requirements with the perfect talent.

Yet, what truly sets Black Market apart is their unwavering dedication to solving intricate financial, commercial, and operational challenges. They actively engage with boards and C-suite executives, providing comprehensive solutions that extend far beyond the typical offerings of recruitment agencies. They see themselves as torchbearers of financial excellence, working diligently with their clients to build a robust foundation for lasting success.

At the core of Black Market's philosophy is the concept of "lifelong clients." They view their clients as partners on an enduring journey rather than one-time transactions. They invest time in comprehending their clients' objectives and challenges, allowing them to provide tailored solutions and navigate the ever-evolving landscape of finance and commerce.

Black Market's exceptional track record speaks volumes about their capabilities. When entrusted with the task of sourcing and delivering talent, they achieve an astounding 100% success rate in delivering top-notch candidates. Their mission transcends recruitment; they aspire to transform organizations through exceptional financial leadership.

The impact of Black Market's efforts is evident in the career advancement of their placed candidates. A remarkable 90% of their placements are promoted within 1-3 years of their initial hiring, underscoring the quality of talent they consistently deliver. Furthermore, 80% of their annual business arises from returning clients who continue to rely on their expertise, and an impressive 30% of their contract resources transition into permanent positions, highlighting their talent identification and cultivation prowess.

If you're in search of a partner who can not only identify top-tier financial and commercial talent but also guide your organization towards sustained success in the challenging world of finance, Black Market is your guiding star. They thrive on illuminating the path to financial excellence, and they are eager to discuss how they can light the way for your organization.

Black Market specializes in the precision placement of finance and accounting professionals, offering a range of options, from permanent and temporary positions to interim roles, contract engagements, and project-specific talent acquisition. They understand that the finance sector's needs are diverse, and they excel at aligning these unique requirements with the perfect talent.

Yet, what truly sets Black Market apart is their unwavering dedication to solving intricate financial, commercial, and operational challenges. They actively engage with boards and C-suite executives, providing comprehensive solutions that extend far beyond the typical offerings of recruitment agencies. They see themselves as torchbearers of financial excellence, working diligently with their clients to build a robust foundation for lasting success.

At the core of Black Market's philosophy is the concept of "lifelong clients." They view their clients as partners on an enduring journey rather than one-time transactions. They invest time in comprehending their clients' objectives and challenges, allowing them to provide tailored solutions and navigate the ever-evolving landscape of finance and commerce.

Black Market's exceptional track record speaks volumes about their capabilities. When entrusted with the task of sourcing and delivering talent, they achieve an astounding 100% success rate in delivering top-notch candidates. Their mission transcends recruitment; they aspire to transform organizations through exceptional financial leadership.

The impact of Black Market's efforts is evident in the career advancement of their placed candidates. A remarkable 90% of their placements are promoted within 1-3 years of their initial hiring, underscoring the quality of talent they consistently deliver. Furthermore, 80% of their annual business arises from returning clients who continue to rely on their expertise, and an impressive 30% of their contract resources transition into permanent positions, highlighting their talent identification and cultivation prowess.

If you're in search of a partner who can not only identify top-tier financial and commercial talent but also guide your organization towards sustained success in the challenging world of finance, Black Market is your guiding star. They thrive on illuminating the path to financial excellence, and they are eager to discuss how they can light the way for your organization.

businesses.name: Honeybloom Florals
businesses.description:
Dunsborough, Western Australia, is home to the enchanting world of Honeybloom Florals, a floral haven brought to life by the artistic vision and heartfelt passion of Candice Honeybone. Here, amidst the beauty of this coastal paradise, a business thrives that embodies the magic of flowers and the enduring commitment of three generations to the art of floristry.

Candice's Floral Fairytale

Candice's journey into the realm of floristry unfolds like a fairytale. From her earliest memories, she found herself captivated by the allure of flowers, spending her childhood immersed in the delicate artistry under her mother's studio table. These early moments of wonder planted the seeds of a passion that would grow into the vibrant tapestry of Honeybloom Florals.

The Essence of Honeybloom Florals

As the proud torchbearer of the Honeybloom Florals legacy, Candice's passion for flowers permeates every corner of her studio. What began as a family tradition has evolved into a thriving business, where the art of floristry is infused with genuine emotion and a touch of magic. At Honeybloom Florals, every arrangement is a testament to Candice's boundless enthusiasm for the floral craft.

Candice Honeybone's distinctive style is a harmonious blend of romance and whimsy, capable of transporting you to a world of beauty and enchantment. Choosing Honeybloom Florals is an invitation to experience more than a floral arrangement – it's an immersion into a realm where each bloom weaves a narrative, capturing the essence of life's most precious moments.

Legacy of Floral Excellence: Three Generations Unveiled

The Honeybone family's dedication to the art of floristry spans three generations, a legacy built on the pillars of quality, creativity, and an unwavering love for flowers. Beatrice, Candice's grandmother and a pioneer in local floristry, laid the foundation for excellence, a legacy continued by Candice as she carries forward the family tradition with passion and innovation.

Honeybloom Florals specializes in crafting floral masterpieces for a wide range of occasions and settings. Whether it's the opulence of a wedding, the modern chic of a corporate event, or the simplicity of an elegant bouquet, Candice's creativity knows no boundaries. The studio offers an array of whimsical arrangements, ensuring that the magic of flowers becomes an integral part of everyday life.

Dunsborough's Influence: Nature's Palette

Dunsborough, with its stunning beaches and lush landscapes, serves as the quintessential backdrop for Candice's floral creations. The natural beauty of this coastal town inspires the organic and natural elements in Candice's designs. The Honeybone family's deep roots in the community further enhance the local charm infused into every creation.

At Honeybloom Florals, the client's experience takes center stage. Candice believes that every client should feel like a cherished part of the family. This sentiment is reflected in the personalized service she provides, taking the time to understand the client's vision and desires to ensure that each creation surpasses expectations.

Embrace the Floral Magic: Connect with Honeybloom Florals

Embark on a journey into the enchanting world of blooms with Honeybloom Florals. Candice Honeybone and her family's legacy invite you to experience a floral spectacle like no other. Whether planning a grand event or seeking to add a touch of whimsy to daily life, Honeybloom Florals brings expertise, creativity, and passion to turn floral dreams into vibrant reality.

Contact Honeybloom Florals today, and let Candice's floral creations add beauty and magic to the chapters of your life. With every petal telling a story and every arrangement a masterpiece, let the language of flowers paint an exquisite picture in your world.

businesses.name: SJK Collective
businesses.description:
When it comes to electrical, air conditioning, and plumbing services in Brisbane, you can count on the expert team at SJK Collective. We've been serving our community for over a decade, offering affordable and professional solutions with the motto, "no problems, only solutions."

As a locally-owned company based in Brisbane, SJK Collective has become a trusted name in the industry. We provide a full spectrum of services, including electrical, air conditioning, plumbing, gas, and solar services to clients in Brisbane and its surrounding regions.

At SJK Collective, we cater to both residential and commercial clients, offering maintenance services to a wide range of high-profile customers in Brisbane. Our team of highly skilled, fully qualified professional tradesmen brings years of expertise to every project, ensuring that each job is completed safely and to the highest standards. We take pride in our punctuality, dedication to excellent customer service, and our commitment to leaving every job site clean and tidy.

We believe in transparent pricing, eliminating any concerns about hidden charges. Customer service is at the heart of our mission, and we're delighted to offer advice tailored to meet your unique needs.

Our Origin Tale

SJK Collective's journey begins with our founder and Managing Director, Scott Kilkeary. Scott has always been dedicated to local businesses that aim to improve the living conditions of Brisbane's residents. His journey commenced with the management of a small business in Ashgrove, Brisbane. Later, he transitioned to the construction industry, where he rose to the position of foreman, overseeing projects in Brisbane's CBD and its suburbs. During this time, he gained invaluable experience working with contractors from various trades—some highly professional and reliable, while others were less dependable. Recognizing the inconsistencies among contractors, Scott saw the challenges that residents and businesses in South East Queensland faced when seeking electrical and other trade services. It was often a gamble to determine whether a contractor would be punctual, reliable, and professional. This realization sparked Scott's mission to provide a comprehensive and trustworthy range of electrical services to benefit the Brisbane community.

Our Founding

On June 1, 2013, "SJK Electrical" was born in Toowong, with Scott as its sole employee. Starting from humble beginnings, Scott worked diligently to build a reputation as a friendly, trustworthy, and consistently reliable electrical contractor. As our reputation grew, so did our team, leading to a move to larger headquarters in Indooroopilly. As our client base continued to expand, we relocated to Jindalee and ultimately established our permanent home in Sumner, complete with a spacious warehouse and office space. Today, our office is staffed with a strong support team, and our team of experienced technicians and hard-working apprentices continues to grow. Throughout our expansion, SJK Collective's mantra has remained constant: to grow and better serve the Brisbane community while staying true to our roots and core values.

Ready to Serve

Contact us today for all your electrical, plumbing, and air conditioning needs. We're eager to work with you and provide professional, cost-effective solutions.

businesses.description:
Strata management challenges are all too familiar, with common issues including poor response times, impersonal service, a lack of attention to detail, disorganization, and an inability to resolve important matters. These problems can escalate into significant issues that negatively impact the well-being of strata scheme residents. At Perth Strata Co, we are determined to offer a different approach to strata management.

Our primary focus is on smaller strata schemes, typically those with up to 20 units. We understand the unique challenges faced by these smaller schemes and are committed to providing hands-on support, addressing concerns, and resolving issues promptly.

A cornerstone of our success is our clear and efficient communication system. We prioritize transparency and effectiveness when handling on-site quotes

for external services, managing documentation, and ensuring compliance with strata regulations. This streamlined communication approach leads to faster resolutions and tangible progress.

businesses.name: Suitsme
businesses.description:
About Us

When it comes to helping with your mental health, we do things a little differently at Suitsme.

We’re passionate about providing you with the ability to take control, with excellent service and the ability to choose your own support team.

If you’re searching for a registered NDIS service with a difference, you’ve come to the right place.

How can we help?

Getting started

Your personal goals mean everything to us. We will work with you to design the best program to achieve them, help you find great people to help, and make it fast and simple for you to control the process using the Suitsme app.

At Suitsme, we concentrate on helping people with their mental health so we learn how to provide really good support when you need it. That is why we offer a flexible and prompt service:

Book at short notice

No wait lists

No cancellation fee

If you cancel a session with at least eight hours’ notice, then you won’t be charged

No notice period to end a service agreement

To join Suitsme you must have an NDIS plan, live in Perth and be over the age of 16.

How we work

You’re always in the driver’s seat. That is what makes Suitsme different from a lot of other services. First, you decide on the workers that suits you best. Then, we use a co-design approach to figure out how we can best work together. It’s about you sharing with us what you want, because you know what’s best for you. This article explains a bit more about it.

Getting started

The Suitsme app makes it quick and easy for you to take control of your own arrangements – choose who you would like to work with, when and where you want your sessions, and how you’d like to work together. Change your arrangements at any time. Setting up the app is very simple but let us know if you need help.

Choosing a support team

Our support workers all have knowledge of mental health; they are checked, screened and hired by Suitsme. Many workers include their credentials in the “About me” section of their app profile, along with all their personal details so you can check out and select the workers you think will be a good match. We have come up with some guidelines to ensure you have the best experience with your support worker. And if you decide you want a change, you can do that on the app at any time.

How we charge

Suitsme charges in accordance with the NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits. Our rates can vary based on time of day and what support you are accessing. Our weekday rate for core support is $64.04 per hour. Check our current pricing.

Operating hours

Suitsme operates from 7am to 7pm, 7 days a week. If you have core support funding, you can book a worker any time during our operating hours. If you have potential building funding, you can book a worker on weekdays.
