businesses.name: Reneew Collision Repair Centre
businesses.address: 1 Altona St, Bibra Lake WA 6163, Australia
businesses.description:
RENEEW Collision Repair Centre stands as a beacon of excellence and responsibility in the collision repair industry. Our extensive clientele includes insurance providers, individual drivers, and fleet operators, all of whom can expect nothing less than the best customer experience, impeccable workmanship, and a deep commitment to environmental sustainability.

Elevating the Customer Experience

Our foremost objective is to elevate the customer experience to new heights. We understand that accidents can be stressful, and our mission is to alleviate that stress by offering unparalleled support and service. From your initial contact with our friendly team to the moment you drive away in your fully repaired vehicle, we prioritize clear communication, transparency, and exceeding your expectations.

Our team is dedicated to ensuring that you not only receive the repairs your vehicle needs but also leave our facility with a sense of trust and satisfaction that lasts long after the repairs are complete.

Masters of Workmanship

At RENEEW, we take immense pride in our workmanship. Our team of highly skilled technicians is well-equipped to handle a wide range of repairs, from minor dents to complex work on electric (EV) and prestige vehicles. When you choose us, you can rest assured that your vehicle is in the hands of experts who demand the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.

Championing Environmental Responsibility

Environmental responsibility is a cornerstone of our identity at RENEEW Collision Repair Centre. We recognize that our clients share our commitment to sustainability, and we mirror that commitment in our practices. Throughout our operations, we actively work to minimize our carbon footprint. We invest in eco-friendly technologies, reduce waste, and follow sustainable practices to create a greener, more sustainable future.

Our Vision: Leading the Way

Our vision is clear: we aim to lead the industry with integrity and innovation. RENEEW strives to be the preferred collision repair company for EV and Prestige vehicles, setting a gold standard for quality and excellence. Safety is paramount, and we adhere to the strictest health and safety laws, regulations, and industry standards to create a safe working environment for our staff and customers.

Empowering Our Team

Our team is the driving force behind our success. At RENEEW, we embrace the philosophy of going the extra mile, not just as an obligation but as a path to personal growth and achievement. We invest in our team's development, providing leadership, training, and support to inspire them to attain the highest standards of workmanship. Our workplace culture is founded on values of respect, trust, and mutual support, fostering an environment where every team member can thrive.

Community Engagement

Giving back to the community is a fundamental value at RENEEW Collision Repair Centre. We are passionate about mentoring and supporting aspiring youth, instilling in them strong work ethics and a sense of responsibility. By sharing our knowledge and expertise, we aim to contribute to the growth and development of the collision repair industry while providing opportunities for the next generation.

Join Us in Shaping a Responsible Future

RENEEW Collision Repair Centre is not merely a repair facility; we are torchbearers of responsibility and excellence in the collision repair industry. Our dedication to environmental sustainability, unwavering commitment to workmanship, and exceptional customer service set us apart. We invite you to join us on our journey towards excellence and responsibility, as we redefine the standard for collision repairs and pave the way to a more sustainable future.

businesses.name: Chambré Estate
businesses.address: 167 Andrews Way Margaret River, WA 6285 Australia
businesses.description:
Nestled just a short 2-minute drive to the south of Margaret River Township, Chambré Estate awaits your arrival on its sprawling 3-hectare property. Here, you'll discover a tranquil oasis surrounded by lush bushland, with a captivating dam and winding walking trails to explore at your leisure. This idyllic location is not just a place to stay; it's an invitation to immerse yourself in the untouched beauty of nature while enjoying convenient access to nearby wineries and beaches.

Our Roots and Essence

Chambré Estate's story is rooted in a deep appreciation for the unspoiled wilderness and expansive farmland that define its surroundings. It was conceived as a sanctuary to provide respite from the fast-paced world we live in. As you enter this peaceful haven, the pristine natural environment warmly embraces you, creating an atmosphere of relaxation and rejuvenation.

Guiding Principles

At Chambré, we firmly believe in the restorative power of nature. Our core principles revolve around cultivating an atmosphere of tranquility, allowing our guests to fully immerse themselves in the peace that envelops them. Our goal is to establish an environment that nurtures inner calm, providing you with the space to reconnect with yourself amid life's chaos.

Creating a Sanctuary

Our commitment lies in offering both physical and mental spaces where guests can truly escape the demands of daily life and find harmony within themselves.

Embracing Nature's Embrace

We aim to provide an environment where visitors can unwind and shed the weight of stress. By immersing themselves in the serenity of the natural surroundings, they can achieve relaxation and inner equilibrium.

Understated Luxury

Our definition of luxury revolves around simplicity. Guests can revel in refined comforts and intricate details that enhance their experience without overshadowing the inherent beauty and tranquility of the retreat.

A Personalized Experience

We are dedicated to crafting a personalized and attentive experience for every guest. Every moment spent at Chambré is designed to exude consideration, warmth, and the understanding that you are a valued and cherished guest.

Our Diverse Guests

Chambré Estate extends a warm welcome to individuals and groups seeking refuge, serenity, and a profound connection with the natural world. Whether you long to escape the pressures of daily life, find solace in the natural landscape's splendor, or simply rejuvenate your spirit, our retreat offers an ideal haven. We cater to those in search of a tranquil experience, where the expansive farmland, native bushland, and open spaces converge to evoke a sense of calm and well-being. Come, and let Chambré's serenity embrace your journey, providing an opportunity to recharge and reconnect with nature.

Understated Luxury

A Personalized Experience

We are dedicated to crafting a personalized and attentive experience for every guest. Every moment spent at Chambré is designed to exude consideration, warmth, and the understanding that you are a valued and cherished guest.

Our Diverse Guests

Chambré Estate extends a warm welcome to individuals and groups seeking refuge, serenity, and a profound connection with the natural world. businesses.description:
About Us

With our professional team of Gold Coast electricians nothing’s a problem!

For people living on or near the Gold Coast, your home is your sanctuary. And with more of us working and spending time at home, who doesn’t want to spend a little time and money to make your life as comfortable as possible?

Our Gold Coast-based team of skilled tradespeople focus on new home construction, renovations and commercial projects.

About Us

Starting out as just one man in a van, Dan Carpenter has built his business to be one of the most successful and reliable electrical businesses on the Gold Coast.

Here’s the ‘Dan story’ in a nutshell.

Dan completed his apprenticeship in Adelaide and became a professional electrician by the age of 20.

In the great Aussie tradition, he took a ‘gap’ year, cruising the Whitsundays and doing work for a Charterboat Company.

Dan quickly made the decision that he liked being his own boss. So, he started his own show at the age of 22.

In 2006, Dan transferred to the Gold Coast and set up shop. Starting from scratch with zero clients or contacts, he pounded the pavement doing letterbox drops and checking out real estate agents, lighting stores and local businesses to drum up some work.

Between 2007 and 2011 Dan slowly grew his team to meet the need for the local building and booming solar industry.

Won the local Gold Coast Small Business Award for Trades and Services and was a finalist for the GC Young Entrepreneur of the Year in 2012.

In 2013, Dan had the honour of working in Vietnam after a client asked him to project manage a major electrical refurbishment of his factory. He led a team of 20 local electricians to bring the factory’s wiring up to Australian Standards. (And when you don’t speak Vietnamese, this was quite the job!)

After an intensive review process, Dan qualified as an Accredited Master Electrician in 2013.

In the past 7 years, Dan and his wife Kelly have worked tirelessly to grow the business – training, upskilling and developing the team – and building a reputation as the best in the business! (While at the same time, raising a growing family of three)

Dan was given some wise advice by the owner of one of the Lighting Stores when he first moved to the Gold Coast. He said…

“Mate, all you’ve got to do to survive here on the Gold Coast is to show up when you say you are going to and do a good job – that’s it – because no-one else is doing it”

Dan took that advice. It’s what he focused on back then, and it’s how his whole team still works today.

Show Up & Do an amazing job & Clean-up

Thanks to these basic principles (plus Dan’s near superhuman work ethic), the business has expanded from that single van to a team of 12.

businesses.name: Kelida Homes
businesses.description:
Kelida Homes Pty Ltd, established in 1993 by a father-and-son-in-law duo, is a name synonymous with quality and craftsmanship in the construction industry. Led by Andrew Mead, a master craftsman with a passion for historical preservation, Kelida Homes has consistently delivered renovation projects that exceed expectations.

Andrew Mead: A Craftsman's Journey

Andrew Mead's journey began in 1979 when he embarked on a four-year apprenticeship as a carriage builder for the State Rail Authority. After completing his apprenticeship in 1982, he dedicated a decade to meticulously crafting historical timber carriages by hand. Many of these exquisite carriages are now proudly displayed at the Thirlmere Railway Museum, a testament to Andrew's dedication to his craft and historical preservation.

In 1991, Andrew transitioned his artisan skills to the building industry, becoming a qualified carpenter, licensed builder, and supervisor. His commitment to excellence and continuous professional development has made him a trusted name in the industry.

Your Renovation Partner: Kelida Homes

Renovation horror stories are all too common—shoddy work, plans gone awry, disappearing tradesmen, skyrocketing budgets, and the stress of living in a construction zone. Kelida Homes, with over 25 years of renovation expertise, is here to change that narrative.

We boast a long list of satisfied clients who can attest to our unwavering commitment to delivering on time, within budget, and in a manner that minimizes disruption to your life. Our meticulous step-by-step process ensures that your renovation journey is smooth, transparent, and stress-free.

businesses.name: Artview Landscapes
businesses.description:
About Us

ARTVIEW Landscapes is an award-winning Sydney landscape design, construction and maintenance business founded in 2004. The owner Brian Baker is passionate about landscapes and focused on helping you transform your environment.

Brian founded ARTVIEW Landscapes with the goal of achieving excellence in landscape design, construction and maintenance. Our business has grown each year, thanks to a skilled, passionate team of Sydney landscape designers who pride themselves on quality work.

This site offers lawn mowing and gardening services, pest and weed control services, as well as fertilization and lawn irrigation installation and repair.

If you choose our Sydney landscape design and garden maintenance services, be aware that you will be given a constant support and trusted landscaping contractors.

In 2006 we were admitted into the Landscape NSW & ACT LTD Association.

In 2008 we won the award for Excellence in the Eco Awareness Residential section for our work on the Keays residence.

We always strive for client satisfaction and our completed works often surpass client expectations. The best proof of the excellence of our Sydney landscape design services are client testimonials.

Our People

Owner/operator Brian Baker is a talented landscape designer who has been managing, designing and building structured landscapes in Sydney for twenty five years.

He has personally built or managed over 800 landscape construction projects ranging in value from $5,000 to $250,000 for residential projects and between $10,000 and one million dollars for commercial projects.

Brian gives attention to everything at all stages of a project and specialises in interpreting clients’ ideas with a ‘view’ to creating a work of ‘art’.

Everyone at ARTVIEW Landscapes shares their passion for landscapes. Our team has experience and qualifications in Sydney landscape design, landscape construction, horticulture and carpentry and we continually expand our knowledge on garden maintenance through ongoing education.

ARTVIEW Landscapes also has apprentices who are studying to complete their trade qualifications. We are a host employer with 2realise and provides work experience opportunities to TAFE and high school students.

Quality Assurance

As garden maintenance often needs other work to be undertaken, such as electrical, plumbing or roofing, we only engage professional partners who abide by ARTVIEW Landscapes high standards of operation, ensuring all of them are currently licensed and insured.

We place great value on exact communication between you, ARTVIEW Landscapes and any specialist contracted into the project.

By really listening to your requests, the work is clearly directed to ensure your satisfaction.

WHS and Insurance:

We uphold stringent WHS and environmental policies and procedures for all operations. Our personnel have Work Cover approved WHS induction for the construction industry (white card).

Talk to us about your next Landscaping project.

In 2006 we were admitted into the Landscape NSW & ACT LTD Association.

In 2008 we won the award for Excellence in the Eco Awareness Residential section for our work on the Keays residence.

We always strive for client satisfaction and our completed works often surpass client expectations. The best proof of the excellence of our Sydney landscape design services are client testimonials.

Our People

Owner/operator Brian Baker is a talented landscape designer who has been managing, designing and building structured landscapes in Sydney for twenty five years.

He has personally built or managed over 800 landscape construction projects ranging in value from $5,000 to $250,000 for residential projects and between $10,000 and one million dollars for commercial projects.

Brian gives attention to everything at all stages of a project and specialises in interpreting clients’ ideas with a ‘view’ to creating a work of ‘art’.

Everyone at ARTVIEW Landscapes shares their passion for landscapes. Our team has experience and qualifications in Sydney landscape design, landscape construction, horticulture and carpentry and we continually expand our knowledge on garden maintenance through ongoing education.

ARTVIEW Landscapes also has apprentices who are studying to complete their trade qualifications. We are a host employer with 2realise and provides work experience opportunities to TAFE and high school students.

Quality Assurance

As garden maintenance often needs other work to be undertaken, such as electrical, plumbing or roofing, we only engage professional partners who abide by ARTVIEW Landscapes high standards of operation, ensuring all of them are currently licensed and insured.

We place great value on exact communication between you, ARTVIEW Landscapes and any specialist contracted into the project.

By really listening to your requests, the work is clearly directed to ensure your satisfaction.

WHS and Insurance:

We uphold stringent WHS and environmental policies and procedures for all operations. Our personnel have Work Cover approved WHS induction for the construction industry (white card).

businesses.name: Preston Builders
businesses.description:
About Us

At Preston Builders, we specialise in building future-proof homes that will fit in with every stage of your life – and with our stress-free process, you’re guaranteed an experience that’s memorable for all the correct reasons.

Every future-proof home we develop follows a Livable Homes Blueprint. They all are single-storey with wide hallways and doorways, perfect for almost any living arrangements or requirements – so no matter how big or small your project, you’ll know that your investment will go the distance.

Why build or renovate with us?

At Preston Builders, we build your forever home. Your new home or renovation can let you enjoy your home longer with some careful consideration. By working together, incorporating our experience and your vision, we build a plan which suits your changing lifestyle. Livable housing design is our passion. Designing a home that adapts as you age or as your family grows can save you lots of money on future renovation costs.

We Design For Longevity

Every home that we construct follows the principles of Adaptable Living and contains the key features of an accessible design, prioritising comfort, safety, and ease of access. This way, you’ll understand that your home will always be able to accommodate your needs, and if you do ever decide to sell, it will be a much more attractive prospect for your future buyers.

We Are An Experienced Team

We’re proud to say that our team has a combined 100+ years of industry experience and counting. Since opening our doors in 2007, we’ve built many forever homes and loved serving our clients.

We Pride Ourselves On Quality

Workmanship And Reliable Communication

Building a home is a big deal, so you can rest assured that when you navigate the process with us, you’ll never feel like you’re going it alone. We’ll deliver workmanship that catches the eye and make sure no critical details ever slip through the cracks.

All Our Work is Guaranteed

Our finished products are built to last and backed by a guarantee. Plus, with the combined experience and vision in our team, we have the experience to develop a plan that suits your lifestyle and your budget, so you can trust that your forever home will reflect your needs and preferences. You can forget budget blowouts!

Meet the Team

Wayne is a respected Livable Homes Guideline Accessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation. Lee has a nursing background and all the skills to draw up a plan for your home that suits you and your family perfectly.

Wayne and Lee are keen about ensuring your home is suitable to your lifestyle. In particular, they focus on building “Forever Homes”. If you want to be sure that your home meets your aging needs, Wayne is a Livable Homes Guideline Assessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation, and Lee has a nursing background and enjoys taking the time to draw your home plans to ensure your home suits your family care needs. Together, they are the team you’ll want on your side throughout the procedure of building your accessible forever home.

About Us

At Preston Builders, we specialise in building future-proof homes that will fit in with every stage of your life – and with our stress-free process, you’re guaranteed an experience that’s memorable for all the correct reasons.

Every future-proof home we develop follows a Livable Homes Blueprint. They all are single-storey with wide hallways and doorways, perfect for almost any living arrangements or requirements – so no matter how big or small your project, you’ll know that your investment will go the distance.

Why build or renovate with us?

At Preston Builders, we build your forever home. Your new home or renovation can let you enjoy your home longer with some careful consideration. By working together, incorporating our experience and your vision, we build a plan which suits your changing lifestyle. Livable housing design is our passion. Designing a home that adapts as you age or as your family grows can save you lots of money on future renovation costs.

We Design For Longevity

Every home that we construct follows the principles of Adaptable Living and contains the key features of an accessible design, prioritising comfort, safety, and ease of access. This way, you’ll understand that your home will always be able to accommodate your needs, and if you do ever decide to sell, it will be a much more attractive prospect for your future buyers.

We Are An Experienced Team

We’re proud to say that our team has a combined 100+ years of industry experience and counting. Since opening our doors in 2007, we’ve built many forever homes and loved serving our clients.

We Pride Ourselves On Quality

Workmanship And Reliable Communication

Building a home is a big deal, so you can rest assured that when you navigate the process with us, you’ll never feel like you’re going it alone. We’ll deliver workmanship that catches the eye and make sure no critical details ever slip through the cracks.

All Our Work is Guaranteed

Our finished products are built to last and backed by a guarantee. Plus, with the combined experience and vision in our team, we have the experience to develop a plan that suits your lifestyle and your budget, so you can trust that your forever home will reflect your needs and preferences. You can forget budget blowouts!

Meet the Team

Wayne is a respected Livable Homes Guideline Accessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation. Lee has a nursing background and all the skills to draw up a plan for your home that suits you and your family perfectly.

Wayne and Lee are keen about ensuring your home is suitable to your lifestyle. In particular, they focus on building “Forever Homes”. If you want to be sure that your home meets your aging needs, Wayne is a Livable Homes Guideline Assessor for the Liveable Housing Design organisation, and Lee has a nursing background and enjoys taking the time to draw your home plans to ensure your home suits your family care needs. Together, they are the team you’ll want on your side throughout the procedure of building your accessible forever home.

businesses.name: From 2 to 3
businesses.address: Suite 202/7-11 Clarke St, Crows Nest NSW 2065, Australia
businesses.description:
About Us

From 2 to 3 Relationship and Marriage Counselling Sydney will provide you with the essential knowledge and skills you need to make healthy relationships (with yourself… and with others) that thrive.

Giving relationship and marriage counselling Sydney to individuals and couples from pregnancy into the early years

From 2 to 3 provides relationship and marriage counselling Sydney for those taking the big step in to parenthood. Located on Sydney’s North Shore, we are a certified practice that uses our training and wealth of experience to aid both individuals and couples who are creating a family.

The entire process of having and bringing up a child is among the most complex that an individual and a couple can experience. It creates a particular set of challenges to each family, and going through them can strain even the strongest couples. From 2 to 3 relationship and marriage counselling Sydney provides a service that prides itself on promoting open, honest discussion, breaking down barriers to communication, and encouraging stronger bonds as you move through this unique time.

My name is Ginny Lindsay, and I bring a wealth of formal training and personal experience to the fold. I have assisted hundreds of couples take on the difficulties of creating a life, and look forward to helping you. You can read more about me here.

From 2 to 3 offers couples and marriage counselling Sydney services across the North Shore and to the entirety of Sydney. We are ready to help you to transition in to parenthood, joyfully, happily, and together.

From 2 to 3, a relationship and marriage counselling Sydney practice established by Ginny Lindsay who is also its Principal Therapist, has been providing help to individuals and couples in life-changing situations that may affect communication between partners.

About Ginny

Who am I?

I’m an experienced psychotherapist and counsellor, and Principal Therapist at From 2 to 3, a couple counselling service dedicated to helping couples adjust to the challenges of life with a newborn. Obviously my academic background is important, and you can read it below, but I strongly believe it’s my personal journey that enables me to offer my clients the greatest value.

I am a single working mother with a gorgeous grown son. When my boy was only seventeen months old, my husband had left and I was dealing with post-natal depression and anxiety and felt ill equipped to deal with it. Since then, I have learnt, through hard times and rewarding times, to adapt to my changing situations and understand the impact that a baby has on relationships. It is my life experience, combined with my extensive studies, that has given me the knowledge and compassion to support others in similar situations.

I passionately believe that growing your family from two to three can be a lot less stressful if you have the right help. I am dedicated to working with couples having their first baby and helping them face the changes in relationship dynamics that occur during this challenging transitional time.

Even though our relationship ended, my ex-husband and I worked together and learnt from our respective pasts to develop a respectful relationship with each other, which provided a solid foundation for our son. I have also been privileged to have the experience of introducing a new partner into my family’s world, where we have accepted a new version of going from ‘two to three’.

I hope to have the opportunity to support you on your journey to loving each other, your child and finding great happiness together.

businesses.description:
When it comes to safeguarding your business, the Westside Insurance Specialists team takes the lead with precision and expertise. Our journey began in 2012, and since then, we've emerged as a dynamic force in the insurance landscape. As proud partners of Insurance Advisernet, a prominent name in Australia's general insurance network, we have honed our skills to offer unrivaled value, versatility, and advisory services to the businesses gracing Western Australia.

What sets us apart is our unwavering dedication to the local dynamics. Our roots are deeply embedded in Western Australia, and we've nurtured a profound comprehension of the insurance needs that resonate within our community. This devotion is mirrored in our strategic headquarters located in Kwinana Beach and Burswood, two pivotal locales that serve as our launching pads for comprehensive and locally rooted insurance solutions.

While our clientele spans a spectrum of industries and sizes, it's the symbiotic relationship we share with WA's mining, resources, and construction sectors that truly ignites our passion. The mutual ethos of resilience, adaptability, and preparation forms the cornerstone of this bond, empowering us to cater to these sectors with tailored precision.

Get in touch with us today to discuss your project requirements and discover how Westspan Sheds can make your shed dreams a reality.

businesses.name: Matchett Constructions PTY LTD
businesses.address: 272 Ruthven St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350, Australia
businesses.description:
Over the past decade, Matchett Constructions has emerged as a leading force in the market, delivering exceptional work that exemplifies our team's dedication to craftsmanship and quality.

Under the ownership and operation of local resident Will Matchett, our company has earned a reputation for reliability and innovative practices. We proudly serve a wide area that includes Toowoomba, Darling Downs, and the Western Queensland market.

Our specialized services encompass house renovations, extensions, new builds, and home design. With our team of skilled and experienced professionals, we are committed to guiding you through every stage of your project, from inception to final handover.

WHY CHOOSE MATCHETT?

With more than 15 years of experience building in Toowoomba, our Founding Director Will Matchett brings a wealth of expertise to our company.

Having grown up in Western Queensland and later attending Toowoomba Grammar School, Will developed a deep appreciation for the area's scenic landscape and charming houses. Inspired by his surroundings, he embarked on a construction career to contribute to the allure of Toowoomba. After honing his skills and knowledge under the mentorship of one of Toowoomba's most esteemed residential builders, Will felt compelled to make his own mark on the beloved city, leading to the establishment of Matchett Constructions.

Drawing on years of experience and industry insight, Will envisioned an exceptional construction company. At the heart of Matchett Constructions lies an innovative boutique builder that upholds superior workmanship and prioritizes strong client relationships. Our expertise lies in creating bespoke custom homes, executing large-scale renovations, and delivering top-notch extensions.

Having spent considerable time in the industry, Will understands what matters most to our clients: timely completion and impeccable quality. Matchett Constructions is renowned for meeting and surpassing these expectations. We acknowledge the multitude of options and decisions that come with the building process, which is why we foster open communication and maintain an accommodating approach. We are willing to adapt to client needs and embrace changes during the project to bring your dream build to life.

Thanks to Will's tireless efforts and amiable nature, Matchett Constructions enjoys enduring partnerships with the finest contractors in Toowoomba. Our dedicated team of carpenters consistently goes above and beyond to elevate each project. Will's genuine passion for the construction industry shines through, evident in his attention to detail and eagerness to explore innovative design concepts. By incorporating bespoke and customizable materials, we strive to maximize the potential of every endeavor.

businesses.name: Prosser Built
businesses.description:
In the world of construction, few names evoke a sense of legacy and excellence as the Prosser family does. For over eight decades, the Prosser family has been at the forefront of building and development, shaping the landscape of Bunbury and beyond. From its modest beginnings to its current stature as a multi-disciplined commercial and residential project provider, Prosser Built stands as a testament to the power of vision, dedication, and generational continuity.

The Prosser story began with Ron Prosser, a first-generation builder with a dream and a small joinery shed on Beach Road in Bunbury. Ron's passion for craftsmanship and determination to deliver exceptional quality propelled him forward. As demand grew, he expanded his operations, eventually establishing a large sawmill on Strickland Street. This marked a pivotal moment in the family's journey, as Ron shifted from joinery to home building, setting the stage for the birth of Auden + Prosser Builders and Prosser Homes.

With the baton of leadership passed to the second generation, Steve Prosser continued to build upon his father's legacy. Under Steve's stewardship, Prosser Homes and R+M Prosser + Son became synonymous with innovation and excellence in "off the plan" home building in Bunbury. Steve's ability to envision and adapt led the company into uncharted territory—commercial building—showcasing the family's versatility and forward-thinking approach.

Today, as the third-generation builder, Dave Prosser carries forward the family's torch with pride and purpose. Dave's deep respect for tradition is matched only by his commitment to embracing the future. At the helm of Prosser Built, Dave has steered the company to new heights, guided by a relentless pursuit of quality and a dedication to preserving the essence of Prosser craftsmanship.

Prosser Built isn't just a construction company; it's a reflection of the Prosser ethos. Our comprehensive suite of services encompasses everything from design conceptualization to the final nail, all orchestrated seamlessly by a unified team operating under one roof. This integrated approach eliminates fragmentation and fosters clear communication, ensuring that every project progresses with efficiency and transparency.

What sets Prosser Built apart is our discerning approach to project selection. We aren't driven by quantity but by the opportunity to showcase our expertise. Our focus on commercial projects and architectural builds speaks to our commitment to delivering structures that are not just functional but also exceptional in design and execution.

Central to our success is the Prosser commitment to professionalism and clear communication. We recognize that every project is unique, and our approach is tailored to suit each client's distinct needs. This personalized touch forms the foundation of the relationships we cultivate—a testament to our belief that collaboration is the cornerstone of great construction.

In closing, Prosser Built stands as a living testament to the Prosser family's journey through generations. Ron's dedication, Steve's innovation, and Dave's leadership have woven a tapestry of excellence that extends far beyond bricks and mortar. With each project we undertake, we honor the past, embrace the present, and chart a course for a future where the Prosser legacy continues to shine as a beacon of inspiration in the construction industry.

businesses.name: Blindman
businesses.description:
Nestled in the heart of Northwest Sydney, Blindman is a family-owned business that has been illuminating homes with its custom-made curtains, blinds, shutters, awnings, and doors since 1989. Over the years, we have built our reputation as specialists in crafting elegance for your windows and doors. Our unwavering dedication to customer satisfaction and exceptional craftsmanship has made us a trusted name in the industry.

A Legacy of Trust

The Blindman family has stood as a pillar of trust in Sydney for generations. Our commitment to delivering high-quality products and impeccable service has earned us the loyalty of countless homeowners. When you choose Blindman, you're not just choosing a product; you're choosing a legacy of excellence and reliability.

A Comprehensive Range of Products

Every home tells a unique story, and we believe your window treatments should reflect that. At Blindman, we offer a diverse range of customizable solutions to cater to your specific needs and preferences. Whether you desire the soft touch of custom curtains, the modern aesthetics of blinds, the durability of shutters, or the sun protection of awnings, we have the perfect solution to enhance your living spaces.

Dedicated to Excellence

Our commitment to excellence extends beyond competitive pricing. It's about upholding the highest standards of workmanship and product quality. We take pride in the fact that a significant portion of our business comes from referrals by satisfied customers. This trust from our clients is a testament to the exceptional work, superior products, and personalized service that our team consistently delivers.

Your Home, Your Vision

At Blindman, we recognize that your home is an extension of your personality. Our experienced team works closely with you to understand your unique vision and requirements. From the initial design consultation to the final installation, we ensure a seamless and stress-free experience, helping you transform your house into a personalized sanctuary.

In conclusion, Blindman is not just a business; it's a legacy of crafting elegance for your windows and doors. With a rich history of trust, a dedication to excellence, and a wide array of customizable products, we are your partners in adding sophistication and functionality to your home. Let Blindman be your choice for creating elegance and beauty in every corner of your home, one window at a time.

Express Envelopes is a leading online wholesale envelope supplier of high-quality envelopes and packaging solutions for businesses and individuals throughout Australia. Established in 2000, the company has since grown into one of the most trusted and reliable envelope manufacturers in Australia and, in 2011, opened its warehouse and printing facility in Sydney.

With a vast range of products available, Express Envelopes caters to all types of businesses, from small startups to large corporations. The company's products are ideal for mailing and are available in various materials, sizes, and colours.

Express Envelopes are a stockist and custom manufacturer of envelopes with offset & digital printing capabilities. Express Envelopes are leaders in:

• Custom Printed Envelopes

• Printed Envelopes

• Recycled Envelopes

• Business Envelope Printing

• Tudor envelops

At Express Envelopes, quality and customer satisfaction are paramount. The company's team of experts are dedicated to providing the highest level of service and support to every customer, ensuring that they receive the best products and advice to suit their needs.

One of the key benefits of working with Express Envelopes is the convenience of their online ordering system. Customers can easily browse and order products on the company's website, with secure payment options and fast, reliable shipping to all parts of Australia.

Why Choose Us as the Envelope Manufacturer?

If you're looking for wholesale supplier for high-quality Australian envelopes for your business or personal needs, look no further than Express Envelopes. With a vast range of products available, custom printing options, and a commitment to quality and customer service, we're confident that we can provide the perfect solution for you. So why wait? Visit our website today to browse our products, or get in touch with our team to discuss your specific requirements.

We look forward to hearing from you!

businesses.name: Industrial Business Brokers
businesses.address: Suite 597, UL40, Level 2, 1341 Dandenong Road, Chadstone, VIC 3148
businesses.description:
Industrial Business Brokers specialise in the sale of manufacturing, wholesale, distribution, and service businesses. Industrial businesses typically have business-to-business transactions in closely networked industries.

Many other business brokers focus more on obtaining listings and just place an ad and wait for leads to trickle in. We limit listings to ensure we dedicate more time to your business sale. This includes:

* genuinely screening all leads,

* being more available for inspections,

* actually doing targeted marketing, and

* working harder to get your business to an agreed offer and settlement.

This is why we maintain a high offer-to-listing ratio with almost all offers near, at, and above asking price.

businesses.description: Canberra Pressure Cleaning is the leading provider of pressure washing services in Canberra, ACT. With over 5 years experience in home and business pressure cleaning, our team delight in delivering the best exterior cleaning results possible. As a fully licensed and insured Canberra power washing business, we have the skills and equipment to take on external cleaning jobs of all sizes, from simple driveways to multiple dwelling roof cleaning projects. Our ACT exterior cleaning services cover all external seurfaces from rooftops to ground level and everything in between. We can clean your roof, gutter and solar panels, garden paths and driveway, and your house walls and windows. Different surfaces require different techniques and equipment. We have a variety of modern softwash and high pressure machines that give outstanding results on any surface without damage that can come from inexperience. Is your driveway starting to look a bit worse-for-wear? It's amazing how much dirt and grime can accumulate on concrete surfaces. businesses.description:
Eastern Security Doors offers strong and reliable security doors in the Melbourne area, Australia which is well designed and suit client-specific requirements. Our business is family-owned and operated and we have long-term experience in serving our valued clients to the highest standards. Our range of security doors includes aluminum security doors, steel security doors, and stainless steel security doors. Our security door can be custom designed and comes at an affordable price.

Security screens from Eastern Security Doors are high quality and long-lasting. businesses.name: Acclaim Tree Care & Services
businesses.description: Acclaim Tree Care & Services is the leading tree service company in Brisbane, Queensland. With over 5 years of experience in the tree services industry, our team of qualified arborists have the skills to look after all your tree problems. As a fully licensed and insured Brisbane tree removal and trimming business, we have the skills and equipment to take on trees of all sizes, from domestic palm tree trimming to massive gum tree removals. Our southeast Queensland tree services cover all tree trimming, removal, stump grinding and land clearing. We can cater to home and commercial properties, from large-scale rural land clearing to urban tree removal in tight spaces. Different trees require different techniques and equipment. We are professionally trained arborists, meaning that we will remove or trim your trees in a fast, sustainable and ecologically-friendly way. Is your large tree giving you nightmares? Worried it might fall on your roof in the next Brisbane thunderstorm? We'll remove your tree burden and restore your peace of mind! If you'd like to see some of our results, check out our reviews online and see the before and after photos - you'll be amazed at what we can achieve! One of our specialties is large trees in suburban backyards. Never thought it would get that big? We see it all the time! Keep your kids safe and avoid costly property damage - get the experts at Acclaim to professionally remove your tree. Are you looking to sell your Brisbane property soon? Tree trimming and pruning is a great way to give your home the wow factor. As soon as potential buyers see your immaculate front and back yards, they'll be in love! Our team is located in Brisbane southside at Rochedale and regularly service all areas of the great south-east, including Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, the Gold Coast, Redland Bay and surrounds.

businesses.name: Fildes Food Safety
businesses.description:
The Fildes name has become well-renowned and trusted throughout the industry for our premium quality food labelling solutions. In addition, we provide a wide range of durable and reliable kitchen implements which further contribute to improved food safety practices and reduce incidents of food poisoning while also enhancing the efficiency of food and beverage operations.

Fildes Food Safety’s products and services are designed to satisfy the demands of commercial kitchens to help maintain and improve your reputation in a number of ways including:

• Facilitating more streamlined processes

• Clearly communicating vital food information

• Reducing the danger of cross-contamination

• Protecting allergy sufferers from potentially serious adverse reactions

• Protecting the general public against the risk of debilitating food poisoning

Our extensive range of products includes a wide variety of equipment to help kitchens establish and maintain an effective food safety culture, all of which are developed with these key safety concerns at the centre of everything we do.

• Food thermometers are an indispensable tool for ensuring food is within the correct safe temperature range throughout cooking, storage and transportation. They can also help prevent food from entering the food safety ‘danger zone’ which allows for bacteria to grow most rapidly. A good-quality Fridge Freezer Thermometer, for example, can be checked periodically to help reduce food safety risks by monitoring your equipment to ensure it is maintaining the appropriate temperature levels: below 5°C for fridges and -18°C for freezers.

• Food safety labels help to quickly and clearly communicate key safety information at a glance, including use-by dates, allergen information and food preferences such as 'vegetarian' and ‘vegan’.

• Colour Coded Chopping Boards utilise an easy to follow, instantly recognisable colour coding system, making it effortless for all employees to implement and follow the kitchen rules and avoid cross-contamination.

• Commercial food and storage containers prevent the spread of airborne illnesses, guard against contaminants such as dust and insects and also help eliminate the risk of cross-contamination

• Food safety posters serve as a convenient point of reference and a constant reminder to staff of the importance of food safety procedures such as e.g. Food Storage Temperature Chart

For all of your food safety needs contact one of our friendly team on 1800 673 644 or send us an email via sales@fildesfoodsafety.com.au. You can also view the full product range by visiting our online store.

About:

Metro Auto Glass service all of Sydney repairing and replacing all types of automotive glass. Available 24/7 our qualified technicians are fully mobile completing all work on-site at your location. While we can arrange to meet you at any time we do ask that you call ahead at your earliest convenience to ensure we have your required glass on hand. Some specialty glass needs to be picked up from the appropriate supplier. Either way, we work with you to complete the work as soon as possible, often achieving the same or next day service.

Specializing in front and rear windscreen replacements, we get your car, ute, van, truck or other specialized vehicle repaired and available for full use once more. Some damage to the front windscreen creates a defect and is illegal to drive in NSW. For this reason, it is best to give us a call to get it fixed asap to prevent heavy fines or endangering the lives of passengers, pedestrians or yourself as a driver.

Stone chip repairs are also best tackled at first notice. Driving with even the smallest chip or crack can quickly cause it to grow in size transforming the cost of a simple chip repair into a more expensive windscreen replacement.

Smashed window from vandals? Request our team to complete a full window replacement ensuring your electric window function is fully operational and safety is once again returned to your vehicle.

For auto glass repair and replacement in Sydney on all makes and models give our mobile service team a call on 02 9800 9509 now.

businesses.name: Noveco Systems Pty. Ltd
businesses.description:
Noveco Systems assists the project managers who run SAP Project Systems (SAP PS). Our expert team has built solutions that provide important functions to manage the projects in SAP system directly. Through our SAP project management software, we aim to provide our clients with a powerful platform that help transform the way SAP businesses manage their projects. Now, no more use of excel sheets, interfaces or middleware. We help our clients as SAP project builder, helping them to work smarter and get better results with less effort.

We want our clients to spend more time on their project and not on managing their project's data. Our SAP commercial project management (SAP CPM) includes engineering and construction projects, capital and maintenance projects as well as manufacturing projects. We look forward to transforming our client's approach in managing their business by catering them with SAP project systems training (SAP PS training).

Our Solutions

SAP Portfolio and project management offer the clients with the following:

- Creating project structure following SAP project management module

- Creating estimates with project management SAP

- Planning expense and revenues with PS SAP

- Allocating required resources under SAP PPM

- Defining start and finish dates of project activities under SAP project systems module

- Running procurement of services and materials by following SAP PS module

- Allocating actual costs and revenue

- Monitoring and updating on the project budgets through SAP project systems overview

- Handling project variations

- Running project reports with SAP module PS

Know more about our smart solutions and services by contacting us directly. Our professional team will be there to provide immediate assistance.

businesses.name: Sydney Wide Shutters
businesses.description:
We take the opportunity to introduce you Sydney Wide Shutters, a leading roller shutter supply and installation service provider located in NSW, Sydney.

We supply quality roller shutters for various applications including Aluminium shutters, exterior window shutters, security shutters and window shutters.

The types of roller shutters we are dealing with including:

1.Battery Roller Shutters

2.Manually operated Roller Shutters

3.Electrically Operated Roller Shutters

A proud member of HIA, we are also in the business of installing and supply of PVC type- plantation shutters, available in more than 15 painted and 13 stained colours. It can be used for high- moisture areas such as bathrooms, laundries, and kitchen areas.

Our plantation shutters have two types:

1. PVC (Fauxwood )

2. Basswood.

The PVC Fauxwood shutters come with 25-years of warranty and Basswood shutters comes with 5 years of Warranty.

Our rolling shutters that come with 10 years of warranty can be used as an alternative for window grills. Not only it provides security, it also provides noise Insulation, lower heat consumption and dust protection.

Not only this, We are also the Sydney based supplier of Ozroll, a leading manufacturer of shutters in Australia. We are also offering high quality and authentic Australian made roller shutters.

businesses.name: Variant Trailers
businesses.description:
We develop the very strongest and sturdiest trailers, with a high demand on quality, safety and reliability. Variant trailers are innovative.

Tyres - All our toilet trailers use E4 rated tubeless radials. Our tyres are C rated for fuel efficiency, driving in wet conditions and sound rating ' Medium '

Suspension - Our trailers use either suspension system or axle leaf spring systems for greater road stability. These are used in conjunction with either solid steel beam axles or rubber & steel compression axles

Braking - All Our trailers use spread-lever braking and auto reverse within. With the overrun system – the hydraulically dampened overrun control device is made up of six main elements that control the braking whilst moving or parked. . No more need for electric actuators - Our trailers can be used on any vehicle with a tow bar and designed to take the weight capacity.

Safety Skid - The safety skid is an integral feature of the cast housing and protect the overrun and handbrake lever from damage from sleeping policemen, dirt roads, off track and other objects under the trailer.

Night Light - All our trailers come as standard with white reverse light lenses for safe reversing and rear reversing cameras. It also illuminates the area in the direction you want people to be aware of your driving.

Night Safety - Our trailers come with safety white reflectors to the front, amber reflectors to the sides and red to the rear as standard. These are for safety at night when parked and unhitched and in order that the trailers are fully visible from all sides to oncoming vehicles.

Coupling - Whether It's a 2000kg, 2700kg or 3500kg rated hitch, all our hitch/couplings have a locking catch for greater security Whether on a journey or in a parked position. All Trailers have an easy to use independent handbrake system built alongside the extra strong coupling.

Strength - It is vital for you to have absolute confidence in your trailer, particularly when your operating day depends on it too. That's why we develop the very strongest and sturdiest trailers you will find from Europe. Our tried-and-tested welding technology makes us unique in being able to supply transport solutions that have got what it takes.

businesses.description:
Navascues Upholstery is a premium furniture restoration company in Melbourne and has been manufacturing beautiful furniture since 1973. We do furniture repairs and reupholstering at the reasonable prices.

We recover old furniture for both residential and commercial clients. We do furniture upholstery to give you durable, beautiful, and functional pieces. With a variety of colours and fabrics we use, we craft the furniture that looks seamless in your property.

Serving both Eastern and Northern suburbs of Melbourne, we strive to provide premium upholstery services to all our clients. With us, you are sure to get high standard services. Whether you have restoration for small or big furniture, you can trust our team to give you renewed furniture that look fabulous and which elevates your interiors.

Our services:

- Upholstery services

- Antique furniture restoration

- Mid-century and retro furniture restoration

- Frame and timber repairs

- Therapeutic and health care services

- Commercial upholstery services

At Navascues, we follow a transparent process of furniture repairing. When you contact us through phone or email, from providing a free quote to in-home visit to pick up furniture and delivering the final restored product – we take care of every step with utmost detail. Our only aim is to see happy faces of all our clients.

We also provide custom commercial upholstery services so that you can modify the furniture in whichever way you want. We bring old furniture back to life using our modern and durable techniques. For more information, contact us today or send an enquiry form through our website.

businesses.name: Decaf Club
businesses.description:
One of the reasons people opt out of coffee consumption is the caffeine present in it. But what if you can have decaf coffee? In simple words, it comes with caffeine, providing you benefits. If this is what you were looking for, go no further than

Decaf Club. With the decaf coffee in Australia, you’ll get quality sleep, less anxiety and no jittering.

businesses.name: C.D. Dodd Scrap Metal Recyclers
businesses.description:
C.D. Dodd Scrap Metal Recyclers is one of Australia’s leading scrap metal recycling companies, renowned for exemplary safety, efficiency and forward-thinking.

We have plants in Perth and Kalgoorlie, collection services in the south-west and Pilbara, plus a range of mobile plants, allowing us to offer a full service to the most remote parts of WA. We also offer our services nationally and internationally for high value or large scale projects.

Our capabilities extend from industrial/commercial scrap metal and salvage recycling to mine-site demolition/cleanup, and marine salvage. We service a broad local, national and international client base, and boast an impeccable safety record in accordance with all Government and private Acts and Regulations.

businesses.name: Casey Hydroponics
businesses.description:
Keeping in mind the average human consumes approximately 16 kilograms of chemicals a year through food groups, its not hard to realize we all should be growing our own foods therefore knowing exactly what we are being fed. No more excuses of not enough land, as the best way to grow is in artificial light situations indoors.

A Totally controlled enviroment, meaning no pests,bad weather,air borne diseases,moulds,rust,etc. The advantage you get, is to totally control all conditions in your grow room according to what you're growing. An average 1x1mtr hydro room would ,with obvious caring, produce up to seven times the produce in a year comparing to the organic equivalent.

We welcome you to the easy world of hydroponics and trust any feedback, including questions or knowledge you might like to pass on would be much appreciated by email or fax. We cater for hobbyists and commercial growers selling all high quality products not only for value for money but to make hydroponics both fun and affordable to anyone wanting an alternative food source. Any plant can be grown hydroponically.

businesses.name: Progress Fire Co.
businesses.description:
Progress Fire Co. is a full-service fire protection company that aims to take the delivery of fire services projects to the next level. With extensive experience, we recognise the need to raise the bar with the successful delivery of fire services in our industry. With uncompromising attention to detail, focus on client relationship management and experience in the delivery of technically complex and time-pressured projects, Progress Fire Co. is a company that genuinely values integrity, a progressive way of doing things and most of all, an enduring relationship with our clients.

Working in tandem with businesses, leaders and communities all over the region we are deeply passionate about keeping South East Queensland safe from fire risk by designing, implementing and maintaining state of the art fire systems.

Our solutions include gas suppression systems, portable fire extinguishers, and fire blankets, fire detection systems, fire pumps, hydrant and hose reel systems, and automatic fire sprinkler systems.

The services we offer include solution design, installation, certification and maintenance across various projects. From cost planning and project management to testing and commissioning; we will be there every step of the way.

With a proven track record of successful projects and delighted clients, it’s no surprise that Progress Fire Co. is the go-to for many in the building and construction industry. To find out why, please join us as we take a look at what makes us South East Queensland’s most trusted fire services company. Please visit our website at www.progressfire.com.au for more information about our capabilities.

businesses.name: Able Scale
businesses.description:
Able Scale Co. Pty Ltd is a family owned and operated business, which was established in 1970.

Able Scales was founded by Alan Sinclair and commenced its operation as A & B Scale Hire. Initially the business started out to provide short term scale hire. The business then expanded to include scale service, and sales of new equipment including cash registers. Over the years the business has grown steadily, incorporating new products, and technology along the way to keep up to date with market trends and our customers needs.

We have a team of personnel with over 100 years combined experience in the sales, service and hire of scales and cash registers.Able Scales offers choice, quality and experience. Our aim is to provide our customers with the best possible solution to suit their business. By stocking many brands of products we are able to offer our customers more options and keep our pricing competitive. Our showroom and factory is located in Thomastown, Melbourne, and we service Melbourne, regional Victoria and interstate areas

data.name: Best Way Scrap Metal
data.briefDescription:
Located in Kilsyth, Best Way Scrap Metal is Melbourne’s premium company specialising in dealing with all kinds of scrap metal. We are registered second hand dealers and have years of experience in the scrap metal industry. At our metal scrap yard, we accept and process most types of ferrous and non-ferrous material including cast iron, steel, aluminium, copper, brass, lead, nickel, zinc, stainless steel and more. We also offer money for white goods.

Being one of the leading steel and zinc recycling companies in Melbourne, we ensure that all the materials are reused or recycled. This allows us to preserve the environment and enable the metal to be used for different purposes. This also reduces the need for new metals to be created which further minimise the impact on the environment.

businesses.name: Tanknology Pty. Ltd
businesses.description:
Tanknology is an industry’s leading underground fuel tank testing company specialising in providing a prompt, precise and cost-effective tank, line and leak detector testing services with minimum disruption to facility operations.

All our tank testing technologies can be used on virtually any petroleum tank with varying amounts of fuel, from nearly empty to 95% full. We offer comprehensive underground tank testing services including, petrol tank testing, diesel tank testing, fuel tank line test, vapour tank testing, vapour recovery testing, etc.

All our tank testing methods are third-party certified and in accordance with Federal EPA regulations. Moreover, they have been reviewed and approved by the National Work group on Leak Detection.

Our Services:

• Tank, Line and Leak Detector Compliance Testing

• VR2 Vapor Recovery System Testing

• PetroScope™Remote Visual Tank Inspection

• Ethanol Conversion Preparation Services

All our services are performed by the most experienced and trained crew in the industry. We utilise patented testing technology that has been certified for various operating conditions. Combined with our 24x7 emergency response service, we provide our clients with the peace of mind that all their testing needs are taken care of.

For more information on the services offered or to request a FREE price quote, get in touch with us today.

Mission Statement:
To be a world leader in the manufacture and development of Waterjet Cutting Technology. To be a team of dedicated people working in a safe and friendly environment, always trying to improve ourselves and be dedicated to total customer satisfaction. To always lead from the front.
Service – Quality – Reliability
Techni Automation is committed to offering machines of the highest Quality. The Techjet has been designed specifically for the very tough abrasive waterjet environment. It uses a minimum of moving parts, which have been manufactured from corrosion resistant materials. This ensures the Reliability of the Techjet machines for many years after their installation. This is all backed up by highly trained Service Technicians, who will treat any problem you might encounter with the urgency you, the Customer, requires.
What We Do Our team includes experienced engineers, practical technicians, skilled tradesmen and a highly trained sales network, with offices situated in America, Australia, India and Singapore, who can offer a solution that is customised to suit your exact requirements. We take the time to listen and learn exactly what you need and then provide the answer in the form that best suits the way you work and the products you manufacture.
Techni Automation is committed to offering systems of the highest quality. All systems are designed specifically for the very tough Waterjet environment. We use a minimum of moving parts and manufacture from corrosion resistant materials, to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machines for many years with minimum maintenance.
Techniwater jet can also put you in touch with our customers directly who offer waterjet cutting services such as glass cutting, glass drilling, stone cutting, aluminium cutting, rubber cutting, foam cutting, MDF cutting and more

data.description:
Razerline is a family owned business that has been providing Australians with some of the highest quality builds of aluminium boats for over 30 years. Recognised throughout Australia for our award-winning boats, our highly skilled and dedicated team of craftsmen ensure all your needs and requirements are met with each custom build. We offer a wide range of services including boat alterations, boat repairs on insurance work, boat builds, and custom boat builds using alloy or plate.

Choose from a wide range of Razerline boat models including the Olympian, Eclipse, RSV, Commercial crafts, Catamarans, or the WA Classic. Customise your boat with your engine of choice, choosing from brands such as Yamaha, Suzuki, Mariner and Evinrude.

By sourcing the highest quality materials and working closely with boating associations allows us to bring your vision to life whilst maintaining industry standards. We have made it our mission and purpose to provide you with an unparalleled boating experience before and after the sale.

businesses.name: Active Scales
businesses.description:
Together with our extensive experienced staff in the field, we have a fully trained team who work with state-of-the-art equipment to offer products and services of unmatched quality.

We manufacture different types of electronic weighing scales to suit a number of requirements. From scales suitable for measuring 1mg to something that can weigh 50 tonnes, we make them all. At Active Scales, we are able to cater to different businesses such as scrap metal firms, concrete plants, wool sheds, fertilizer businesses, abattoirs, and so on.

Scale servicing is also part of our service package, and we can work on every make and model. If you want to get your industrial, medical or platform scales to function like new, we are your "goto" guy. We offer our services in Melbourne and throughout Victoria. Our team is reputable for being highly efficient, punctual and reliable service providers. Over the years through our hard work, dedication and quality products; we have earned a large clientèle and customers. Instilling their trust in us to do the best for them and their business.

businesses.name: Pallets Sydney
businesses.description:
Pallets Sydney is part of the Well Made Group of companies which manufactures new and supplies used pallets throughout Sydney, and regional NSW, for the safe transporting of your goods.

Our continued focus is on manufacturing quality pallets and supplying affordable used pallets with well made services. Management has over 15 years experience in the pallet industry.

When contacting our pallet company, you will be greeted by an industry professional that has the skills to be able to understand your pallet requirements based on how you plan to store, handle and ship along with what weights are being carried.

We specialize in and are able to supply;

Timber Pallets

All our timber pallets are customized to suit your requirements, ranging from large timber pallets to small timber pallets, and manufactured to your specifics.

Plastic Pallets

Our plastic pallets are in stock, and ready for delivery direct from our Sydney plastic pallet facility. We have a range of sizes, styles and colours that you will be able to choose from.

Custom Pallets

We are able to manufacture what ever type of timber pallet that you require. With over 15 years experience you are in safe hands and can be assured that you will receive a product that is quality built.

Used Pallets

We have a massive range of used pallets in our Sydney facility. All our used pallets have been hand selected to assure you that you don't receive any broken ones.

We look forward to hearing from you and proving that our service, and products, are above par, affordable, and reliable.

businesses.name: Trailer Signs
businesses.description:
Trailer Signs provide a range of products for your roadside advertising needs.

This includes Variable Message Signs (vms) or Electronic Advertising Boards, Billboard Trailer Signs and Mobile Trailer Signs.

We specialise in business advertising but our Variable Message Signs or Variable Message Boards are also suited for traffic control and event management.

Our trailers run 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, are solar powered and comply with Australian Standards.

We have prompt delivery of your advertising trailer. Message changes for the electronic message boards (vms) are programmed remotely by us, whenever you need, even after hours. All our fee's are included in our quote so you will not pay extra for GST, delivery, insurance or message changes.

We have very competitive prices so call us for a quote today.

MercuryPM represents all the brands on this site in a number of key export markets already, however, there are still more distribution opportunities available, particularly with Saber Offroad and Carbon Winch. businesses.name: Chandos Auto’s
businesses.description:
Do you need a service or repair? Or Want to speak to a professional, qualified auto technician? Then choosing Chandos Auto's would be the perfect choice for you. Chandos Auto's was established in 1985 and has been operating for over 25 years we have built a solid reputation for quality and service and have a customer base of over 600 loyal customers.

At Chandos Auto's, our technicians are fully qualified and experienced as motor technicians who have over 70 years of experience so that the level of expertise is ensured. We have been offering auto services like mechanic, car repair, car service, roadworthy certificate, long book service, clutch repairs, brake repairs, air conditioning service and several others. Our technicians have worked on almost every vehicle available, which gives them vast experience and enable quick diagnosis of faults or problems saving our customers' time and money. They enjoy a challenge and any opportunity to help customers with their vehicles. When you choose us, it is ensured that you have invested your hard earned money in the perfect and reliable auto service center and left your vehicle within the right hands.

Although we are based in Cheltenham, but we are not limited to just one place as we offer our service and repairs for residents of Beaumaris, Black Rock, Sandringham, Highett and the surrounding suburbs.

With more than 10 years of experience, All Care Asbestos Removal has developed a reputation for exceptional workmanship and guaranteed customer satisfaction. We are well equipped with the state-of-art equipment and technologies necessary to detect and remove all traces of the asbestos from the old buildings.

Our team of fully licensed and insured specialist for providing asbestos removal service that is second to none. By providing the highly efficient asbestos inspection, asbestos testing and asbestos disposal, we are the one stop shop for the asbestos removal service in Melbourne. Our team will thoroughly inspect the property to determine the presence of potential asbestos materials and formulate tailored strategies accordingly.

We provide asbestos removal in areas included but not limited to Melbourne eastern suburbs, Mornington Peninsula, Mornington and Frankston.

To inquire more about our asbestos removal service or for a free price quote, feel free to give us a call or send us the inquiry.

"Located in Mascot close to Sydney Airport, Fusion Locksmiths have fully equipped vans on the road all across Sydney. This allows us to get to most locations within 15-60 minutes. We are also available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. That's right, Fusion Locksmiths are ready for any emergency lockout situation.

A family run business we believe in providing great service at affordable prices. Using only quality, reliable and leading brands we do things right the first time to ensure your home or business property remains secure. Check out our many 5 star reviews on Google, True Local, Facebook and more review sites.

businesses.name: SEO Sydney Solutions
businesses.description:
"Are you looking to grow your business? Have you exhausted your referral network and are in need of a steady stream of fresh new business? We are ready to help you.

Using our expert knowledge of search engine optimisation, we work closely with our clients to understand their business goals. We then create customised strategies to ensure your website is setup to help you reach your goals.

Did you know there are thousands of searches performed every month on Google from people looking for your services? Over 75% of these people never click past the first page results. And the higher up you rank, the more people will click through to your website.

Not only does your website need to rank at the top of Google to get the most exposure for your business, but your website also needs to be optimised for conversions. This allows you to convert more site visitors into actual paying customers for your business. This is exactly what SEO Sydney Solutions does.

We take websites to the top of Google for search terms your potential customers are using when looking for your services. We then optimise your website for conversions. This is turn provides a great user experience for your customers which further builds your SEO rankings.

Based in Sydney we also service greater NSW and other states and regions in Australia. Get in contact with us today for a no obligation free consultation and strategy session. Let's take your business forward for a successful future."

businesses.name: Elan Linen
businesses.description:
Elan Linen is a family-run business with the core family values - simple as putting our people foremost. Our company's foundation is laid around the strong associations we have with our people - not only our customers, who we care & value above all, our suppliers who have strengthened us over the time but every member of our team who's committed to make it a success story.

We aspire to become one of Australia’s leading specialist retailer of Manchester and homewares by providing the most elegant and stylish bedding products from world renowned brands, delivered right to your door step and without the unnecessary mark ups. With over three decades of retail experience, we are renowned for combining superior quality service with exceptional products. We have provided bed linen to thousands of satisfied customers worldwide and our business is expanding exponentially. With a tradition of quality, elegance and customer centricity, we aim to reach out to every corner of this planet and serve customers.

You’re not like everyone else, so why should your bedroom look the same as everyone? We offer diversity in design reaching to our audience of all ages, personalities, seasons and tastes. From dazzling quilt covers and matching pillowcases, to comfortable bedspreads and warm quilts, we have all your bedding needs covered. We ensure the best for you by strict quality checks, choosing the best materials, designs and customer support team. You require quality, we deliver it passionately. You require variety; we offer a whole world of it. You require elegance, we sell aesthetic designs. So, style up your home with spring, summer and winter collections from Elan Linen at unbelievably low prices. Everything you want is just a click away.

We take pride in ourselves to have a tradition of exceptional customer service, from helping you pick the right product, all the way through managing your order until delivered and even after sales service. Feel free to get in touch with our friendly staff if you would like to enquire anything about our company/services or if you face any difficulty in using our website.

Shop with confidence with the peace of mind that all transactions are processed by Visa or Mastercard through most reliable PayPal gateway.

businesses.name: Aspect Furniture Systems
businesses.description:
Our team are passionate about providing clients with furniture solutions that deliver across a range of factors:

Creating a vibrant and inspiring workplace for staff that is also highly functional

International quality design that is manufactured locally and tailored to our local market demands

Providing flexible furniture that will adapt to the changing requirements of the business over a guaranteed service life of 10 years plus

Ensuring that the work environment meets the ergonomic requirements of users

In a changing world where many manufacturers have opted to shift production off-shore, Aspect remains committed to local production. Through clever design and world class manufacturing facilities Aspect remains as competitive as ever and can provide clients with the benefits of local manufacture; faster delivery, design flexibility, quality assurance and genuine environmental credentials.

Extensive infrastructure throughout Australasia means Aspect can provide multi-nationals with a consistent furniture solution across their Asia Pacific operations. In addition to Australia and NZ, Aspect has delivered successful furniture fitouts in locations such as Papua New Guinea, Noumea, San Francisco and Singapore.

Perhaps most importantly, Aspect takes a long term view of our client relationships. We partner with our clients, seeking to understand their individual needs, providing the best value solution and then backing this up with reliable and responsive service.

businesses.name: Fremantle Timber Traders
businesses.description:
Recycled Timber is readily available at our Fremantle Warehouse, in all shapes, sizes and forms - from Hardwood Slabs, Posts, Beams, Bush Poles, Gluts, Wharf Timber, Railway Sleepers, Stair Treads, Recycled Timber, Recycled Flooring to Re-milled Decking and more!

This is the result of years of hard work to salvage and recycle hardwood timber with the least possible damage, reclaiming wood that was originally milled between 50 – 150 years ago which has been dried with age, rather than kiln-dried.

This early timber is vastly superior in quality, compared with recently milled timber, as the colour, grain and texture of the wood has come about naturally over time. The character and patina simply cannot be matched.

businesses.name: Zepel Fabrics
businesses.description:
Since 1978 Zepel Fabrics have supplied industry-leading designer fabric solutions for Upholstery, Furnishings, Wallpaper, Curtains and more.

Our highly experienced staff personally spend the time it takes to source only the highest quality fabrics from European designers and mills, so that Australian hotels, shopping centres, home designers and businesses of all kinds can offer an experience like no other. Made available for wholesale, we are a trusted supplier of exclusive fabric requirements for large-scale interior projects Australia-wide. All of our fabrics meet Australian and international standards through vigorous testing and quality certifications.

We are exclusive Australian providers of world-renown brands including FibreGuard, FR-One, UV Pro (Belgium), Casamance (France), Christian Fischbacher (Switzerland) and more.

We welcome you to explore our massive range of the latest options and speak to our friendly staff about your requirements.
