Established in 1974, Mazspares Auto Service is one of the renowned Mazda spare parts providers and are specialized as Mazda car wreckers in Melbourne. Mazspares Auto Service is a one stop shop for efficient, reliable and affordable automobile spare parts for your automobiles.

We deal with a wide range of Mazda and Ford commercials that includes Bravo, Tribute, Mazda BT50 Parts, E Series, Ford Ranger Parts, Courier, Escape and Econovan. Besides this, we also stock a large inventory of pre-owned and recycled Mazda auto parts for passenger vehicles that includes Mazda 6 and Mazda 3 parts along with the Mazda SUV range (CX5 CX7 CX9).

After Prakash Raniga, the Principal of the firm joined in 1998, the firm was renamed as RRR Lawyers - Rossi, Ryan and Raniga. We pride in offering the most practical legal advice and a reliable legal solution that puts our client’s interest first. Even during unplanned situations, our highly skilled lawyers provide sound legal advice by communicating effectively on paper with everyone involved in the case.

Our Featured Services:

1) Family Lawyers

2) Divorce Lawyers

3) Criminal Lawyers

4) Construction Lawyers

6) Business Lawyers

7) Commercial Lawyers

8) Property Lawyers

Our lawyers have an extensive experience of over 30 years serving Australian businesses, private clients and foreign-owned companies. businesses.name: Handcrafted Catering
businesses.description:
Handcrafted Catering is the premier catering company in Melbourne. Owing to years of experience and expertise, we specialize in boutique corporate catering, intimate dinners and exclusive events. We pride on creating every morsel from scratch and by hand, using the absolute essentials to ensure our every food particle is loaded with flavour.

We bake our own bread, develop our own sauces and create our own stock. Our attention to detail, commitment to quality and focus on the hand-made distinction sets us apart from our competitors.

We have an extensive range of catering options including banquet, formal dining, casual dining, barbecue, canapes, drinks and many more. We can tailor our menu to suit any taste dietary requirement and budget. Our buffet catering options are ideal for family get-togethers, simple light meals or lavish dinner parties

Event Catering

Party Catering

businesses.name: Casey Tours
businesses.description: In 1973, Founder Bryan Casey started Casey Adventure Tours with a single 8 seater Volkswagen Kombi Van and a passion for touring the remote areas of Australia. Today we are known as Casey Tours, and operate a large fleet of coaches, showcasing a variety of tours from single day tours within Western Australia to extended tours through some of Australia’s most remote and beautiful regions. With more than 40 years of experience on the road, we have the best knowledge to run amazing, comfortable and safe tours throughout Australia. Casey Tours makes use of their own vehicles and drivers employed by us, we don’t and never will, hire drivers from other operators to drive our passengers. In a similar manner, we arrange all accommodation, attractions and meals directly. To ensure the highest quality we take responsibility for all areas of the passenger’s touring experience.

businesses.name: Dapple Landscape Design
businesses.description:
Transforming concept into reality, Dapple Landscape Design can bring your dream garden to life. With proven strategies and streamlined methodologies, Dapple Landscape Design takes the stress and hassle out of designing unique outdoor environments and submitting plans to local councils. Offering a complete suite of garden design services, Dapple Landscape Design delivers spectacular results each and every time.

Based in the Western Suburbs of Sydney, Julian Saw and the Dapple Landscape Design team operate throughout the Greater Sydney region consulting with private clients and the development industry. By taking a personal interest in each project, Julian approaches each landscape with a passion.

From the initial consultation and discussion, Julian will take the time to envisage your dream landscape. Following an established design process, the team will then provide you with a concept and design that can be refined and perfected. As each project has unique requirements, the Dapple Landscape Design team will adapt their services to ensure a smooth workflow. The team offers a range of design packages to best suit your needs and budget. To discuss which package would best suit your project, please don’t hesitate in contacting Julian by phone today.

Why Choose Dapple Landscape Design?

Tailor-made designs

Locally owned and operated

Highly recommended

No job too big or small

Industry experts

Complete range of services

Competitive rates

Dapple Landscape Design - Your Local Sydney Landscape Designer

With a unique understanding of the local flora and fauna of your community, the team at Dapple Landscape Design can create landscapes that will thrive in your local environment.

Services:

DA/CDC/Developer Approval Landscape Plan - From $400

DA/CDC Landscape Plan and On-site Consultation - From $700

Backyard Concept Design Package - From $800

Upscale Landscape Design Package - From $2000

3D Models - From $500

Don’t settle for mediocre design and service. Dapple Landscape Design offers class-leading services that will surpass even the highest expectations. Over the last few years, Dapple Landscape Design has created some of the most stunning landscapes and boutique gardens in the Greater Sydney region. If you want to upgrade your outdoor lifestyle and improve the value of your property, engaging the services of Dapple Landscape Design is the right move.

Whether you are renovating your backyard, developing plans for a new commercial facility or managing the landscaping for a body corporate, Dapple Landscape Design provides affordable services with exceptional results.

Specialist garden design using smart methods and creative processes. Friendly service and cost-effective packages.

Come and visit the Dapple Landscape Design website to explore some of the recent projects the team has completed. To discuss your project with the principal landscape architect, contact Dapple Landscape Design on 0437 043 112.

businesses.description:
Based in Northern Melbourne Campbellfield, European Prestige Car Care is one of the most renowned European car specialists. With a team of highly skilled and experienced mechanics in Somerton, we are the one stop destination for all the car repair and car service needs. We provide a wide range of automotive service, including roadworthy certificate, auto air conditioning service, brake repair, clutch repair and log book service.

No matter what make and model the car is, we can service all the European cars specialising in Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Peugeot, Saab, Volvo and Volkswagen. With a workshop well-equipped with state-of-art tools and equipments, we can diagnose any issues in the cars very efficiently.

We are the registered member of VACC. We can inspect and provide roadworthy certificate on the same day itself. We also provide log book service as per manufacturer’s specifications and without voiding the car’s warranty.

We service in area included but not limited to Somerton, Greenvale, Wallan, Dorren, Epping and surrounding suburbs.

To book the car appointment or for an obligation free price quote, call 03 9357 7075

Delight, appropriateness, elegance and economy are the main qualities that you will see in our work. data.name: The Traffic Plans Company
data.briefDescription:
The Traffic Plans Company commenced trading in June 2014 and was founded by two experienced Construction Industry professionals who identified a market for reasonably-priced, highly detailed Traffic Management Plans for the road building, road maintenance, construction industry and local government.

The Traffic Plans Company is a trusted, reliable and efficient supplier of high quality, fully compliant Traffic Management Plans to a diverse range of clientele based throughout Victoria. Working closely with Vic Roads, State and Local government authorities and departments, including several public and private companies, our company provides Traffic Management Plans that help ensure that the safety of workers, motorists and pedestrians in and around work sites is maintained at all times.

The Company has Pre-Qualification status with Vic Roads, and strictly adheres to the various Guides, Codes of Practice, Australian Standards and Road Management Act and Regulations,This commitment is backed by a management team which focuses on continuous improvement and investment in various leading edge technologies including; quality management systems, aerial mapping and plan-drafting software, and employee training to provide the highest levels of quality and service.

We provide:

-Development and drafting of Traffic Management Plans designed to manage risks and provide safe work environments for workers, pedestrians, motorists and cyclists, whilst minimising disruption to traffic flow through a wide range of work sites;

-The obtaining of authorisation(s) from Vic Roads and/or Local government and Councils to allow the implementation of professional traffic management strategies

-An Audit capability with a Qualified Senior Road Safety Auditor; and

-Assistance with meeting your WHS obligations to provide the safest possible work environment for staff, contractors and the general public

Thus the next time you need a Traffic Management company, you now know whom to call

data.name: Job Fit
data.briefDescription:
Job Fit is a leading provider of workplace health and safety courses & services within Victoria. We offer a range of services including: back safety training, office ergonomics, workplace warm up programs, wellness programs, risk assessments, task analysis and noise assessments. Implementing Job Fit’s programs and services will help to ensure that your workplace is compliant with current regulations set out in the 2004 OH&S Act.

Our skilled team of OH&S professionals are able to carry out detailed evaluations including workplace ergonomics, task assessments, risk assessments and noise surveys. After analyzing the information we gather we will compile extensive reports to provide our clients with the information they need to implement change.

Our occupational health and safety training programs aim to not only teach people good manual handling practices but also promote workplace health and happiness. Our range of programs include: ergonomic workstation setup workshops, ‘Stretch Into Action’ and ‘Keep Well, Work Safe, Live Longer’ workshops, and a variety of manual handling training. We also provide high quality client specific training videos. These video’s use the client’s logo, equipment, uniforms and employees within the video to get a completely customized and job specific training video.

businesses.name: Sheridan’s Badges & Engraving
businesses.description:
Located in Jolimont (Perth), Western Australia, Sheridan’s supplies a comprehensive range of badges, lapel pins, plaques, medals, medallions, personalised keyrings, trophies and specialty items to local and national government agencies, health organisations, schools, sports clubs, associations and business organisations.

Perhaps unsurprisingly, much of this work requires highly technical engraving skills. Skills we at Sheridan’s sometimes take for granted after over a century of experience making well-crafted badges and engravings for the people of Perth and throughout Western Australia. We have the equipment to not only make highly detailed embossing dies but to engrave the end product, and the artisanal skills to create beautiful end products, and to manufacture very detailed schematic boards, and electrical and dashboard panels.

businesses.name: Australian Solar Designs Pty Ltd
businesses.address: Suite 1, Level 1, 65 Doody Street, Alexandria, NSW 2015
businesses.description:
Australian Solar Designs Pty Ltd (ASD) was established in 2009 and is run by a team of industry professionals with vast solar experience and a passion for contributing to Australia’s Clean Energy Future. ASD is part of the National Solar Energy Group with a strong Balance Sheet and impressive Financial Accounts.

ASD is focused on providing cost-effective, optimized solar solutions to clients ranging from small commercial businesses to the largest commercial, industrial and government organizations across Australia.

In 2009 the Solar Industry was booming with the value of the Government incentives at its highest. ASD has seen many industry highs and lows and has survived Feed-in Tariff changes and rebate decreases and remains a strong market player.

In this time, ASD has been selected as a preferred supplier by many companies and government organizations including the ACT Government.

To date, ASD has completed over 4,000 Solar Photovoltaic installations including multiple large commercial installations across the country. ASD was selected in 2014 as the exclusive installer for Solar PV systems under the ACT Solar School Program (a Government Grant Program). Through this program, ASD installed and commissioned solar PV Systems on 22 schools throughout the ACT.

ASD has installed commercial-scale solar systems on numerous NSW Health Hospitals, Schools, Councils, Aged Care providers, Hotels and commercial and industrial premises.

THROUGH GROWTH AND DEMAND, ASD IS NOW HEAVILY BASED IN NSW, VIC, ACT, AND QLD, AND OUR SERVICES EXTEND AUSTRALIA WIDE.

businesses.name: AQWA
businesses.description:
AQWA is a private company dedicated to educating the public on the marine life of Western Australia from the cold waters of the southern ocean to the coral reefs the far north. Owned and operated by Coral World International, AQWA is passionate about marine education, conservation and rehabilitation through extensive education programs for schools and rehabilitation programs for injured marine animals.

The company also provides exhibits that provide a window to the vast and prolific communities that exist on the sea floors. AQWA's goal is to inspire respect for marine life while also raising awareness of the critical importance of the ocean in our world.

businesses.name: Korex
businesses.description:
Established in 2010, Korex (formerly Hazrem) is a highly experienced, reputable and compliant asbestos removal business operating throughout Melbourne and Victoria.

Korex specialises in soil remediation, removing asbestos in soil on-site thus reducing time and cost.

At Korex we implement a methodical process for every job to ensure the best outcome for all parties. The risks are often clearly understood however, the opportunities are often found when we bring innovative solutions to our clients by realising efficiencies.

Korex is committed to finding sustainable solutions to benefit clients and the community, ensuring we remove the risk of further contamination and eliminate hazard to both people and the environment.

We maintain a good relationship with Worksafe and the EPA and support continual industry improvement through membership of the Demolition Contractor’s Association and Australian Land and Groundwater Association where we sit on the board and Asbestos Committee respectively.

The team at Korex implement a comprehensive, systematic method of asbestos soil removal that they have had patented in Australia thus demonstrating their level of professionalism and commitment to sustainable work practices.

data.name: Korex
data.briefDescription:
Operating throughout Melbourne and Victoria, Korex unrestricted Class A license allows the team to manage the full spectrum of risk issues on every site, covering safety and environment issues as well as our client’s operational, reputational and communications risks.

Our integrated management system is independently audited and allows for the client’s own risk issues to be included and customised for each project.

businesses.name: PumpEng
businesses.description: PumpEng® is an Australian owned and operated business with a proud history of manufacturing and supplying submersible pumps to the underground and surface mining sector. We specialise in tough submersible pumps for use in mining, construction and industrial dewatering. We have submersible pumps that can manage tramp, shotcrete fibre, slurry, dirty water and high-head requirements. Our well-known Raptor® and JetGuard® pumps and parts are Australian designed and manufactured. We formed PumpEng® to improve the design of mass produced pump components for Australian operating conditions. We consulted with Australian maintenance and mining staff and used our own expertise gained through our long association with the mining industry. We manufacture in small batch runs using special materials to allow for quick design changes so we can reduce operating and maintenance costs through innovative design. Our results and long list of satisfied clients are testimony to this.

businesses.name: Koalakrane Franchise
businesses.address: 14 Ardena Court, Bentleigh East, Victoria, 3165, Australia
businesses.description: Koalakrane is a very special franchise because we are the only established amusement crane machine franchise in the world. We started way back in 2000 and have been going strong ever since. So how did it all start? Founder Cliff Hopkins used to be a sales manager for his brother’s company, selling teddy bears to gift shops, florists and toy stores. Cliff was looking for a business idea using soft toys and thought about crane machines. He imported one machine and put it outside a shop in Auckland, sharing revenue with the owner. It went very well and it all grew from there. To grow the operation Cliff organized people all round the country to buy businesses that run crane machines, while he organized soft toys and later chocolates for them. The synergy between organizer and operator became obvious and the franchise system Kiwikrane was born. With business partner Paul Hydes joining in to assist, by 2006 Kiwikrane had completely covered New Zealand with crane machines.

businesses.name: Search Domination
businesses.description:
As a local Caloundra SEO agency we present customers with varying costings for different sized enterprises. Search engine optimisation is NOT equal for all organisations, and Search Domination knows that each business must develop marketing strategies that are contextualised for that individual company, not a mass production that lacks distinguishing characteristics.

SEO is a very tactical affair that involves an extremely systematic and methodical approach. Your website’s keyword optimisation is a vital component of how search engine spiders grade your web site and how successfully the searcher will discover you via a keyword phrase search. At Search Domination, we will initially examine your content, then optimise your collection of keyword phrases, and propose alternate or additional ones to enhance your page rank.

At Search Domination we will also provide you with a comprehensive analysis report highlighting how the most appropriate keywords will increase traffic. It is critical we understand your business strategy and the most appropriate keywords to chase so that the campaign is likely to succeed.

businesses.name: Ekologix Australia Pty Ltd
businesses.address: Unit 1, 20-26 Sabre Drive, Port Melbourne, VIC 3207
businesses.description:
Established in 2009, Ekodeck is an Australian-owned company with over 60 years’ experience in the timber and building industry. We manufacture and supply composite outdoor living products specially designed for Australia’s harsh climate.

We provide sustainable and durable alternatives to timber decking and screening to thousands of homes and businesses all over Australia.

Ekodeck is a composite material made from reclaimed and recycled timber and plastic. It looks and feels like natural timber but does not require oiling or painting and is naturally weather resistant. Ekodeck products are also termite, rot and mould resistant.

Hardwearing and durable, our products are family safe and come with the peace of mind and convenience of being available exclusively through Bunnings nation-wide.

We pride ourselves on providing an environmentally friendly product that delivers architecturally inspired looks with unrivalled durability.

businesses.name: Carbon Filtration Solutions
businesses.description:
Carbon Filtration Solutions Pty Ltd is the country’s leading supplier of activated carbon filtration systems. We have a wide variety of activated carbon filtration products, including the PureAir Vapour - Odour Filter that has been developed as a budget-friendly means of controlling toxic vapours and odours in an industrial area. Its most common applications are for tank vent odour control and processing of gases.

Other products that we have are the ALC 50 water filtration systems, active carbon air filters, activated carbon odour vent filter, carbon saturation indicators, bag filters and housing, and the PureAir 100 Vapour - Odour.

Interested in these products? Get in touch with us at sales@carbonfiltrationsolutions.com.au. or Phone: 0408880519.

It is primarily a remedial bodywork and massage service with a focus on emotional anatomy and the psycho-emotional energy that can be held within the body. This energy can be reflected within the body’s shape and form, tissues, structure, movement and gait. It can present as misalignments of posture, body armouring, desensitised areas of tissue, tension, stiffness, and/or pain within the body.

From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. No less exceptional is the hotel’s easy access to the city’s myriad attractions and landmarks, such as Prince’s Square Medical Centre, St. John’s Anglicare Cathedral, (General Hospital), Gorge, Penny Royal, café…
data.description:
The facilities and services provided by Centennial Hotel ensure a pleasant stay for guests. Wi-Fi in public areas, car park, family room, smoking areas are just a few of the facilities that set Centennial Hotel apart from other hotels in the city.

The hotel features 11 beautifully appointed guest rooms, all rooms include television LCD/plasma screen, non-smoking rooms, tea/coffee making facilities, heating, desk, extra-long beds (> 2 meters). Besides, the hotel's host of recreational offerings ensures you have plenty to do during your stay. Superb facilities and an excellent location make the Centennial Hotel the perfect base from which to enjoy your stay in Launceston.

Centennial Hotel is a 5-minute drive from Launceston city center and Launceston Court. Launceston Centennial Hotel is a 2-minute walk from the local Coles Supermarket. It is within a 13-minute drive from Cataract Gorge Reserve and Launceston Airport.

Our used Volvo parts and Volvo construction equipment parts are of high quality, competitively priced and is a great alternative to genuine Volvo replacement parts.

Our used construction equipment for sale service offers you to choose from a wide range of wheel loaders, dozers and off highway trucks. data.name: Valley Precise Global
data.briefDescription:
Quite simply the fastest method to repair a pipe under pressure. The VPG Rapid Response Clamp was engineered to contain leakage from damaged pipework under pressure faster, with less potential for harm to the operator that all competitive systems on the market. Developed originally for use in combat vessels, the Pipe Repair Technology is now available in three variants :

MILSPEC – up to pressures of 300 PSI ( 20 Bar )

COMMERCIAL – up to pressures of 150 PSI ( 10 Bar )

HP 40 – up to pressures of 600 PSI ( 40 Bar )

The Clamp has application across a variety of industries including energy, oil and gas, mining, refining, aviation, maritime, chemical and food industries.

The VPG Rapid Response Clamp offers :

* Increased personnel and asset survivability.

* Reduction in potential environmental damage

* Improved protection of assets

* Improved ability to maintain production

* Lower Total Cost of Ownership

* Improved Downtime of the Operation

businesses.name: Weld East Fabricators
businesses.description:
GENERAL & HEAVY FABRICATION

We offer a wide range of fabrication services to our customers, including HD robotic CNC plasma cutting, CNC bending and rolling, welding, assembly, design, certification, finishing, sandblasting, repair, refurbishment, and steel supply. Our expert fabricators are capable of working with a variety of steel grades of varying hardness levels.

Low Carbon (Mild Steel) Plate Grade 250, 350

High Carbon steel plate

Steel sheet 1mm and up

Boiler Plate, Duraflex K1042, Bisalloy 80, 400, 500

Stainless steel grades 316 and 304

Aluminium

WELDING

Welding is the process of fusing materials such as metals in order to seamlessly join them. Our professional and qualified fabricators at Weld East are fully-trained and compliant with the following welding processes:

MIG (Metal Inert Gas) - GMAW (Gas Metal Arc Welding)

Arc Welding - SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding)

TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) - GTAW (Gas Tungsten Arc Welding)

FCAW (Flux Cored Arc Welding)

Our quality assurance system incorporates a series of quality gates to ensure high quality performance is maintained at every stage of fabrication.

You can rely on us to provide any supporting documentation required including weld procedure specification (WPS), concept drawings, and engineering certification.

LASER / PLASMA CUTTING

Plasma Cutting is a process used to cut steel using a plasma torch, which uses a powerful electric arc to create plasma out of a blast of ordinary dried air to vaporise, or literally ‘plasmatise’ the metal that is being cut. Our robotic CNC Plasma Cutter is designed to provide excellent cutting and bevelling performance on material up to 25mm thick. Our machine is fully robotic and able to cut from a CAM file generated from AutoCAD files. Our machine is fully capable of processing both small and large orders in short time frames.

PRESSING & FOLDING

Weld East Fabricators is proud to deliver a full range of manufacturing services on-site. Our Perth fabrication workshop is equipped with press brakes in a range of sizes for plate pressing and folding. The press brake CNC controls allow us to save your parts to our database making repeat orders simple and cost effective for batch produced parts. Our largest press is built to handle up to 25mm thickness and in sizes up to 3m x 5m.

PAINTING & FINISHING

Our Perth fabrication workshop is fully equipped with industrial spray painting facilities. We have the equipment and experience to give your project whatever finish you require including 2-Pack, priming, and top coats.

data.name: Ace Filters
data.briefDescription:
Established in 1984, Ace Filters are renowned manufacturers and suppliers of commercial and industrial filtration products. With more than 30 years of experience, we are renowned in the industry for our quality system design, product manufacturing, expert advice and personalised pre-sales and after-sales service.

Being the leading infrared thermometer, deep fryer filter and cooking oil filter machine suppliers in Australia, we only deal with the industry’s leading raw material suppliers and are proud of our extensive customer list including many leading names in the industry.

As a specialist filtration products manufacturer, we offer the flexibility to create custom-made products that meet our client’s diverse needs.

Our Products:

• Infrared food thermometer

• Dust Filters: Industrial dust collector, fume filter, wood dust filter and cement dust filter

• Industrial trolley cover and commercial food trolley covers

• Oil filter machine including cooking oil filter machine, deep fryer oil filter, bag filter, cooking oil filter paper

All our food grade frying oil filters in Australia meet or exceed FA standards, FDA CFR 176/180 Section 21.

To download our product catalogue visit our website. Also, for any product inquiry or for an obligation free price quote, feel free to get in touch with us at our registered number.

businesses.name: Sureshade Aluminium Venetian Blinds
businesses.description:
SURE SHADE ® Basic 100F:

The blind slat profile SURE SHADE ® Basic 100F is 100mm wide and can only be controlled by ladder braid and has flexibility of movement under wind load or use. This excessive flexibility of the blind slat has a significant drawback as the slat can either rotate around the ladder string or distort and flatten against the glazing in the wind causing excessive instability, movement, noise and block out of light.

SURE SHADE ® Basic 80C L1 W:

The SURE SHADE ® Basic 80C L1 W slat profile is 80mm wide and is of a more robust construction than the 100F, due to a rolled edge, and can be manufactured to be more wind stable as compared to the 100F. However ladder braid 80C slat construction, under wind loading, will still attempt to rotate around the ladder string.

businesses.description:
STX Technology has an extensive range of Stainless Steel Harsh Environment Touch Computers, Stainless Steel Touch Monitors and Touch Monitors with an extender option. Proven in a wide range of different industries in Australia and around the world. Applications include Meat, Fish and Food Production, Dairy, Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry and Automation. STX Technology products have a large number of configuration options to meet virtually any requirement.

Manufactured in 304 or 316 stainless steel, STX Technology's rugged touch products have the option of tough Resistive Touch Screen or Projective Capacitive Touch Screen, different power input options, IP67 rated connectors and flexibility to meet most requirements, including screen sizes from 8 inch through to 100 inch, and mounting options to suit most locations.

Established in 2002, STX Technology has a vast amount of experience in Harsh Environment Touch Computing and have a solution to endure most harsh and rugged environments. The STX Technology's range is supported by a highly experienced local technical service team.

data.briefDescription:
As the biggest manufacturer of chemical pigments and solvent dyes of South China, Xinghua Pigments Group, namely Shenzhen Xinghua Pigment Masterbatch Co.,Ltd., was established in Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, China in 1994, and has had over 20-year professional experience in the fields of dyes and pigments, masterbatch, new plastic materials, modified and synthetic resins. Since it was established, it has been holding the following values as its core corporate and business values: BUSINESS-ORIENTATION, SERVICE-ORIENTATION, BRAND-ORIENTATION AND COOPERATION-ORIENTATION. Currently, Xinghua Pigments Group has developed into an international group which is integrated with product manufacturing and trading. And it has eight domestic branches, one professional overseas branch, one purchased center located in Hongkong and two manufacturing bases, which makes it earn the business and cooperations from all over the world.

Besides, Xinghua Pigments Group is also the core partners and/or agents of global chemical giants such as CABOT, BASF, HUNSTMAN (VENATOR), CLARIANT, DIC and LANXESS.

Xinghua Pigments Group has been devoting itself to drive its own development by realizing its customers’ values, to realize its positive, healthy and sustainable developments by achieving its industry values and social values.

- Transport, handle and store chemicals safely

- Assess, plan & co-ordinate weed/pest control activities

- Prepare & calibrate equipment.

- Conduct site hazard identification & risk assessment for weed/pest control

- Monitor the effectiveness of controls & any collateral damage.

- Drift Management

data.name: Outdoor Instant Shelters
data.briefDescription:
Outdoor Instant Shelters, an Australian owned and operated instant marquees company offer the high quality and durable pop-up marquee and pop up gazebos available in Melbourne, Sydney, Perth and Brisbane. With more than 15 years of industry experience, our marquee tents are made using highest quality material and design standards. Our marquee gazebo is available in four different sizes starting from 3m*3m up to 8m*4m. Our highly durable strong and light-weight marquees for sale are manufactured using the high quality and commercial grade aluminum and are designed to withstand the harsh Australian climate.

Our quality promotional printed marquees can be branded and customised with printing of logos and images. We provide single color printing of your school/club/business name on the roof valance of our portable gazebos at a price as low as $150 and turnaround time as fast as 24 hours. We do the screen-printing in-house and are able to provide with the best quality branded marquee and canopy outdoor that will act as a great tool for building brand recognition.

For more information on our service, visit our website or for a free price quote, give us a call 1300 939 629.

businesses.name: Bird Proofing Australia
businesses.description:
Bird proofing Australia provides a specialist bird netting solution for commercial and industrial buildings, warehouses, sheds, undercover areas including schools, airports, hangers stores and outdoor structures. The netting can barely be seen and is a permanent solution to prevent birds sitting or nesting.

Bird dropping is a health and safety risk for anything that they fall on. So it makes sense to install a permanent bird control mesh netting solution that is not harmful to the birds.

We supply and install the bird-proof netting. Our warranties include 10 year years on the net and 7 years on workmanship. We look forward to helping solve your bird problem.

businesses.name: McCrae Conveyancing
businesses.description:
Buying Property

Buying a home is one of the most stressful and expensive things you will ever do. It’s vital that you seek legal advice from someone experienced in property law and who knows the area.

Once you’ve made the decision to sell your property, one of the first tasks is to have the Contract for Sale of Land drawn up.

The contract will include not only the legal terms and conditions of sale, but will also specify what items are included or excluded from the sale, and any other special requirements you might have like a longer or shorter settlement than usual, or perhaps that the contract be conditional upon another contract for you to buy your next property.

businesses.name: Inspect it First
businesses.description:
Inspect It takes pride in being able to offer same day or next pre purchase building and pest home inspection. Inspect It First – your local pre purchase inspectors can deliver the final inspection report for your home within 2 hours of completing the inspection.

Dale is a builder having completed his carpenter & joiner apprenticeship in 1979, working for AVJennings, HF Yunkin, Boral and Gunns Timber. He’s studies include Workplace Law and Accounting. Dale has been the president of the Australian Society of Building Consultants, 2013-2015 and is also the organiser of the 3D Users Australia and New Zealand, a group of inspectors who use electronic systems to deliver inspection reports. Under the 3D Users Australia and New Zealand brand Dale provides inspector training and is the distributor of 3D Inspection System, one of the worlds leading inspection reporting software companies.
categories: Automotive & Electrical , Occupational Hygiene and Safety , Property Services

businesses.name: KaRaTec Power Supplies Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
A proud Australian owned and operated company; KaRaTec is a dedicated and dynamic engineering business providing innovative and rugged power conversion equipment to Australian Industry.

Established in 1997 KaRaTec prides itself on delivering Australian made power conversion equipment that is durable, high quality and long lasting. We provide full ongoing support solutions to all of our clients and offer repairs and reconditions services as well.

Over the years KaRaTec has developed a comprehensive range of standard DC/DC converters and AC/DC converters/UPS for various industries. In additional, KaRaTec has also developed, in conjunction with our clients, an extensive range of custom power conversion equipment and peripherals.

Our business motto is “Total Customer Service.” This means we provide reliable products, swift delivery and unequaled support and service. In cooperation with our clients, we provide clear and effective communication to ensure that your needs are met by our experienced manufacturing team.

A commitment to only using the best materials, stringent quality control and rigorous testing make KaRaTec an industry leader in custom power conversion equipment.

KaRaTec is NOT an importer, all our power products and equipment are manufactured in Australia. We have every confidence in our products that we back them up with a 3 years warranty.

businesses.name: Shou Sumiyaki
businesses.description:
Shou Sumiyaki is one of the best Japanese barbecue restaurant in Melbourne

CBD, where fresh meat, seafood, and vegetables are cooked directly over the

charcoal flame.

 

Shou Sumiyaki introduces Japan's latest conceptual technology of 'smokeless

charcoal griller' in Australia, the technology used redirects the smoke

underneath, allowing a more comfortable smoke-free Japanese style barbecue

experience to the visitors.

 

Fresh ingredients are essential for Sumiyaki, only the freshest produce are

selected, we only serve finest Japanese Kobe Wagyu beef, ranging from short

ribs and tenderloin to scotch fillet, all sliced and cut to perfection. The

pork is a special breed of black hair pig, Kurobuta pork from Japan. Shou

Sumiyaki also offers freshest seafood delivered from the local fish market.

Your experience is enhanced by the friendly, personalized and professional

service and best for corporate function venues.

 

They also have an extensive drink menu, from Japanese sake, Umeshu, shochu,

local and imported beer and refreshing cocktails. Shou Sumiyaki is one of

the best Japanese BBQ in Melbourne.

data.name: Shou Sumiyaki
data.briefDescription: In the heart of China Town is Shou Sumiyaki, introducing diners to the other side of Japanese cuisine. Sumiyaki dining is based on a Japanese ‘smokeless charcoal grill’, where customers can barbecue their own meats for an enjoyable dining experience. Wagyu beef is a speciality at Shou, but there is also a range of sashimi and seafood, as well as an extensive range of Sake and Japanese-inspired cocktails.

businesses.name: InStyle Adventures
businesses.description:
InStyle Adventures is a family operated Kimberley tour specialist, providing guided luxury 4WD tours throughout the Kimberley (& Broome), the Pilbara and Western Australia. We offer an extraordinary & memorable experience, as you travel with Western Australia’s most experienced Kimberley guides, staying in the regions best accommodation, meeting the locals, while taking in and learning the history & culture of this ancient land.

As Broome locals, we have explored the amazing North Western Australia for many years and we are still in awe of it’s beauty. We invite you to come and experience the sights of Broome, journey into the remote Kimberley wilderness with us or explore the spectacular gorges and scenery of the Pilbara and Coral Coast. InStyle Adventures offers a truly unique experience, as you travel with one of Australia’s most experienced guides in a luxury 4WD tours.

Whether it’s a 5 star day tour of Broome or a two week journey through the remote Kimberley landscape, InStyle Adventures can tailor make your tour to suit you interests. Our intimate and flexible touring style is ideal for couples, families and friends travelling together, in fact it only takes 2 guests and we can guarantee your tour! Learn the best gorges & beaches to swim, how to avoid the ‘tour groups’, and most importantly we know the people of the region so we can make sure you have an incredible experience and an unforgettable holiday.

data.briefDescription:
Since 2011, Pure Dairy has been building an international reputation for its honest and transparent approach to conducting business.

Specialising in the supply of quality dairy products to the Food, Beverage and Flavour industries, we pride ourselves on our extensive knowledge of global and domestic dairy products, world market activity and our proven ability to offer dairy buyers and sellers more than just an avenue to trade.

With our head office located in Melbourne, Australia we operate three key business segments: International Trade, Food Service and Retail.

Our Total Supply Chain Management System offers our partners a turnkey solution incorporating product design, procurement, planning, manufacturing, quality control, financing, freight services, government regulatory requirements, warehousing and distribution.

Pure Dairy is a leader in its field, conducting open book trading activity in over 40 countries worldwide. We combine local insight with global reach to help suppliers and buyers attain their business goals. With the interdependence of world markets, a global perspective is essential for conducting success business.

Our multilingual team provides in-depth market knowledge, efficient service, and creative and commercially savvy solutions. The Pure Dairy team is at your disposal when it comes to technical advice and assistance.

We are committed to achieving and exceeding the needs of our clients through superior customer service. Our Customer Service Department, matched with our Technical Support Team, will ensure you keep coming back.

businesses.name: Aqua Mountain Water Filtration
businesses.description:
If you are a city dweller and don't mind a chemical cocktail as your primary water source, or a rural dweller and rely on a rain water tank system to drink and bathe in, then you will have a massive chemical collection and also an e-coli, bacterial and parasite issues to contend with in very unstable acidic unbalanced distilled tank water.

Many of the chemicals like Chlorine used in our town water are found to also destroy the good bacteria that form our first line of defence in the immune system, hence humans end up 'catching' many bad microorganisms floating around because the good microorganisms (our first line of defence in the immune system) have been killed off by these chemical anti-biotics.

As is chlorinated / fluoridated water equally potentially dangerous by drinking, also bathing and showering pose a risk by absorbing large amounts internally and externally through digestion, skin absorption and inhalation of chlorine as a chloride gas.

Rural tank water is equally as potentially dangerous as town water, but for many different reasons.

As storage tank water is completely delivered from rain water via building roofs and downpipes along with a multitude of debris including dust, chemical crop sprays, dead possums, rodents, snakes, birds (that hit upstairs windows) mosquitoes, frogs, toads, worms, parasites, insects, Guardia, Cryptosporidium, air pollution from industry and vehicles, etc.

By far the greatest potential risk to health comes from contamination of water with harmful microorganisms such as bacteria and parasites from bird or animal droppings, (faeces) resulting in large e-coli build-ups. Most water storage tanks contain large e-coli build-up. Rainwater tanks can also be contaminated from roof or plumbing materials.

Tank water, is basically distilled water, water that hasn't had the opportunity to 'earth-out'. That is, to fall to the ground and 'run' over the mineralised earth through a short distance of water courses, stream, rivers and finish its journey at the ocean- in a naturally mineralised balanced state, undrinkable, but very balanced and dynamically healthy to bathe in as the skin absorbs the mineral/ nutrient rich sea water.

Therefore rain (distilled) water is very acidic 'dry' and hungry water. What happens when we 'trap' this out of balance' liquid in storage tanks is disastrous to the human body. Even the concrete and iron storage tanks are eaten away rapidly by this 'hungry' acidic liquid trying to magnetically balance its pH levels by eating out the tanks alkaline minerals like lime, potassium, sodium, calcium, magnesium, iron, etc. The same thing happens in the human body, creating massive free radical damage, robbing minerals from body, bones and teeth.

The human body is constantly ravaged by this hungry out-of-balance-critically-unstable-liquid as we gulp it down as drinking water and draw it in through our skin through showering, bathing and teeth cleaning / rinsing.The results are catastrophic with this hungry liquid electrically charged to attract to its opposite polarity. Thus stealing our valuable minerals from bone, teeth and body reserves in its wild attempts to stabilise itself.

The food digestive system is severely restricted by continually drinking acidic rain water and town water as the stomach requires alkalinity before a meal to paradoxically trigger hydrochloric acid for proper digestion.

Distilled water is also 'dry' water insomuch as it cannot penetrate our cellular system so the cells are not hydrated by this unstable liquid, as the cells actually repel this out-of-balance liquid.

The cellular system requires balanced mineralised clean stable liquid to magnetically attract to the 100 trillion cells within the human body.

So very important is to filter our water with an 0.2 to 0.5 micron (half a micron) filter to remove bad bacteria, e-coli, chlorine, Cryptosporidium, Guardia, etc, and if possible to run our drinking water through our Benchtop alkalising mineral pH balancer.

Any filter beyond 0.5 micron (half a micron) will NOT be adequate.

ie: One micron to 5 micron filters are completely inadequate for rural or town water and will only work to remove organic waste particles and chemicals.

Aqua Mountain Water Filtration:

Benchtop Tower:

Fully protected drinking water with 0.2 to 0.5 (half) micron benchtop tap fitted filter. Conveniently effective.

Cleanable Ceramic & Carbon best quality protection. Easy to install with ongoing economical maintenance

99.99% Chlorine protection.

90% Fluoride protection.

Bacteria and Parasite full protection.

Mineral Water Purifier / Alkaliser

12 litre & 24 litre.

Full water protection with 0.2 to 0.5 (half) micron cleanable ceramic filter and alkalising minerals benchtop fountain

Mild alkaline crystal clear soft drinking water. Manual filling gravity fed upper holding tank.

Chlorine & Parasite full protection.

Easy to assemble and maintain.

* Under sink units available.

* Full house filtration with UV.

* Shower filters 0.5 micron.

Drink only safe, clear, parasite free water as nature intended it to be from Aqua Mountain Filtration.

Aqua Mountain Water Filtration- providing the best quality water filtration for over 15 years through our Nutritional Supplement business.

businesses.name: Dazmac International Logistics
businesses.description:
Importing a car or boat? DAZMAC has you covered

Importing a car or boat is a complicated process that requires the preparation of hundreds of pages of paperwork, timely application for permits, and coordination with offices charged with assessing and controlling import and export processes.

That’s why you need DAZMAC Pty Ltd. We’ve imported thousands of land and water vehicles to Australia, and we’re experts in the painstaking process of gathering documents, transferring payments, arranging for permits, performing inspections, filing taxes, and preventing unexpected charges. Whether you’re importing a pleasure boat or a large yacht, a motorbike, car, caravan, or trailer, DAZMAC ensures that the process is painless and error-free.

Are you better off transporting your boat in a trailer or a cradle? Can you file for a partial-year VAT refund upon sending a car overseas? Is your vehicle subject to a luxury tax? What modifications are required to your car’s emissions and other systems? Does your trailer require an Australian standard coupling for import, and how can you have one installed overseas?

Count on DAZMAC, your proven partner when it comes to importing boats and cars.
keywords: importing a car from the uk
importing cars from uk to australia

data.name: Dazmac International Logistics
data.briefDescription:
Dazmac International Logistics was founded by our Managing Director Daryl McIntyre in January 2010. The business aim was and still is to streamline the shipping process for Marine & Automotive importers by offering an end to end solution. We identified these industries as being over priced with lots of hidden costs & potential pitfalls. We set our goals to make our service competitive, informative, transparent, and hassle free.

In a short period of time we formed good partnerships with like minded agents in USA, Canada, New Zealand, Japan, Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, UK and Europe.

These relationships along with having reliable experienced staff have enabled DAZMAC to become a market leader in shipping boats & cars into Australia.

businesses.name: Sydney Anchor Points
businesses.description:
Services:

- Anchor point installation

- Ladder bracket installation

- Anchor point certification

- Roof access hatches

- Safe roof access systems

- Height safety consultations

Sydney Anchor Points specialises in cost-effective anchor point installations. Years of extensive research and testing ensures that the experienced technicians can safely assess the condition of your roof and quickly install a system that meets all relevant standards and OHS requirements.

Never compromise on safety, rely on the industry experts!

Sydney Anchor Points is a locally owned and operated business that services the entire Sydney region, from Bondi to Penrith and the Illawarra Shire to Hornsby. With an extensive knowledge of your local council's safety requirements and construction legislation, Sydney Anchor Points takes care of all of the paperwork so that you do not have to.

For stress free anchor point installations, rely on Sydney Anchor Points.

Each and every anchor point the team installs is designed, manufactured and tested in Australia. In accord with AS/NZS 1891.4 and AS/NZS 1891.2, all of the anchor points are rigorously tested for extreme Sydney weather conditions. You can be confident that you are receiving a premium quality height safety system. Sydney Anchor Points is so confident in the products they install, that they trust their lives on them every day of the week.

If you demand the highest standard of quality, rely on Sydney Anchor Points.

Why Choose Sydney Anchor Points?

- HIA Member

- Friendly customer service

- Cost effective anchor point installations

- Free quotes

- Sydney wide service

- Commercial, domestic and strata properties

- Metal, tiled and concrete roofs

- Fully insured

- Complete range of safety solutions

- Industry experts

- Highly recommended

The team at Sydney Anchor Points work hard to ensure they continue to surpass the high expectations that their clients demand. By continuing to refine their services and methods of delivery, Sydney Anchor Points is rapidly establishing a reputation as one of the most highly recommended height safety companies in Sydney. With a diverse commercial client base that includes Woolworths, LJ Hooker, Raine & Horne, NSW Ministry of Health and NSW Police as well as private property owners throughout Sydney, Sydney Anchor Points has the experience and runs on the board that you should expect from a reputable height safety company.

Sydney Anchor Points is a member of the Housing Industry Association and Trades Monitor so you can be entirely confident in the standard of workmanship and attention to detail of each member of the team. As qualified roof plumbers and roof tilers (License #241729C), Sydney Anchor Points can install innovative roof anchor systems safely without compromising the integrity of your roof.

If you don't know what type of height safety system is appropriate for your property, give the team a call for a free consultation.

Sydney Anchor Points

Phone: (02) 8020 5777

Website: http://www.sydneyanchorpoints.com.au/

businesses.description:
No matter the tree problem, Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance is the solution.

One of the reasons why so many property owners in Newcastle continue to rely on Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance is because the team is committed to showing the highest level of professionalism in every aspect of their work. When you book an appointment they will arrive on time. They will leave your yard free of leaves, sticks and twigs. They follow all relevant OHS standards to ensure the job can be done safely without incident.

Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance services all suburbs in Newcastle, Port Stephens, Lake Macquarie, Warners Bay and the Hunter Valley. The team has worked extensively with all Local Councils and can help you understand all relevant Council and State guidelines regarding native trees in the region.

The team at Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance recognise that having trees removed from your property can be an expensive undertaking, so they have streamlined their services in order to provide you with affordable prices without compromising on quality. Using industrial strength equipment and time tested methods, the fully licensed arborists can efficiently remove even the most hazardous trees which will save you time, money and hassle. John Rickards and the fully licensed arborists can provide you with specialist advice regarding the ideal treatments for any diseased trees on your property.

Services:

Tree pruning

Tree removal

Hazardous tree assessments

Tree diagnostics and treatments

Arborist consultations

Dead wooding

Palm removal

Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance is focused on “providing a safe and reliable tree service from the first point of contact, right down to the last leaf”. With a range of five star recommendations from previous customers, Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance is one of the leading tree maintenance teams in New South Wales.

To read genuine testimonials from commercial, body corporate and domestic customers in the Newcastle region visit the company website.

For a free tree removal quote call the team today. The affordable rates will be sure to impress.

No matter the size of the job, Cutting Edge Tree Maintenance has the experience, expertise, personnel and equipment to handle it. businesses.name: Advanced Lock and Key
businesses.description:
Advanced Lock & Key initially commenced trading in 1999 with myself (Aaron) & my wife Amanda operating from one mobile van and a home office. Through our demonstrated professionalism and dedication to provide excellence in service, we have grown to become one of Perth’s premium Emergency Locksmith companies.

The expansion of the business can be directly related to our ability to provide quality products, consistent excellence and expediency in our service with the goal to achieving complete customer satisfaction. We have a dedicated Emergency Locksmith team, who take personal pride in their work which directly contributes to our continued growth, success and prosperity.

Advanced Lock & Key employs six qualified, police cleared & licensed locksmiths with over forty years combined lock smithing experience. In addition to our qualified locksmiths we currently employ a first year apprentice, as part of our commitment to providing training opportunities for young people in the lock smithing industry. Our Bookkeeper & Office Administrator ensure our office & accounting department runs smoothly and completes our team.

Our team of qualified and experienced emergency locksmiths have the skills, expertise and flexibility to provide our customers with the services they require to meet their needs. Our structure consists of a central retail shop / workshop facility and four mobile vans, fully equipped with machinery and stock to perform onsite locksmith services.

businesses.name: Envirosystems Technologies
businesses.description:
Envirosystems are a solutions orientated manufacturing company, who specialise in the supply of market leading elastomeric and cementitious coating technologies.

Formerly Waterproofing Technologies, Envirosystems Technologies has rapidly grown its base since inception and is now the leading manufacturer and supplier of construction chemicals in Australia. Our extensive range includes premium Waterproofing Systems, Coatings, Flooring, Sealants, Adhesives and Remedial Solutions for use across the built environment.

We are a proudly Australian Made and Owned brand committed to the supply and production of the most environmentally sound products of their type. Ongoing consultation with Builders, Architects and Engineers is provided on a collaborative basis to deliver optimum system solutions for a variety of project-specific needs.

Our products are supplied to contractors operating across the full construction market, including Tier 1 construction, industrial, commercial and residential projects, while also available for purchase throughout our Australian distribution network and retail space at our Trade Centre in St. Peters.

Envirosystems has a national presence with sales centres in New South Wales, Victoria and Western Australia. In addition, we have representatives covering Queensland, South Australia, Northern Territory, Tasmania, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

We pride ourselves on our high level of quality assurance and continually demonstrate a commitment to, and support of, environmentally responsible technology.

businesses.name: M & S Textiles Australia
businesses.address: 136 Cromwell St, Collingwood, VIC 3066, Australia, Collingwood, VIC, Australia
businesses.description:
M & S Textiles Australia is founded by Sham and Momo Lohani in 1990 in Melbourne on the dream of empowering the Australian Aboriginal designs to create on-demand, custom-designed textiles.

We are an Aboriginal fabric and Quilting business offering, 100% cotton fabrics from natural and eco-friendly fibres with Aboriginal and Australian designs.

Our Each Aboriginal Designs Have a Story and Historical Significance.

Enlightening the marketplace over the 9 years, M & S Textiles have become the leader in the authentic Australian Aboriginal designs, providing genuine products across the country.

At M&S Textiles Australia, all our designs are created by Australian Aboriginal artists and their experience with the Dreamtime. The designs are crafted using only the colours seen in nature; because of this, our fabrics work very well together with other fabrics. Alongside with 100% cotton fabrics, M&S Textiles Australia also manufactures and supplies battings in the following compositions.

· 100% Cotton

· 80/20 Cotton Polyester

· 80/20 Cotton Polyester Fusible

· 100% Super-washed Wool

· 50% Wool - 50% Polyester

· 100% Polyester

We also distribute Hobbs Bonded Fibre Battings imported from the United States.

M & S Textiles licenses each artwork showcased on the website and pays a fair share of the price to each artist. Explore our online shop with the variety of Australian fabric collection organised by colourway, by bugs and animals, by pattern/design, by the size of print (small and giant), and by blenders.

businesses.name: Sun Dynamica
businesses.description:
Everyone should experience the health benefits of sauna, from weight loss to improved blood circulation. But, you might not have enough time, money or access to go to a sauna. We at SunDynamica want to fix that problem. We want to make the sauna portable and accessible for everyone. That is why we offer the far infrared sauna, also known as the FIR sauna. If you want to install a sauna in your own home, you don't have to worry about being limited in space. The traditional saunas cost a lot and are permanent. The FIR ones are fairly inexpensive and you can use them on your own bed.

Our product has been tested for the emission of EMF and we can assure you that it is completely safe. The emission of an electromagnetic field of the FIR saunas is lower than the allowable levels set by the European Safety Standard. When you order from us, you get free shipping to your door. You won't have to pick up the product or worry about expensive shipping fees. Start enjoying weight loss, detox and relax in your own sauna right away.

And don't forget to subscribe to our Mailing List and follow us on Facebook so that we can keep you in touch with new products, sales and special offers.

Hope you enjoy our Tiny World of Wonders and happy shopping!

businesses.name: Viva Digital
businesses.description:
Viva Digital is a boutique-style web and online marketing agency based in Caloundra on Australia’s Sunshine Coast. Despite our small size we have a massive focus on results and we deliver these with a genuinely friendly service. We value our clients on an individual level and each customer gets our full attention – this is one of the advantages of working with smaller agencies. When companies come to us for help they deal with the same person throughout the project, Paul Smith, Viva Digital’s founder.

We are nimble, independent digital specialists on the Sunshine Coast.We deliver exceptional, results-driven design, branding, marketing and web design, providing an excellent return on investment. We work with start-ups and established businesses, focusing on generating new opportunities.

Led by Paul, a highly experienced web strategist and graphic designer, the team at Viva Digital pulls together its considerable knowledge and expertise. By working together, Viva Digital can offer a completely bespoke service to each customer, no matter what the brief is.

There are countless companies out there that do what we do, but there are precious few who can offer the level of personal service that Viva Digital does. The fact that we remain small-scale means that we can stay nimble and responsive to the different needs of our customers and their businesses.

With bigger agencies, clients, especially smaller ones, can get lost in an impersonal agency machine, which is alienating and frustrating. An even bigger downside to larger agencies is that clients are often paying a surcharge for fancy premises and sales staff wages. We’ve done away with all that and we focus on bringing the latest in digital marketing to our clients at old-fashioned prices.Viva Digital listens to its clients and wants to make sure each customer is 100% satisfied. We already have more than 300 happy clients on the books – small local start-ups to larger national and international companies.

We see ourselves as our clients’ creative partner and as such we view their growth and success as our biggest rewards. Our main focus is to develop and deliver web solutions that will have a real return on investment.We are dedicated to creating innovative and engaging website design, strategies and branding for our clients. Viva Digital have been active for nearly 15 years, and our experience has taught us what works, what doesn’t, how to keep up with the times and most importantly; how to get results. We’re results driven, we have the solutions, we have the experience and we have the expertise to increase your online presence in the most effective way. We know that every single cent you invest in marketing, needs to have a dollar value return and this is our aim.

businesses.description:
GuardRight Industries

Guardright Industries offers Crimsafe Security Products, Roller Shutters, Plantation Shutters and Magnetite Double Glazing, which provides first-class security, noise control and weather management products for home or business.

Our team has over 23 years’ experience and we are proud to be a well-known shutter store for western Sydney, from Parramatta to the Blue Mountains.

At Guardright you will find the best security screen doors Sydney supplies, including the iconic Crimsafe brand. We are the number one choice for businesses and home owners when it comes to blinds, awnings, windows and roller shutters for domestic homes and businesses. Not only do our range of shutters and blinds reduce the hot Penrith temperatures in summer, they offer superior security and can complement the aesthetics of your home or business.

Guardright is committed to outstanding, reliable and honest customer service. We take great pride in taking the very best care of you, every step of the way.

Crimsafe and Guardright, together to keep you safer.

GuardRight takes the security of your family home and business very seriously. For this reason we are pleased to announce that we are now a fully authorized licensee for Crimsafe security products. Crimsafe is Australia’s most recommended and trusted brand of security doors and windows. You can be rest assured that every Crimsafe door and screen or exceeds all Australian industry standards.

Available in a range of designs from standard frames through to ultra-modern, your Crimsafe security screen doors can be made to fit any size and style to complement your existing aesthetics. If you have a love for traditional wooden doors, Crimsafe have colonial designs with wood-look finishing.

Commercial Roller Shutters

Our commercial roller shutters are made to the highest standards, and are backed with our GuardRight Promise to ensure that you won’t be left spending hours away from running your business.

Plantation Shutters

GuardRight plantation shutters come in many different styles and Louvre sizes. Plantation shutters are simple indoor shutters that block sunlight and provide a decorative touch to your windows.

Magnetite – Retrofit Double Glazing for Windows

Your home is your sanctuary but there are many factors that can reduce the quality of your living environment and the ability to enjoy a healthy and stress free lifestyle. Glass windows are a major feature of your home’s design. Many existing homes have single glazed windows using glass which is to the minimal standards, which provide minimal noise and thermal insulation. Magnetite’s retrofit double glazing system achieves a complete and sustainable solution providing significant results that you can feel and hear and the best part is that once installed are discreet.

data.name: SpanRight – GuardRight Industries
data.briefDescription: The SpanRight Domestic/Commercial 55mm Curved Profile aluminium roller shutter, with its extra wide dimensions, allows you to span wider spaces. Suitable for large windows or openings, SpanRight roller shutters operate silently and offer strong and durable protection from intruders and wild weather.
data.description:
Our shutters are the perfect cover solution for wide stacker doors, garages, bi-fold doors and alfresco openings, or even for partitioning, so you can sublease that unused office space. They screen out the noise and the sun and, if needed, provide welcome shade. Penrith-based GuardRight Industries manufacture and supply these quality shutters and blinds to Parramatta, Sydney-wide and beyond.

SpanRight aluminium roller shutters are made to withstand harsh Australian conditions. Made right here in Australia with premium materials and engineering, we use precision 2 ply roll formed aluminium for strength and durability and a polyurethane/polyamide paint coating system + lacquer for a long-lasting finish. They are abrasion and corrosion resistant and, happily, never need repainting.

When you have extra wide spaces (up to 4.0m), to cover or secure, the SpanRight is the right choice for physical security and peace of mind. It’s the solution for a host of applications, ranging from domestic to commercial. Energy savings also flow from the roller shutter’s insulating urethane insert core, which is CFC free.

businesses.name: Kwikfynd Fencing
businesses.description: Fencing or as it is commonly known as Boundary fencing is a free standing structure, designed to restrict or limit access across a particular boundary. Fencing is normally different from wall structures by their variety and specific construction and the purpose that they are used for. Although there is Barrier wall fencing, they tend to be limiting by blocking views and in some cases being unsightly, while fence can aesthetically appealing while in many cases such as a glass or frameless glass fence can provide an unrestricted view from a balcony, deck or veranda, while still adhering to the protection of a particular boundary and general safety. Generally there are many types of fencing products and their uses vary greatly. For example there is Privacy fencing, Garden fencing, Pool fencing, Backyard and Front yard fencing. They can be installed as a DYI product however due to the complexity of different blocks and boundaries it is wise to choose a professional Fencing Contractor, Fencing supplier and or installer. That way you will know that you are complying with the local council rules and regulations and most importantly that your fence will be built to last. The fencing contractors on this site will be able to assist you with all your questions and needs.

Tree guardsProtect your young plants from pests and accidents by installing sleeve tree guards. We sell tree guards in bulk. Tree guards are plastic or cardboard. Survey pegsSurvey pegs are one of our specialities. Our wood survey pegs come in white, plain or coloured tops. There is a variety of sizes and dimensions to choose from.Jute Matting Our Jute Matting products promote erosion control whilst allowing the soil to breathe underneath it.Grass Reinforcement SolutionsAll Stake Supply is known for its landscaping products and environmental terrain solutions. Grass and ground reinforcement products are a greener and more cost-effective choice over concrete and asphalt.Here are the driveway pavers and grass pavers products that All Stake Supply offer:• PP40 Porous Pavers• Geocell• Bodpave 85• EconoGrid40• GR11 & GR14 Reinforcement Mesh• Turf Reinforcement Mesh TR4Unlike concrete and asphalt, these grass reinforcement products allow the growth of lawn underneath yet it is spared from foot and vehicle traffic that can damage and ruin its overall health. This allows you to park on grass without damaging it plus you keep something that absorbs rainwater.For aesthetically pleasing driveway without the expense of concrete, consider installing a gravel driveway. businesses.name: KRGS Doors
businesses.description:
KRGS Doors

Proudly Australian owned and run KRGS is committed to supplying quality door products at competitive prices, while offering the highest level of uncompromising service in our industry.

The founders of KRGS bring together a vast amount of experience in the door industry, in combining superior levels of customer service with high quality product, and have identified the need for such a quality service provider in the market at affordable prices. We are fast becoming a leader in the industry with our superior systems and efficient reliable customer service.

Our extensive product range is focused squarely on delivering uncompromising quality in roller shutters, roller doors and roller grilles for retailers and hospitality providers (kiosks, serveries, bars etc.). Our product range is adaptable to practically any situation where you need increased security after hours. Our products include: folding closures, a wide range of roller shutters, roller grilles, roller doors and side folding doors.

The best part is this - thanks to our very efficient manufacturing techniques, we are able to offer very competitive pricing.

Roller Shutters:

KRGS Roller Shutters provide maximum security and privacy at a very competitive price range. 3 different types of Roller Shutters to suit your needs. Counter line Shutters suit smaller architectural openings such as fire hose reel cabinets or shop kiosk. The Series II Aluminum Roller shutters can be either solid or perforated slat and applied to shop fronts, reception counters and majority of door openings.

Folding Doors / Concertina Doors:

Folding Closures allow you to have security concertina doors in any shape and any length. These commercial folding doors have no floor track, eliminating any trip hazards. Great for protecting shop fronts against theft, for businesses that need airflow while being secure and as an add-on level of after-hours security for your business.

Roller Grilles:

KRGS security grilles allow airflow and ventilation as well as visibility without sacrificing strength and security.

businesses.name: Oz Seals
businesses.description:
Australia's leading supplier of hydraulic seals and pneumatic seals, and manufacturer of custom special seals

Oz Seals Pty Ltd was established on 4th December 1995. We were initially established to act as a hydraulic seals and pneumatic seals manufacturer with divisions in each state of Australia and world-wide.

Today, after almost 15 years of business, we have expanded into three distinct areas: Custom Made & Standard Seals, Seal Manufacturing Systems and Raw Materials.

At Oz Seals, our core business is the manufacturing of specialised seals and the supply of the biggest range of standard seals in Australia. We understand the importance of seals and the immense costs a breakdown can cause to a business - that is why our emphasis is placed on sealing solutions with a very quick turn around (one hour service is provided if necessary).

We also develop our own, state-of-the-art seal manufacturing systems that are among the most technologically advanced in the world. These manufacturing systems and specific CNC software are available to be purchased or leased depending on the customer's location. Customers using this facility are known as our partners.

businesses.name: VECTOR LIFTING
businesses.description: Vector Lifting is a 100% Australian owned and operated Company, specializing in material and vehicle handling equipment. Since our inception in 1989 we have developed an extensive range of products and undertaken a variety of engineering projects within Australia and Internationally. Some of these projects have involved major componentry integrated with a processing facility, while other components have been of a complete 'turn-key' nature, with Vector Lifting taking responsibility from design to fully commissioned operational finish. High speed rail maintenance equipment project is a perfect example of this.Our design and production team have many decades of experience between them, with a strong focus on efficiency and practicality of the Vector Lifting equipment. They have gain enormous product knowledge that enables us to develop innovative and effective design ideas, providing solutions and improved productivity to our clients. Through constant development and improvement, Vector Lifting successfully maintains the high level of quality, reliability and service that has always been our principal philosophy.

businesses.name: Precision Stainless Systems
businesses.description:
Precision Stainless Systems design, manufacture and install stainless steel solutions for production lines and production rooms. This includes both custom designed equipment and “off-shelf” modular solutions, depending on the business needs.

We have been producing stainless steel solutions of the highest quality for close to 20 years for clients based Australia wide, but mostly concentrated in Brisbane and South-East Queensland, ranging from Bundaberg, Oakey in the West, and Lismore/Casino further south.

We judge our success by the success of our customers, and we continually invest to improve the quality and performance of our products. This has built us a reputation as the supplier of choice for stainless steel equipment and manufacturing facilities in South East Queensland.

Precision Stainless Systems specialise in Conveyors for all types of production facilities. With our complete range of custom-designed and or modular belts systems, we are renowned within the industry for supplying high quality production and processing systems.

Our skilled team has vast experience constructing and installing many different types of Conveyors including:

Powered Chain Driven Roller,

Flat Top (Modular and Slat Chain),

Twin Strand Chain, &

Belt Conveyors.

data.name: Precision Stainless Systems

e specialise in stainless steel fabrication of custom machinery and equipment for manufacturing businesses in these sectors:

Food Manufacturers – Meat & Chicken Processing, Smallgoods, Snackfoods, Bakeries, Biscuits, Packaged Foods, Fruit & Vegetable Processing, Grain/Nuts/Legumes processing, Dairy producers

Beverage Manufacturers – Breweries, Juice, Wine

Non-food FMCG Manufacturers – Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, Batteries, Pet Food, Chemicals

We operate Australia-wide, with the majority of our customers located in Brisbane and South-East Queensland, ranging from Bundaberg, Oakey in the West, and Lismore/Casino further south.

Clyde Street Child Care & Preschool in Bondi is an inviting home away from home for all our Clyde Street families. We pride ourselves on the friendly and welcoming ambiance and the wonderful relationships we have with families.

With your help we aim to raise confident, secure and happy children in all areas of development. Working within the Early Years Learning Framewok (EYLF), our qualified Early Childhood trained teachers set up achievable challenges to inspire a sense of achievement and evoke children's curiosity through play. data.description:
Amiga Engineering was established in 1988, and are known as the specialists of Pipe Fittings and Flanges. Amiga Engineering was the worlds best kept secret, and are now dabbling in other areas of Australian Manufacturing. In 2008, Amiga Engineering acquired Genat and Wood Pty Ltd, the manufacturers of the finest inline helical gearboxes. Amiga has revitalised the Australian brand and have officially registered our brand of Genat and Wood as officially Australian Made and Owned.

Amga Engineering also acquired Bradley Technologies Group (also known as Bradley Engineering) in 2008; a general and precision machining company. We are now the sole manufacturers world wide of the brand Genat and Wood, and for the dentistry Manual Aspirating Twin Tip syringe.

You can find our fittings and flanges on almost every oil rig or platform in Australia.
