businesses.name: CMTP
businesses.description:
Timber Pallets, Crates & More – Transport Packing & Packaging Solutions

Complete packing and packaging solutions that works

Wherever you are in Australia, if you need to pack, store, move or export delicate goods, from fresh produce and livestock to electronics, or large volumes of bulky goods and equipment, CMTP can provide you with effective and efficient packaging solutions.

Whether you need standard pallets, crates, cartons, contract packing or totally customised packaging designed and built for you, CMTP has the skills, experience, technology and full ISPM compliance to offer the best solution for your requirements.

Product PROTECTION, packaging INNOVATION and prompt ACTION are the cornerstones of CMTP customer satisfaction.

30 years of manufacturing protective packaging

We have highly experienced teams in six complementary manufacturing facilities in Melbourne, country Victoria, NSW, S.A. and Tasmania, all equipped with the latest material technology. As such, CMTP can meet your needs for timber pallets for export and domestic use, crates and produce bins, livestock crates, cardboard cartons and carton pallets, tote flute board bins and sundry packaging.

Our semi-automated and automated production capabilities enable us to meet tight delivery schedules nationally without compromising quality. We pride ourselves on supporting our customers’ business results with our “100 per cent Delivered In-Full, On-Time” supply chain performance and our “Just-in-time” delivery system (KANBAN).

A growing family business delivering customer satisfaction

Our customers say they value the personalised attention they receive from CMTP management and staff.

Founded in 1976 in Colac (Vic) by Chris and Marilyn Meade, the company has grown, diversified, opened interstate facilities and acquired the Aspect Packaging Company (in 2008).

Throughout this evolution to becoming a significant member of the Australian packaging industry, CMTP has remained a family business passionate about customer satisfaction. Chris and Marilyn’s son Travis has joined the team of packaging experts, consolidating CMTP’s customer service commitment to very diverse customers.

data.name: CMTP
data.briefDescription:
Logistic Solutions Provider, Supplying Quality Pallets, Crates & Cartons | CMTP

Your business results depend on reliably transporting and exporting delicate goods, and so you cannot take risks with choosing your packaging supplier!

Your fresh produce, livestock and electronics will lose value fast without a very effective transportation solution, from export crates to individual cardboard cartons.

Your bulky goods, too, need their own unique solution. And you want to be confident that your pallets, wooden crates, pens, bags or cardboard cartons will be available exactly when you need them, to minimise downtime and ensure your business is as efficient as it can be.

Whether you need cardboard pallets for small or occasional quantities or export crates for frequent or large volumes; whether you are transporting fragile, live, fresh, bulky or just “normal” goods; you want a partner who has a track record of capability, flexibility and reliability.

businesses.name: Polito Wood Fire Ovens
businesses.description:
There’s something special about cooking and eating outdoors in your own wood fire oven. Food simply tastes better when enjoyed in the fresh Australian air.

Nothing beats a wood fired oven in your backyard and Polito’s wood fired ovens, made right here in Melbourne, are the best you can buy.

HOME OVENS:

Wood fire oven used in a pizzeria, restaurant, hotels etc need to be of the highest quality material and building methods. The importance of the cooking floor tile is vital, a 50mm thick floor oven tiles which has a minimum Alumina content of 38% and to reach temperature of 1350 dg C. Polito believes 100% on the thermal mass, reaching the wall/floor thickness layers of approximately 300mm. By achieving thermal mass the wood fire oven retains/captures the heat which results to burning less firewood used leaving 80% of the internal oven footprint to cook. Polito commercial wood fire ovens are pre built and ready to be delivered for installation. Ovens come with a commercial metal black powered coated stand.

COMMERCIAL OVENS:

Polito Wood Fire Ovens in Melbourne manufactures commercial wood fire ovens with a wide range of sizes and styles. businesses.name: EX Solutions International Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
At E-x Solutions we offer consultancy services in the application of standards to the field of explosion protection.

Whether your work site requires a hazardous area inspection, hazardous area audit, or you're a manufacturer in need of pre-certification assessment for your latest product, we’re here to help. Our electrical and compliance engineers are dedicated to the pursuit of excellence when it comes to explosion protection and committed to providing expert solutions.

At all times we encourage our clients to work with us in an open and transparent environment to ensure the best outcome, which keeps risk as low as reasonably practicable.

Across the world, most places require electrical equipment that is used in explosive atmospheres to undergo a rigorous certification process in order to confirm that it complies with the relevant equipment standards.

Depending on where you are different standards will apply, however, wherever you are the idea is the same: all standards include requirements relating to equipment construction and performance.

By maintaining an up to date and detailed knowledge of both Australian and International hazard area standards, we can ensure that the highest level of safety is maintained in hazardous areas.

Our aim at all times is to work with our clients to provide the best possible solution, while always referring to the appropriate hazardous area standards. When you commission E-x Solutions as your hazardous area consultant you can rest assured that all of the necessary decisions will be fully documented with accuracy and precision, and that we will endeavour to clearly explain everything in plain language.

So if you use equipment in explosive atmospheres but are unsure about exactly how the hazard area standards apply to you, don’t hesitate to call one of our experts to organise a consultation.

Label Power was established in 1996 with head office and manufacturing facility in Brisbane, Queensland. An extensive trade label manufacturing plant coupled with over 18 years experience in the implementation of the best labelling systems make Label Power the right partner to help you implement all your product identification and tracking needs.

HACCP Certification

Label Power take food safety seriously and our Food packaging, Beverage and Meat labels are now manufactured in our HACCP certified facility

HACCP is a systematic preventive approach to food safety and pharmaceutical safety that identifies physical, chemical, and biological hazards in production processes that can cause the finished product to be unsafe, and designs measurements to reduce these risks to a safe level.

As a major label and tag supplier into the Australian food industries it was essential for Label Power to invest in developing systems and procedures to enable HACCP certification.

We look forward to supporting even more food industries now with our HACCP certification.

businesses.name: Jewellery Design Studio
businesses.description: Jewellery Design Studio is the brainchild of Alex Vanasco and Sally Chaplin. With over 35 years of combined experience they are also the heart and soul of the company. Desiring to offer both a personal design service and quality handcrafted jewellery, as well as retaining personal contact with clients, is a strong focus of the Jewellery Design Studio mission. As creative individuals we do not want to lose contact with those people who inspire us daily – our clients.

data.name: Jewellery Design Studio
data.briefDescription:
“At JDS we create unique and individual jewellery for our clients. Although we carry numerous diamond engagement rings in store to select from, we usually find that our clients choose to modify and personalize their items into a unique piece. This involves sitting together with our qualified Designer who hand sketches in front of, and with the client, to create quality, individual pieces.

As Gemmologists, Registered Valuers and Diamond Graders, we can then assist the client with the selection of Certified Diamonds and Gemstones, ethically sourced direct from the cutters, enabling JDS to combine individuality and top competitive prices.

JDS specializes in remodelling, utilising our hand design and skilled manufacturing techniques to remodel old jewellery into new pieces, transforming old unworn items into new family heirlooms. Each of these pieces having a unique story.

Our clients deal directly with the people who design and handcraft their pieces ensuring they receive the best possible advice.

In store, we carry a large selection of unique engagement rings, ladies and mens wedding bands, & anniversary rings, together with numerous individually designed one off jewellery pieces for those looking for a special gift. As a family jeweller we also offer repairs and valuation services.”

businesses.name: Byron Bay Harvest
businesses.address: 50 Skinner Shoot Road Byron Bay Nsw Australia 2481
businesses.description:
Local businessmen Nathan Folkes and Jason Saville are launching their very own organic farm in the heart of Byron Bay. Starting in June 2015 and officially opening our doors in September 2015, Byron Bay Harvest aims to bring healthy, organic food right to your door. Compared to some of the fruit and vegetable produce available at Australia’s major wholesale outlets, Byron Bay Harvest strives to provide financially affordable organic food with the added ease of it being delivered to you direct.

Farmed locally in Byron Bay, the quality-assured crops cultivated by BBH will also be available to buy at local markets, from our local schools and directly from our website…

The company was founded and completely focused upon being able to provide fresh organic produce to the local people at affordable prices. Jason Saville, the driving force behind this goal, has been involved in farming since the early age of five years old and has always been an active part of his family farm. In his early twenties he then went on to work as a jackaroo in Oberon. Where his passion for fresh produce developed further. Jason then went on to set up an organic farm for a client down in the Blue Mountains, which gave him the push to set up his own organic farm in his hometown of Byron Bay.

Jason says “I've always found the prices of organic produce in supermarkets shockingly high and have finally decided to do something about it in my community. It's all about enlivening our community by relieving our reliance on supermarkets and knowing exactly where our fruit and vegetables come from. I have devolved a passion for organic farming and teaching communities about the benefits and practices around organics. We look forward to bringing some great benefits to the community and beyond through this exciting project”

You can place orders directly from our website by creating an account or you can find us at the following farmers markets....

""We have been washing dogs of all sizes, shapes, colours and coats for years. When your best pal needs some treatment, trust on those who know best.""

Mobile Dog Wash Perth WA dog wash and grooming service use an advanced hydro bath system which provides an extremely convenient, affordable, effective and reliable dog wash and grooming method.

It not only maintains your pet's health but has your beloved friend looking and smelling great. Mobile Dog Wash Perth WA is more than happy to provide you advice when caring for your dog whether it be in regards to nutrition, breeding vet related and medicated dog wash and grooming services.

Caring, dog loving professionals, trained in the mobile dog wash hydrobath system for all breeds of dogs. It will have your pet loving itself and loving you more than ever.

Regardless of the size, the shape, the colour or the coat we come to the convenience of your home in our all weather purpose built mobile dog washing system.

Mobile Dog Wash Perth WA dog wash and grooming services include: Washing your dog in warm freshwater, provide them with a delicate massaging brush, effective grooming and clipping in selected areas including nail clipping the dogs.

We also carefully and effectively clean out their ears and eyes, we provide them some beautiful aroma care and som pet-friendly deodorant to have them smelling beautiful.

We then blow dry to remove excess water and to give that beautiful coat a fluffy finish and of course finish by providing the dog with doggy treats and lots of love for it's as a reward.

Mobile Dog Wash Perth WA. Perth's leading mobile dog wash and grooming specialists.

"

businesses.name: GeotyresOnline
businesses.description:
Proudly Australian owned and operated, the staff at Geo Tyres are dedicated to providing you with the best service and value for your money.

We have the largest range of quality tyres and tubes to suit anything from riding mowers and farm equipment to motorcycles and ATV vehicles.

Our wide range of product is sourced from world leading brands such as Kenda, Deestone and Mitas.

Kenda is a leading OEM brand and produces the world’s largest range of high quality speciality turf, ATV, UTV, skid steer and industrial tyres, as well as dependable butyl rubber inner tubes.

The Deestone brand is a low cost, value driven alternative to higher priced original tyres with a large product range for turf, ATV, backhoe, agricultural machinery, forklifts and many categories.

Mitas Motorcycle Tyres are produced by one of Europe’s largest tyre manufacturer. Mitas tyres are of premium high quality and performance. They are competitively priced with a wide range of off -road, adventure and road motorcycle applications. Mitas Tyres are used around the world in competitive and recreational purposes with a wide range of products.

data.name: Plaza Central Dentists
data.address: Shop 3, Plaza Central, 31-33 Plaza Parade Maroochydore Qld, 4558
data.briefDescription:
The mouth is a warm, moist environment rich in nutrients. It is a perfect place for bacteria (germs) to grow feeding on the food we eat that gets trapped between our teeth and gums, especially sugary foods. Bacteria are the main cause of tooth decay (rotten teeth), gum disease (gingivitis) and the build of up scale/tartar (thick layers of bacteria stuck to teeth).

We truly believe in prevention and our Care Plan has been developed to help make visiting the practice for regular six monthly examinations and cleaning simple, easy and affordable. Learning how to stop teeth rotting and gums becoming infected is the key to keeping teeth healthy for life. Remember, you only have to clean the teeth you want to keep!

businesses.name: Task Forklifts
businesses.address: 5 Cord Street DUDLEY PARK South Australia 5008 Australia
businesses.description:
Like many successful companies, we began with a dedicated, driven individual whose strong work ethic and uncompromising standards forged a reputation for, in his case, manufacturing excellence. That individual was Eric Rainsford.

In 1938, Eric Rainsford established a business manufacturing surgical equipment for the Australian Defence Force. The Rainsford manufacturing business developed rapidly, expanding production to include many household and everyday items like automotive mirrors and seatbelts, blinds and the well known Safe ‘n’ Sound child restraints. By the 70’s the Rainsford enterprise had expanded to include automotive component manufacturing facilities in Adelaide, Lithgow, Gosford and Melbourne.

In 1981, the company turned its manufacturing skills to making electric stackers, and it’s been a case of onwards and upwards ever since. We became known as TASK in 2001, by which time we’d become the largest Australian manufacturer and exporter of forklifts and materials handling products as well as holding numerous international patents.

In the 21st century, the Rainsford family continue the tradition of manufacturing excellence with the design, manufacture and distribution of pedestrian stackers and ride-on forklifts through TASK FORKLIFTS®. And it’s only with the expertise and hard work of our dedicated team that we can continue to prosper and grow.

As an Australian business we are delighted with our Australian made product and look forward to the opportunity of servicing your needs.

businesses.description:
Sure Search - Utility Location and Leak Detection can help you see your site from all angles, above and below the ground. We offer a range of expert services, using the latest equipment – from Hydro vacuum excavation, ground penetrating radar, underground 3D imaging to CCTV inspections – designed to give you unprecedented access to your site or structure, as well as superior site protection for safe excavation and planning.

Our range of advanced detection tools, controlled by our expert technicians, enable you to see deep into the ground, and through walls and structures, to identify leaks as well as to safely map the location of pipes and cabling.

We can also assist when planning structural support and mapping spaces, to identify areas of structural deficiency and ideal utilities placement. As part of our services we offer identifing: Underground Utilities - Pipes - Voids - Underground Tanks - Cables - Blockages - Water & Gas Leaks: Service Detection, Pipe, Cable and Utility Locating Leak Detection Sydney & Investigation

Hydrogen & Nitrogen Testing, Water Loss Management, Non-Destructive Digging through Vacuum Excavation and Hydro Vacuum Excavation.

We can also accurately map and oversee the installation and construction of utility piping, cabling and construction, all while protecting your site.

Established back in June 1987, Sure Search was the first independent pipe, cable and leak detection company in Sydney - maintaining our place as Sydney’s experts in leak detection and utilities management has remained our goal ever since.

Contact us now for a quote on 1300 88 45 20.

businesses.name: KUKA Robotics Australia Pty Ltd
businesses.description: KUKA is an international automation group with sales of more than EUR 4 billion and around 15,000 employees. As one of the world’s leading suppliers of intelligent, resource-saving automation solutions, KUKA offers industrial robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMR) including controllers, software and cloud-based digital services as well as fully connected production systems for a wide range of industries – primarily for markets such as automotive with a focus on e-mobility & battery, electronics, metal & plastic, consumer goods, food, e-commerce, retail and healthcare. KUKA is active with over 100 locations in more than 50 countries. The largest sites are located in Germany, the US, China and Hungary, with headquarters in Augsburg, Germany. The KUKA Group includes Swisslog (intralogistics automation), Swisslog Healthcare (hospital and pharmacy automation), Visual Components (offline programming and simulation) and Device-Insight (IoT).

businesses.name: Swift Metal Services Pty Ltd.
businesses.description:
Swift Metal Services is a second generation specialist component manufacturer, with industry leading fast turnaround times and attention to detail. Swift provides a quality component service Australia wide, with same day response to customer enquiries, fast quotes and on time deliveries.Specific services include:• Component design • Tool design and manufacture• Metal stamping and pressing • Punching and forming• Repetition fabrication• Welding and assembly• Laser cutting and profiling• Repetition Machining • Thread rolling, drilling & thread tapping• Vibratory finishing and protective coating

Tube Flattening

One of Australia’s leading metal processing companies, Swift Metal Services offers a complete tube flattening and punching service for most types of tubes including RHS, SHS and circular tubes, to 200mm diameter.

Swift utilizes the latest technology tube profiling and tube bending equipment enabling a wide variety of lengths and profiles to be achieved depending on client requirements.

Tubes can flattened and punched on-centre or off to one side as per the diagram below.

The photo shows a 38mm (1 ½”) tube flattened with a mounting hole punched in the centre.

Swift has the capacity to flatten most types of tubing including mild steel, stainless steel, brass, aluminium and copper, with tube wall thicknesses up to 3mm.

For further information on  tube flattening and tube punching contact the experts at Swift Metal Services www.swiftmetal.com.au/repetition-fabrication

businesses.name: ABB Robotics Australia Pty Limited
businesses.description:
ABB is one of the world’s leading power and automation engineering companies. We provide solutions for secure, energy-efficient generation, transmission and distribution of electricity, and for increasing productivity in industrial, commercial and utility operations.
The ABB Group employs more than 150,000 people in over 100 countries. Each of our customers benefits from sharing ABB’s research, supply, manufacturing, distribution, information technology and benchmarking capabilities.
In Australia, the history of ABB goes back to the late nineteenth century. Today, ABB has operations in Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Darwin and Melbourne. With over 2000 employees located at our 13 sites, customers are served through an extensive country-wide presence.
What We Do Spread over five divisions, our portfolio ranges from light switches to robots for painting cars and packing food, and from huge electrical transformers to control systems that manage entire power networks, vast mining operations and state-of-the-art factories.
In ABB, we have a proud history of many ‘firsts’. In 2012, ABB Australia patented another world first – technology to recycle SF6 gas to technical grade purity. ABB’s technology can effectively close the loop on this greenhouse gas, the significance of which was recognised in ABB being awarded a prestigious Banksia Environmental award.
Underpinning all the work we do, is our emphasis on safety and quality. The health and safety of our people and our customers is a fundamental part of our commitment to sustainability. We care deeply about how our operations and products affect our employees, customers, contractors and our neighbours.

Abrasivestocks Pty Ltd, headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland since January 2023, dedicates itself to the abrasive industry supply chain, serving wholesalers and distributors across Australia and New Zealand. With over two decades of rich experience and professional service, we’ve established enduring partnerships with thousands of global buyers.
At Australian Abrasives Warehouse, we pride ourselves on sourcing premium abrasives and tools from China, offering unparalleled quality, competitive pricing, and exceptional service to bolster Australian manufacturing. Our offerings include:
Exclusive first-time customer free samples.
Ample in-stock items for immediate distributor support.
Rapid product delivery for time efficiency.
A 30-day return and exchange policy for customer satisfaction.
Direct-to-door delivery, leveraging special freight rates for cost and time savings.
Customization for buyers with unique needs, ensuring precise product specifications.
Dedicated regional market support for distributors, avoiding direct competition.
Flexible payment terms ranging from 1 to 60 days.
Reward programs for achieving sales milestones, including exclusive distribution rights, complimentary trips to China for factory inspections, and promotional support at ATGE expos.
Annual trips for distributors to explore manufacturing innovations in China.
Priority placement at professional tool and grinding expos to enhance distributor visibility and buyer engagement.
Our diverse product range encompasses all facets of abrasives and tools, from cutting and grinding to polishing and sandblasting. Renowned for quality, our sandblasting media like garnet, glass beads, and abrasive tools like cutting discs, Velcro sanding discs, diamond discs, have earned a stellar reputation in the Australian abrasive, cutting and polishing market.
We invite Australian manufacturers and distributors to join us in a mutually beneficial partnership. Whether you’re a buyer intrigued by our offerings or a wholesaler eager to collaborate, reach out to discover how we can support your growth, streamline operations, and enhance profitability.

With over two decades of rich experience and professional service, we’ve established enduring partnerships with thousands of global buyers.
At Australian Abrasives Warehouse, we pride ourselves on sourcing premium abrasives and tools from China, offering unparalleled quality, competitive pricing, and exceptional service to bolster Australian manufacturing. Our offerings include:
Exclusive first-time customer free samples.
Ample in-stock items for immediate distributor support.
Rapid product delivery for time efficiency.
A 30-day return and exchange policy for customer satisfaction.
Direct-to-door delivery, leveraging special freight rates for cost and time savings.
Customization for buyers with unique needs, ensuring precise product specifications.
Dedicated regional market support for distributors, avoiding direct competition.
Flexible payment terms ranging from 1 to 60 days.
Reward programs for achieving sales milestones, including exclusive distribution rights, complimentary trips to China for factory inspections, and promotional support at ATGE expos.
Annual trips for distributors to explore manufacturing innovations in China.
Priority placement at professional tool and grinding expos to enhance distributor visibility and buyer engagement.
Our diverse product range encompasses all facets of abrasives and tools, from cutting and grinding to polishing and sandblasting. Renowned for quality, our sandblasting media like garnet, glass beads, and abrasive tools like cutting discs, Velcro sanding discs, diamond discs, have earned a stellar reputation in the Australian abrasive, cutting and polishing market.
We invite Australian manufacturers and distributors to join us in a mutually beneficial partnership. Whether you’re a buyer intrigued by our offerings or a wholesaler eager to collaborate, reach out to discover how we can support your growth, streamline operations, and enhance profitability.

businesses.name: Acra Machinery Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Registered in 1977, the name ACRA Machinery has always been synonymous with the highest quality machinery and the best customer service available. Founded by Jeff Beable.
Acra Machinery was first registered in 1977 starting out as a service business mainly repairing and maintaining Kleen press brakes and guillotines, then later all Acrabend Press Brakes and Acrashear Guillotines. It wasn’t long before many customers were asking Jeff’s assistance in finding quality second hand machinery and seeking advice on the selection of new machinery.
Acra traveled to Europe and America several times looking at all machines available. Acra finally settled on a previously unheard of Manufacturer in Turkey, Durmazlar. Since then in 1994 Durmazlar has grown to be the largest Press Brake manufacturer in Europe and the second largest in the world, spanning an impressive 155,000 square meter factory.
Acra are suppliers of quality New and Used Machine Tools. Principal machinery includes: -Press Brakes
-Punch and Shears
-Section Rolls
-Turret Punches
-Bandsaws
-Laser Cutters
-Plasma Cutters
-Slitter Folders
-Panbrakes
-Press Brake Tooling
-Roof Panel Machines
-Laser Welders
And Much More
The ACRA Mission Statement is a simple one:
•To supply our customers with the best in machinery
•To lead the industry in service, support and backup
•To be a profitable through following the best possible practises
•To service our customers with the best equipment available to us, and to ensure that all business is performed in an open, honest and honourable manner.

businesses.name: Additive Engineering
businesses.address: Factory 1, 42 McArthurs Rd Altona North Victoria 3025
businesses.description:
Additive Engineering is an Australia-based advanced manufacturer utilising proven additive manufacturing technology to manufacture consistent, high surface quality production parts more efficiently.
 
Additive Engineering provides contract manufacturing services on demand for a range of high performance materials including biocompatible Ti64AlV, Titanium alloys, Stainless Steel and a range of super alloys suitable for Medical, Aviation, Space, Defence, Maritime, and Resources industries.
 
Accelerate development, reduce risk and support sustainment by  relying on proven advanced platforms to enhance fleet readiness. Additive Engineering can improve speed to market by reducing lead time from product development, production to sustainment. Complex component designs are optimised for size, weight, power and cost (SwaP-C) applications, overcoming limitations of traditional manufacturing methods. Design for Additive Manufacturing consolidates parts, improves component performance by reducing weight and waste.
 
·        Contract manufacturing on demand reduces lead times and inventory costs
·        High performance superalloys suitable for aggressive environments; chemical, wear and corrosion resistance and hypersonics
·        One-off manufacture of legacy spare parts
·        Small volume production without minimum order quantities and tooling investment
 
Discriminators include
·        1-3 day turnaround of quality metal 3D printed components for speed to market.
·        Consistent, Industry-leading part quality; as-printed parts in a clean environment, are seamless and require little finishing.
·        Production standards modelled to meet medical and aerospace QMS requirements (ISO9001, ISO13485, AS9100, ISO27001)
·        Assistance with design for additive manufacturing.
·        Viable, end to end production (including full finishing capabilities, heat treatment, polishing, sterilisation, and packaging) to complement manufacturing process without supply disruption risks.
·        Intricate print resolution starting from 0.02mm for metals and 0.06mm with polymer.

businesses.name: Advanced Cutting Technology Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
We are a Melbourne based company offering advanced Laser Cutting Services. Customer focused and with highly skilled staff, we are ready to assist you with your fabrication and manufacturing projects using our advanced 2D laser cutting or 3D laser cutting services. Our service is an advanced manufacturing process – computer controlled to produce components with precision and repeatability at very affordable prices. We can cut a diverse range of materials accurately with minimal thermal effect and low distortion. Production runs of low or high volume are carried out with ‘attention to detail’ and your project files are stored on our database for simplified and convenient reordering. If you need assistance with parts development using 2D or 3D laser cutting, our experienced staff are ready to help. Whether you are in Melbourne or interstate, contact us to discuss your project.
What We Do We will cut what other laser cutting companies cannot. Our specialist 3D laser cutting technology is superior and highly advanced. Our six axis, 3D laser cutting machine is capable of processing many materials. Our state of the art machinery functions in a 3D plane. It is capable of Counter Sinking, Bevel Edge Cutting and Scalloping. Along with the ability to process all your pipe (Round or Square). We can even cut on and around all faces of pre-fabricated three dimensional objects. We can laser cut a diverse range of materials including mild steel, high carbon steel, wood and board, aluminium, acrylics, polypropylene and titanium to name a few. We can also cut stainless steel with nitrogen to give a clean, bright cut with an oxide free edge, ready for welding. Our new 3 Dimensional Laser Cutting Machine can cut formed components and shapes and six-axis rotary cutting of tube, pipe, RHS and bevelling of mild steel and stainless plate.

businesses.name: Advatek Pty Ltd
businesses.address: Factory 3, 15 Burgess Road, North Bayswater VIC 3153
businesses.description:
Advatek is a precision machined component manufacturer based in Bayswater, Victoria, Australia. Our manufacturing facility includes a fully owned 3000 sqm factory and an array of the latest CNC Machine tool technology in our Makino machining centres.
Since starting in the mid 90s, Advatek has expanded their customer base,expressed in a steady increase in sales turnover every year. Advatek claims that their success has been mostly due to their commitment to an uncompromising attention to detail and total customer focus, as reinforced in their company quality policy document.
Through implementation of the latest advancements in CNC technology, Advatek consistently achieves very tightly toleranced machining of material, ranging from aluminium and plastics to stainless steel and titanium.
Other non-CNC processing equipment is on-site for part preparation and finishing operations.
What We Do With a company goal to only utilize the best and latest CNC machining technology, Advatek has earned a clientele which now comprises companies involved in areas such as medical, defence, defence electronics, aerospace, wire & wireless communication, oil exploration, as well as many other local and overseas companies.
Advatek can provide services at very short notice, due to their flexible scheduling system.
Operations are 24 hours per day, 7 days a week on the Makino machine centres. The use of unique and locally designed pallet fixturing reduces processing times and assists in the completion of orders much quicker than would otherwise be the case.
In recent years Advatek have developed an enviable reputation in CNC machining of small, intricate titanium components for medical implant applications. Titanium implant components we have machined have micro-features needing to be cut completely burr free and with extreme accuracy.

businesses.name: AES Environmental
businesses.address: 9A Pembury Road Minto New South Wales 2566
businesses.description:
AES Environmental has manufacturing capabilities in both its main headquarters and in local branches across Australia. The advantage of this local manufacture is fast lead times and flexibility to make non-standard products as required.
Our Warehousing operations in each branch maintain stock of the high-demand filter products such as standard-size panel filters, replacement filter bags and standard HEPA filters. These ‘ex-stock’ inventories in each branch are based around the filtration needs of the local area.
Our High-efficiency filters, filter modules and large filtration units are manufactured in the Head Office factory in Sydney NSW. All design, engineering & manufacturing functions of AES Environmental operate to a standard set of operating procedures and quality-assurance policy that is centrally managed and regularly audited.

OUR MISSION
-To provide the best solutions for the requirements of our customers throughout Australasia.
-To deliver the highest quality equipment, and offer service that is always on time and to the highest level of competence.
-To maintain a level of professionalism, flexibility and team spirit that ensures our customers have an ongoing competitive edge.
-To constantly seek new and better ways of meeting our customer’s needs and exceeding their expectations.

Epilog Laser
CO2 & Fiber Laser Engraving & Cutting Systems
Han-Kwang
High Powered CO2 Laser Cutting Systems with optional levels of automation
Coherent Laser Machine Tools
Compact laser cutting systems for thin metals, thick plastics and timber
ACSYS Lasertechnik
Laser systems for marking, cutting, machining, 3D engraving, welding and cutting
Vision
Computerized Engraving & Routing Machines
QuickJet
High Performance Machining Centers for the Die/Mould Industry
Haas Automation Inc.
CNC Lathes, Vertical & Horizontal Machining Centers, CNC Routers & CNC Rotary Tables

businesses.name: Alumac Industries Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Alumac is a well established full service contract sheetmetal manufacturer. Established in 1973 Alumac has become renowned for its reliability and flexible customer care.
We are committed to reinvesting into the company to keep up to date with modern manufacturing methods and systems.
This includes the Amada F1 4kw 3000×1500 laser cutter combined with our Amada Vipros Queen 357 turret punch( 30 ton capacity), we are able to cut and punch any shape from a large range of materials and thicknesses.
With the introduction of solid modelling complementing our CAD/Cam system we are able to take your concept to design, then to prototyping and onto subsequent production.
What We Do Standard processes are also available including guillotining, NC folding, fastener insertion, MIG & TIG welding, sawing and powder coating.
As all of these processes are available in house we are able to control on time delivery and quality of the completed project.
We service a vast array of industries including automotive, medical, defence, power distribution, IT, display and security to name a few.
In addition to our standard manufacturing services, we also offer a range of specialised tile presentation stands in a variety of shapes and sizes for a variety of uses.

businesses.name: Aluminium Machinery Solutions (AMS)
businesses.description:
Our Rebrand Story We have recently reflected on the last 38 years, where we had enjoyed growing alongside our customers and constantly adapting to the evolving needs of the market and emerging industry trends.
As such, we felt it was time for our brand to evolve too. In July 2023, we announce a significant milestone in the growth and evolution of our company:
Luna Machinery Queensland has changed our name to AMS, Aluminium Machinery Solutions.
Our decision to rebrand was a move aimed at better aligning our brand with core values, mission, and expertise.
AMS, Aluminium Machinery Solutions provides:
Unparalleled Innovation: We remain at the forefont of technological advancements, empowering you with state-of-art solutions that elevate your manufacturing potential. We are excited to embark on this new chapter and invite you to stay connected with us on this exciting journey. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Facebook , where we will share industry insights, product updates, and success stories that inspire us.

businesses.description:
AMADA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company founded in 1946. Including its subsidiaries and affiliates, the Amada Group is composed of approximately 90 companies.
The Group’s main businesses include the manufacture, sale, repair and maintenance of metalworking machinery and devices.
AMADA OCEANIA was established in 1998 as a direct subsidiary of Amada CO., LTD. and has been providing innovative sheet metal manufacturing solutions that set the standard for performance and reliability.
One of our fundamental principles is to grow with our customers . The success of our customers is our key motivation.
The Sydney, Melbourne and Auckland based Technical Centres offer training and verification processing using the latest technology in lasers, turret punches, press brakes, tooling, automation and CAD/CAM software.
Amada Oceania has provided Australian industry with a steady stream of innovative, productivity enhancing sheet metal machines.

businesses.name: ANCA Motion Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
ANCA Motion designs and manufacture flexible control systems, specialising in high precision solutions for CNC machines. We tailor our hardware and software to a OEMs exacting requirements, providing solutions that give customers a competitive edge. Our continuous support and innovation throughout the life of the product allows us to deliver world class products and service.
ANCA Motion control systems have been used in a variety of applications since 1974. Our aim is to become recognized as one of the market leaders in the design and manufacture of customized control systems that are used in world class machines. Our control systems are used on a number of applications ranging from complex 5 axes machine tools to 2 axes profile cutters and single axis stand alone applications.
We have a global presence in more than forty countries around the world with ANCA Motion solutions in every major continent, spanning a wide variety of industries.
What We Do We are able to offer a range of solutions ranging from turnkey automation control packages to single items such as digital servo drives, motion controllers, soft PLCs, CNCs, IO modules, motors, cables and cabinets.
Our unique software modules and patented technology allow our customers to configure these components into efficient and innovative solutions. We understand your need to have the service and support when and where you need it.
By keeping up with the latest technology, we enable our customers to become both technologically and cost competitive on a global scale. This is achieved with a close partnership that begins from the development stage and continues on through the life of the product.

businesses.name: ANCA Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
ANCA is a market leader in quality CNC grinding machines and CNC systems. The company has steadily evolved through policies of innovation and technology and a determination to produce machines that satisfy our customers’ requirements and exceed their expectations.
After 30 years working with industry, we continue to find new ways to deliver products that respond to market needs.
In the early 1980s, ANCA expanded by using its high-level engineering and mathematical skills to develop complete machine tools. The company created sophisticated CNC tool grinding machines by combining leading-edge technology with operating simplicity.
The decision to extend operations launched ANCA into a major growth phase, which involved building an advanced machine tool factory and employing highly-skilled and specialised staff. Further growth matched investment in factory equipment, research and development, and an expanded sales support network
What We Do ANCA is a vertically-integrated, world-leading designer and manufacturer of high precision CNC grinding machines, software and automation accessories that provide system solutions for 800 customers around the globe.
ANCA designs and manufactures complete grinding machines in Melbourne, including building the CNC, precision motors and spindles, and polymer concrete bases in-house. This gives us greater quality control and a holistic understanding of how all the components work together to produce a desirable outcome for our customers.
As well as designing complete machines, the 60+ engineers located at ANCA in Melbourne also write all the machine software programs, plus all the programs for the CNC systems.
ANCA has significantly broadened both the machine variety and capability over the past few years, and now offers nine models to cater for various customer requirements and applications.

businesses.name: Anderson Group Australia Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Anderson Group, founded in Taiwan in 1972, is a global leader in the manufacturing of advanced CNC machining centres.
With a history of innovation dating back to its first CNC router launch in 1985, the company specialises in high-precision solutions. Its diverse portfolio serves woodworking, advanced materials, composites, and metal industries, demonstrating extensive expertise across various materials and applications.

Based in Sydney, its aim is to provide world-class sales support and technical services to its valued customers across Australia.

businesses.name: APCO Engineering Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
APCO Engineering is a modern progressive engineering company specialising in Casting and Machining. We have been servicing the Marine and industrial sectors for over 30 years supplying customers both nationally and internationally.
APCO Engineering uses the latest technology and management practices to provide a high quality efficient service at competitive pricing.
We produce cast and machined products in ferrous and non-ferrous metals including cast iron, alloy steel, stainless steel, aluminium and bronze.
Specialised materials such as high strength, heat, wear and corrosion resistant metals are cast in our in house foundry using the latest foundry practices and technology. Castings can be supplied “as cast” or machined in our machine shop which is equipped with conventional and CNC machines using CAD/CAM technology, including the latest 5 axis Mazak I400 Integrex.
APCO Engineering remains a small and flexible operation, able to respond quickly to your needs, custom manufacturing items to your specifications, providing a total supply solution from conception through to production. We can assist with design, provide 3D solid modelling, pattern making, casting, machining and assembly for prototyping and production runs.

businesses.name: Blickle Australia Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
A family business since 1953 In 1953, Wilhelm Sülzle split his long-established ironmongery factory among his sons and his son-in-law Heinrich Blickle into three standalone companies. The newly founded company Blickle assumed the production of iron wheelbarrow wheels, developing it into a range of high-quality wheels in addition to swivel and fixed castors. Typically Swabian virtues such as hard work, an obsession with quality and the genes of inventors all contribute to continual product improvement. After the sudden death of the company’s founder Heinrich Blickle in 1961, his wife Elisabeth Blickle took over as Managing Director.
Today, Reinhold Blickle, son of the company’s founder, runs the company as executive partner together with his wife Denise Blickle and Walter Wager. Under their management, Blickle has developed into one of the leading manufacturers of wheels and castors worldwide over the past few decades. Progress and keeping with the traditional values of the family company go hand in hand – a corporate philosophy that will be continued into the third generation.

BOC is a member of The Linde Group which supplies compressed and bulk gases, chemicals and equipment around the globe. The company develops safe, sustainable and innovative solutions for customers in many specialty sectors, heavy industry and medical environments.

• A complete package tailored to your requirements

businesses.name: Bolts & Industrial Supplies Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Bolts & Industrial Supplies has been a family owned and operated Australian business for over 40 years. Incorporated in 1973 by John Rodgers (a founding partner), the business is still in the Rodgers family name to this day.
Since then we have served the engineering community of Australia with a strong sense of pride and a level of customer service that simply cannot be beaten. The company has been moulded into what it is today by providing our customers with high quality Australian made products at a respectable price, top notch service and reliable and timely delivery options.
We have over 30 staff specialising in various fields working hand in hand with over 200 suppliers, providing the best technical information possible to enhance performance and productivity in your workshop. Our reputation has been built on being discrete and confidential, and currently we have many workplace non-disclosure agreements in place.
With over 40 years experience, we know you’re in good hands
What We Do Bolts & Industrial Supplies has an extensive range of hardware and industrial supplies with thousands of products stocked at all three of our Australia branches. No matter which section of this industry you’re in we’ve got you covered. Aerospace, automotive, die and mould, general engineering or even the home handyman – we’ve got the tools best suited to your needs. Quality is the name of our game – check out our range of manufacturers, see the list on the left.

Contact a representative using our Live Help option (below on the left), use our Contact Form, or even give us a Phone Call. Some of our products may require additional lead time to source, so if your order is urgent please contact us and we will do our best to accommodate you.

businesses.description:
Bomac was founded in 1984 by the engineers who originally created the Altrac product range. While a newer generation of engineers now manage the day-to-day operation of the business, the company’s founders are still involved at arms-length, acting as mentors and consultants. This helps ensure consistency and product integrity, as well as encouraging continuous innovation.
The company has been trading for over 30 years, and you can be sure that Bomac engineers will be available in future to address any questions or concerns you may have. The standard products meet most needs and are designed for the purchaser to install and extend as needed. All new product research and development is done in-house.
This website highlights some of the standard products offered by Bomac, but is not a comprehensive list. Contact Bomac to discuss a system to meet your specific needs.
Bomac materials handling products are used in many industries including manufacturing, automotive, mining, and food and beverage processing. Altrac cranes and height safety systems can be found across all states and territories in Australia: Victoria – VIC, New South Wales – NSW, Western Australia – WA, South Australia – SA, Queensland – QLD, Tasmania – TAS and in New Zealand – NZ.
Altrac has been exported to many regions around the world including Oceania, Middle East, Asia, Europe and the US. Please contact Bomac directly to enquire about suppliers in these locations.

businesses.name: Calm Aluminium Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Calm Aluminium was established in 2002 to market products and services to the Aerospace, Defence and Toolmaking industries in Australia and New Zealand and also to act as a technical adviser of correct materials and alloys for the related markets. From its inception, Calm Aluminium has achieved competitive prices and lead times for Aluminium and other products for the local industry.
Calm Aluminium now represents several specialist metal supply companies in USA and United Kingdom. These companies include Copper & Brass Sales (a division of the Thyssen-Krupp group of companies), Modern Plastics and British Aluminium Tubes, as well as special Cast Alloy products for the aerospace and defence industries through Uni-Cast in New Hampshire, USA.
What We Do Calm Aluminium offers Aluminium and alloy in sheet, plate, extrusions and custom designed extrusions for all industries. The alloy range is from 1000 to 8000 series, as well as other products such as stainless steel, special steels, titanium, copper, brass and other products on application.
Calm Aluminium can supply M1 Cast Aluminium Mould plate up to 762mm thick which is used for large die moulds and other applications for the Automotive mould industry on extremely short lead times from our supplier in USA. Material can be supplied in exact quantities and size, reducing weight and machining times as opposed to the high weight ratio and machine times of tool steel.
Current and past contracts include: Material requirements for sub contractors in Australia to Lockheed Martin for the Joint Strike Fighter Program, Stainless Steel parts for the ESSM project, Reflector project for the CSIRO, NULKA decoy program and other projects that are currently in negotiation.

businesses.name: Camtech Engineering Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Camtech Engineering specialises in servicing the tooling needs of the rigid plastics packaging industry and is recognised as one of Australia’s leading blow moulding and injection moulding manufacturers. The company has been established in Queensland since 1988 and draws from the expertise of five working directors. Supported by state-of-the-art computerised design and manufacturing facilities, and a two shift operation, Camtech Engineering is able to provide the Australian Packaging Industry efficient, and highly competitive products and services.
What We Do Camtech Engineering has specialised in the design and manufacture of moulds for the PET industry and has a capability of manufacturing PREFORM MOULDS up to 96 cavities combined with a STRETCH BLOW MOULD manufacturing capability of some 100 moulds a month. Camtech Engineering also has the know-how and the equipment to design and manufacture moulds for a variety of CLOSURES, from screw caps, twist off caps through to tamper evident closures. Camtech Engineering is also a highly-skilled specialist in mutli cavity STACK MOULDS and is Australia’s largest designer and manufacturer of this product. A significant proportion of Camtech Engineering’s has been involved in the production of EXTRUSION BLOW MOULDS for a wide range of dairy, food, bathroom and laundry products for major Australian and international clients.

Catten Industries Pty Ltd of Bayswater, Victoria, is a wholly owned Australian company, specialising in the field of precision sheet metal fabrication.
Our modern facility incorporates our design and development division, which can manage your project from concept to completion. Our factory has the right machinery, operated by highly skilled staff, making sure that whatever the product, it is made to the highest standards for our many valuable customers.
Catten Industries have invested in industry leading equipment, which has resulted in increased capabilities, productivity and quality, enabling us to reduce lead-times and exceed customer expectations. Customer focus is our main aim, resulting in Catten Industries aiming for the highest Standards of workmanship.
What We Do Catten Industries manufacture precision, fabricated metal components and assemblies whether it be low volume prototypes or high volume manufacturing runs using the latest in state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment. Our manufacturing expertise extends to:
CNC punching
Specialist punches and presses
NC folding andforming
Welding and pre-finishing
Finishing
Quality control
Assembly and packaging
Distribution

businesses.description:
Since 1990, we have offered the very best design technology to the  architectural, engineering, construction  and  manufacturing  industries. Where no solution exists, we create one.
Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology, and what you can get out of it.
We don’t just provide industry-leading software such as   SOLIDWORKS ,  Archicad  or  Solibri : but the training, technical support and resources to transform the way you work.
We do more than provide the pieces of the puzzle: we help you integrate your  hardware ,    software  and  people  to streamline processes. Replace manual process with  system integration solutions . Remove inefficiencies. Improve collaboration.
There’s another clue in our name as to why you should choose us:  Central .
We put you first. Our award-winning team of technical experts, specialist consultants and highly-qualified instructors are focused on you, and your needs.
While award-winning software might be part of the solution, perhaps the real issue is lightning-fast hardware to save valuable time.
You might want industry-leading  training  or  recruitment services  to bring your people up to speed. Only to discover that it’s the processes that need smoothing out.
Let us work with you to discover, solve and deliver a truly effective solution.
To find out more about what we offer, and what we can do, please explore this site. Then contact us to experience the innovation that is centred on you.

businesses.name: CNC Machinery Sales Australia Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Established in 1989 by Rob Brighton and Tony Sprague, CNC Machinery Sales began life modestly as SBR Machinery in Sydney focusing on conventional new and used machinery. Over the next decade we gradually built our business, product range and client base until 2000 when we acquired the successful South Australian company Machines For Industry (M.F.I.). This provided a springboard to a higher level with a greatly expanded client base, product range and most importantly highly skilled staff with vast experience in CNC Machinery.
For the next few years we operated in several States as SBR and MFI until 2005, when we established our national identity CNC Machinery Sales Australia. This name accurately describes our main focus, though conventional and used machinery continue to be offered. 2006 completed our national coverage with the acquisition of our long term Queensland Agent, Australian Capital Equipment.
What We Do CNC Machinery Sales Australia is dedicated to providing ongoing service and support to our clients in every part of Australia. Experience has shown that the best way to do this is to operate our own team of in-house service engineers and back them with a broad range of spares, exceptional factory support and training. As our engineers are directly employed by CNC Machinery, we have the ability to set priorities and move service resources to the areas where they are most needed. This flexibility enables us to keep our clients down time to an absolute minimum.
We would like to thank our existing clients for their support over many years and welcome new clients into the fold. As always we will strive to provide competitively priced, high quality products with service and support Australia wide.

businesses.name: Colchester Machine Tool Solutions Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Colchester Machine Tool Solutions Pty Ltd is a major machine tool distributor, supplying state-of-the-art machine tools; lathes, milling machines, drills, and metal band saws. Colchester Machine Tool Solutions is a diversified engineering group with a world-class reputation in the manufacture and distribution of machine tools and precision-engineered components. Our machines are tailored for both industrial and training applications and proudly exemplify the excellence of British engineering with our Colchester-Harrison branded lathes. We produce a wide range of centre lathes and machining centres. Our machines have earned a global reputation for their user-friendly design, exceptional quality, and unwavering reliability. We proudly supply the following brands, Colchester-Harrison, Storm, Tornado, Clausing, Rong Fu, and Iberdrill.
We provide comprehensive service across Australia. We put our customers first and our success is a result of that. Customer support and service is our number one priority, and our service technicians are all accredited to International Standard ISO9002. Customers can purchase with confidence knowing they are supported by an organisation that has a longstanding reputation for service and customer excellence.

businesses.name: Composit Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Composit is an Australian extended reality (XR) studio that builds virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR) and mixed reality (MR) experiences for industry. For more than a decade, the team has helped organisations step inside ideas that are normally locked inside drawings, PDFs and slide decks—turning complex systems into experiences people can see, feel and understand.
For manufacturers, Composit applies VR where it has measurable impact: reducing risk, compressing learning curves and accelerating confident decisions. Instead of hoping a procedure “sticks” after a toolbox talk, teams can rehearse high-consequence moments safely, repeatedly and under realistic pressure. Instead of discovering layout, access or ergonomics issues after installation, stakeholders can walk a virtual facility, test workflows, and stress-test changes before a single bracket is fabricated. And instead of travelling samples, building mock-ups or relying on imagination, customers can inspect products at true scale, explore options, and align faster—without buyer’s remorse.
Composit’s work spans immersive training and hazard identification, virtual prototyping and design review, and sales-ready virtual showrooms. Their approach blends deep technical capability with a user-first design philosophy and high-end digital artistry, producing experiences that are engaging, practical and scalable—from pilots through to broader rollouts.

businesses.description:
Our services.
CSI employs over 5,000 people in custody, operates 14 business divisions over 120 commercial business units and 60+ services industries across 29 correctional centres.
We manufacture and provide a diverse range of products and services for sale to external customers as well as essential services for use within correctional centres including Agriculture, Engineering, Furniture and Upholstery, Laundry and Textiles, Modular and Demountable Buildings, Facilities Maintenance and Print and Packaging. We specialise in overflow and import replacement work, supporting Australian businesses to keep manufacturing onshore.
Managed by Trade qualified overseers, CSI business units replicate the real-world working environment that allows people in custody to participate in work programs providing opportunities to learn new skills and gain employment experience.
Our widespread industry facilities and job ready workforce means that we have robust contingency plans in place for the fulfilment of orders. While our warehousing and logistics services can facilitate long and short-term storage solutions, as well as deliveries across NSW and interstate.

businesses.description:
Delahenty Machinery was established in 1964 and specialises in New and Second-Hand Tube Bending, Manipulation and Cutting Machinery for a wide range of industries including Automotive, Furniture, Structural, Mining, Petrochemical, Marine and 4WD just to name a few.
  With over 60 years’ experience in the importation of machine tools Delahenty Machinery Pty Ltd has established close relationships with the world’s leading suppliers.
  What We Do
Our product range includes pipe benders, NC and CNC mandrel tube benders, tube end forming machines, band saws, cold saws, aluminium cutting saws, ring rolling machines, tube polishing machines, vertical machining centres, rebar benders, rebar croppers and stirrup benders.
  In House Tooling Manufacture
The critical stage of any machine production is tooling and for this reason Delahenty Machinery have a fully equipped toolroom, dedicated to the manufacture of tooling and spare parts for machines that we import and sell.
  After Sales Service and Spare Parts
Delahenty Machinery Pty Ltd offer full after sales service and spare parts for all machines purchased both New and Second Hand.

businesses.name: Diverseco
businesses.description:
Originally evolving from the industrial weighing sector, Diverseco has built on its capabilities to become one of Australia’s leading integrated measurement and automation solutions provider to a broad range of industries.
Since establishment in 1992, our company has grown through mergers and acquisitions to become the international company it is today, with offices and operations in every Australian mainland state and internationally in New Zealand and Singapore.
Prior to all of our business units adopting the Diverseco brand on the 1 st  July 2019, Diverseco formerly comprised the following group of companies that traded under the brand names AccuWeigh, AccuOnboard, AccuPak, Robot Technologies-Systems Australia, SCACO and Ultrahawke.
As one of Australasia’s leading measurement and automation solutions providers, we aim to provide our customers superior value by combining an intimate understanding of their needs with our problem-solving expertise and innovative weighing, dimensioning, packaging, inspection and robotics automation technologies. Our team has a long, strong history of converting our customers’ challenges into new capabilities.
For these reasons, we are driven by: the continuous improvement of our people, processes and operations; heavy investment in training and technology; and continuous innovation, which includes revitalisation of its operations by changing the scope of its business and competitive approach.
We are proud of our reputation as a quality ‘employer of choice’ for close to 200 people that thrive within a culture that is founded on principles that inspire optimistic attitudes, constructive ideas and productive behaviours.
With a global customer base and long-standing relationships with prominent international suppliers, Diverseco has won many business and entrepreneurial awards and prides itself on the contribution it makes to society through a range of charitable programs.

businesses.name: Dixon Industries Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Norm Dixon began designing and producing fusion equipment for the local gas reticulation industry to weld small diameter polyethylene pipe (PE) in 1973.
Nearly 5 decades on, Dixon Industries Pty Ltd remains focussed on the design and manufacture of butt fusion equipment at our plant in South Australia. Sold under the  FUSIONMASTER ®  trademark, Dixon manufactured equipment has achieved a reputation for excellence of engineering, ease of use, and the ability to survive in the toughest of Australian conditions. Many of the original machines are still operating in the field.
The  FUSIONMASTER ®  brand has become the first choice of Australian polyethylene pipe installers in mining, natural gas, water, irrigation, aquaculture, telecom and civil installations.
Our clients range from one man operators to multinational corporations and our equipment is used in many countries around the world.
Dixon Industries Pty Ltd is a privately owned company that is still owned and operated by Norm Dixon with the support of a highly skilled team.
We are also a proud member of the Plastics Industry Pipe Association of Australia Limited (PIPA).

  Durolenz specialises in domed products and printed decals. We pioneered doming technology in 1991 and are one of Australia’s few specialists in corporate ID and innovative product branding.

  We do not compromise your brand’s appearance or longevity on cheap alternatives. The fact is, you get what you pay for.

From improving operational efficiency to maximising profitability, we provide the tools and support you need to succeed today and into the future.

businesses.name: Elite Oceania Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Elite Oceania was founded by Richard Sulman, an experienced fitter, engineer, and automation integrator who has been in your shoes.
Through his work at Sulman Automation, Richard experienced first-hand the frustrations common to integrators: slow parts availability, expensive software add-ons, and support that existed only offshore. Rather than accept these limitations, he saw an opportunity to build a business where practical solutions and local service came first.
When Elite Robots began searching for an Australian partner, they recognised this shared philosophy. Together, they saw an opportunity not simply to import and sell robots into Oceania, but to deliver fit-for-purpose affordable automation solutions tailored to Australian industry.

businesses.name: Ensitech Pty Ltd
businesses.address: Unit 1, 144 Old Bathurst Road, Emu Plains NSW 2750
businesses.description:
Ensitech is an Australian-owned manufacturing company based in Sydney. It is the award-winning developer of the TIG Brush® Stainless Steel Weld Cleaning System and the Ensitech Surface Finishing System.
Ensitech produces high-quality products which change the way users do business by providing a safe, efficient alternative to dangerous and contaminating industrial practices. It does this by combining technical analysis and innovation with marketing and financial expertise to bring leading-edge products and concepts to the marketplace in a commercially viable system.
Ensitech’s first product, the TIG Brush®, uses the company’s patented power management technology, together with a conductive brush and chemical solutions of proprietary design, to clean and passivate stainless steel welds without the need for dangerous chemicals such as pickling paste.
Ensitech manufactures and exports TIG Brush products to more than 25 countries and has a worldwide network of distributors. Ensitech Inc. is a subsidiary company located in Chicago, Illinois, to service the North American market.
The company has been a member of the Australian Technology Showcase (ATS) and a winner and finalist in numerous business awards. In 2012 it won the 50th Australian Export Awards (Small Business Category), the NSW Premier’s Export Award (Small Business) and two NSW Business Chamber awards (Excellence in Innovation and Business of the Year).

businesses.name: Fantid Pty Ltd (Hasmot)
businesses.address: 99-105 Boundary Road Peakhurst New South Wales 2210
businesses.description:
H&M Ferman is a family business that has been importing and distributing automotive spare parts since 1975. Hasmot started working with truck and bus rear-vision mirrors as an Original Equipment (O.E.) supplier in 1984. Satisfied clients include Mercedes-Benz, Iveco, Isuzu, Hino, Volvo, Scania and many others.
Hasmot started to modify imported mirrors to comply with local legislation and government standards. Requests by several large customers for more sophisticated designs mobilised the Hasmot team to design and manufacture their own highly advancedaerodynamic, European style mirrors.
Hasmot was commissioned by Isuzu Australia to design and supply a wholly original, fully electric rear vision mirror.components up to several kilograms no project is too big for the team at Hasmot. All final assembly and quality control is handled in their recently upgraded on-site assembly facility, headquartered in Sydney.
Hasmotek recently acquired a Melbourne branch in order to overcome transportation logistics and increase their distribution.
Hasmot’s production facility is agile and highly flexible, allowing efficient large and small scale production runs according to customers’ demands. Constant innovation is at the core of Hasmot’s competitiveness. “We always look at our competitors’ and our own products and processes and ask ourselves how things could be done better”, says Michael Ferman, Managing Director. Regular visits to tradeshows around the world mean the latest technology and thinking is incorporated into Hasmot’s product range.
Hasmot serves the Australian market through its branches in Sydney and Melbourne, both with extensive warehousing facilities. Hasmot’s management team have set their sights on overseas markets to grow the company. A joint venture in Brazil is spearheading overseas expansion, while a new satellite office in Dallas, Texas is responsible for procurement and the development of the American export market.
Our range of various LED lights continues to expand on a daily basis with feedback from our customers on the changing range/products they need to service their own customers. Additionally, our highly experienced: Product designers/photometric engineers, tool designers and tool makers many of whom are caring over 20 years experience in production of OE parts for major passengers/heavy trucks brand names, comb the world in search of innovative techniques/solutions to improve existing products and reduce cost to our worldwide customers.
Using our long standing OEM relationships/expertise, we are often aware of technology changes in modern day motor vehicles before their release, allowing our teams to begin R&D projects to meet the continually evolving aftermarket needs of the motor industry.
All our head/tail lamps are equal or exceed OE requirements. We also tailor make specific lights based on customer’s design/needs.

businesses.name: Green Energy and Carbon Management
businesses.description:
Energy consumers across Australia are trying to reduce their energy consumption and improve their energy productivity. We make it easier to do it. We provide best practice energy management to companies around Australia, so you can assess your energy use (and associated carbon footprint), identify opportunities for improvement, and report your progress.
Why are we here? In the past, it was essential to bring awareness to climate change and all the negative consequences associated with it. While this is still important, now individuals and businesses are more informed about the importance of adopting clean energy and decarbonising the economy.
It’s a great starting point! The problem though: most companies [like yours] are inclined to change processes and adapt to get there, but they need additional resources, time or simply lack the expertise to do it by themselves.
What does that mean? Changing established processes can be daunting. You can’t expect your in-house team to add tasks like carbon accounting and energy use auditing smoothly into their routines. You don’t need to add this very specific knowledge to your wheelhouse, but you shouldn’t miss the opportunities associated with improving your energy management and reporting.

businesses.name: Guhring Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Guhring offers high-performance precision tools such as twist drills, HSS jobber drills, carbide end mills, reamers and machine taps. Guhring is represented around the world with 32 production plants, 47 service centres, 46 sales companies and numerous marketing partners.
Guhring has over 5000 employees around the world to provide outstanding services to its customers. All employees are committed to ensure total customer satisfaction and therefore make Guhring one of the world’s leading suppliers of rotary cutting tools.
With our own carbide production, coating technology, machine and equipment division as well as our development departments for key industry sectors, our company has direct control over important parameters such as tool material, geometry as well as coating.
What We Do Guhring Australia imports and distributes our standard range of precision cutting tools, made in Germany. Guhring Trade division frequently updates and presents catalogues of products that are stocked in Australia for overnight delivery to our customers. It represents a concise selection of key products from Guhring’s standard range.
With our in-house CNC Grinding machines and state of the art PVD Coating facility, the service division is responsible for the manufacture and service of special tools and coatings.
The Tool Management Division helps our customers to concentrate on their core business. Guhring’s Tool Management division provides services which include process planning, stock control, logistics, application support, tool maintenance and process optimization. Tool Management can go as far as taking over the complete tool administration.

businesses.description:
Haco (Australia) Pty Ltd is a subsidiary of The Haco Group, a worldwide leader in machine tool building. The Haco Group operates manufacturing plants throughout the world and have sales and service subsidiaries established in all major countries. In addition to our Perth office, we recently opened our new showroom in Melbourne.
The history of Haco started in 1965 as a small family owned business in the northern part of Belgium, serving local industrial companies. From the very beginning our principal goal was to understand the needs and requirements of our customers and to provide for them better than anyone else does.
This approach has remained unchanged throughout our history. We aim to create long-term partnerships with each of our customers all over the world. businesses.name: Hardman Bros Pty Ltd
businesses.address: 385-393 Lower Dandenong Road, Dingley Village VIC 3172
businesses.description:
Founded in Oakleigh, Victoria by brothers David and Ronald Hardman in 1953, Hardman Bros is a family owned Australian gear manufacturing and general engineering company. The business has grown to be a significant manufacturer in the engineering industry, employing over 30 people, with over 5,000 sq metres of floor space and some of the largest and most technologically advanced equipment available.
Through the hard work of their skilled and experienced staff, Hardman Bros has established a reputation not only as a quality supplier of gears and gear boxes, but as a flexible, innovative and skilled manufacturer of general engineering components of varying complexities and size.
What We Do Gear cutting specialist and general engineers. At Hardman Bros, we manufacture all types of gears, from a vintage car to 150 tonne jack screws required for a steel mill.
We can do one-off parts or full production runs in our fully equipped workshop, which includes turning & milling machines, wirecutting, broaching, slotting, CNC lathes & CNC mills.
Hardman Bros. have a range of stock spurs, mitre bevels, ratio bevels, spline bushes & spline shafting on the shelf.
We also make the HADBRO transmission range of agricultural gearboxes, right angle drive for most applications.
We are committed to ensuring we always do what we say we will do. Our customers have the peace-of-mind knowing we invariably meet our targets.
As a Quality Endorsed Company to international standard AS/NZS ISO 9001:2008, we have the systems and ingrained culture to guarantee a quality end product, delivered at a fair and competitive price.

Founded in 1919, G.A. & L. Harrington Pty. Ltd. is a privately owned family company. From its inception the company has specialised in manufacturing pressed metal products and assemblies.
Our plant comprises an extensive range of presses from 10 to 1000 tonnes capacity, together with resistance welders, MIG robot welders, pulley forming machines and electrostatic wet paint and powder coating lines. Coil handling and feed lines are capable of processing up to 12mm thick material.
The company operates a modern, well equipped toolmaking facility for tool design, manufacture and maintenance of new and existing tools. All tools are designed, fabricated and serviced by our team of specialist tool-makers, with up-to-date CNC equipment utilised to produce precise and efficient press tools.
The combination of proven expertise and technology has enabled the company to win contracts for complex metal pressings and fabrication projects in the very competitive ‘global marketplace’.
