businesses.name: Ultimate Laser Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Ultimate Laser operates out of 3 modern factories in the Southern Suburb of Dandenong in Victoria. We are equipped with the latest state of the art Laser and Waterjet cutting machinery from Switzerland and Sweden.
Commencing operations in March 2004 with just one laser machine and with growing demand and foresight to customer’s requirements, we now run 6 Laser machines and 1 Waterjet (Beveljet 5 axis) machine operating a huge 6.5 meters x 3.1 meters bed size.
Our Management Team has over 30 years combined experience in the Laser and Waterjet cutting industry and has a complete understanding of these cutting processes. In today’s economic environment we at Ultimate Laser are very conscious that the customer expects efficient service, excellent quality, short lead times and competitive low pricing.
With our commitment to quality we have become a Quality Endorsed Company certified to AS/NZS ISO 2008 standards.
What We Do Ultimate Laser realises the importance of top quality machinery and is deeply committed to investing in the latest equipment and technology, which in turn allows us to provide better and faster methods of manufacturing product resulting in various advantages for our customers.
By developing a reputation for quality product, providing prompt and impeccable service, extremely attractive pricing, standard lead times between 3 – 5 working days all strives to provide you, the prospective client, with the best possible outcome.
At your invitation, we would be pleased to visit your manufacturing facilities to meet with you and provide various samples of our cutting abilities, and to discuss any specific requirements you may have regarding the outsourcing of your laser or waterjet cutting requirements. Alternatively we welcome your requests for quotations by fax or email to our Dandenong office.

businesses.name: Value Heat Treatment
businesses.description:
Why VHT? Backed by a team of experienced professionals in operations, metallurgy and engineering, VHT can provide you turnkey solutions for production, product innovation and growth. We provide our customers:

Metallurgical backup
VHT offer metallurgical inputs from process design through to failure analysis. With inhouse metallurgical and materials engineers and excellent metallurgical testing facilities, VHT can provide consulting inputs for material selection, process development through to failure analysis. We have inhouse Rockwell, Vickers hardness testers, cutting & mounting equipment, micro hardness traverse testing, binocular stereo microscope as well as metallurgical microscopes. An extensive library offering information on a wide range of topics including steels, heat treatment, manufacturing, failure analysis is available inhouse to provide design & development inputs for innovation, efficiency and quality improvement.
Operational Excellence
With years of experience processing components across this a wide range of industry, we have developed optimum heat treat processes and process control systems to heat treat components that will meet the most stringent quality requirements for any application. Commitment to well-maintained infrastructure enables maintenance of equipment in good condition and prevent breakdowns thus leading to equipment reliability, consistently good quality and excellent service. Our well trained and committed team with expertise across metallurgy, heat treatment process and furnace engineering have the capability to set up the best tooling, loading and process cycles to provide you with consistent high quality heat treatment outcomes

businesses.name: Wayahead Systems
businesses.description:
For over 30 years, Wayahead Systems has been a leading software provider for manufacturing companies looking to safeguard and streamline their operations. Our software is used by many manufacturers (pharmaceutical, nutritional, infant formula, animal health etc.) across many international sites.
The main business of Wayahead Systems is the installation and development of  Wayahead MES , our user-friendly manufacturing software product.  Wayahead MES  has many modules or features that simplify and streamline all production activities, from initial raw materials right through to finished product packaging.
Wayahead MES  has many customizable features including barcode labelling of received materials, lot number management, dispensing of raw materials and issuing of packaging materials.
The automatic controls and calculations eliminate user and material errors, reduce data entry and paperwork and accelerate the weighing cycle for faster batch release to market times.
Wayahead MES  seamlessly connects with ERP, PLC, WMS, LIMS systems and is linked to tablet management systems, such as Korsch Compression machines, Servolift blenders, Thomas Coating machine, NIR analysers, Erweka testing devices, etc.
After system validation, all production activities are recorded in  Wayahead MES  to regulatory levels, such as FDA, GMP, TGA, Medsafe, CFDA. A full track & trace audit trail can then be accessed, from original starting materials, through to the finished product. All activities are extensively validated at each customer site.

businesses.name: Western Sydney University, Launch Pad
businesses.description:
Western Sydney University has once again been named number one in the world for its social, economic and environmental impact in the 2023 Times Higher Education (THE) University Impact Rankings.
For the second year in a row, the University has placed first overall in the prestigious annual rankings – a first for an Australian university.
The Times Higher Education University Impact Rankings is the main global ranking system that assesses universities on their commitment to the United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Rankings are based on universities’ teaching, research, outreach and stewardship.
Western Sydney University topped the list for 2023 out of over 1,700 institutions from 115 countries – a 21 per cent increase in participating institutions from last year.
The University’s work has been recognised in the following SDG categories:
1st in the world for SDG 5 Gender Equality, SDG 12 Responsible Consumption and Production, and SDG 17 Partnership for the Goals 2nd in the world for SDG 6 Clean Water and Sanitation and SDG 15 Life on Land 3rd in the world for SDG 10 Reduced Inequalities 4th in the world for SDG 3 Good Health and Wellbeing 5th in the world for SDG 11 Sustainable Cities and Communities 7th in the world for SDG 13 Climate Action.

businesses.name: WorkGuru Pty Ltd
businesses.description:
Time slips away, stock gets misplaced, and tracking everything with the wrong tools just creates more headaches.
For years, we watched small business owners struggle with expensive, overly complex software that didn’t fit their needs. Spending thousands on a system that only added confusion didn’t feel right to us.
That’s why we created WorkGuru—an all-in-one solution designed specifically for fabricators, engineers, and manufacturers. We built it to help businesses track job costs, manage inventory, and streamline operations, all without breaking the bank. Our goal is simple: to give you the right tools to run your business more efficiently, so you can focus on growth and success.

businesses.name: Zeiss Australia
businesses.address: 25 Khartoum Road, Level 1 North Ryde New South Wales 2113
businesses.description:
Carl Zeiss is a leading international group of companies operating worldwide in the optical and opto-electronic industries. Headquartered in Oberkochen, Germany, the Carl Zeiss Group is directly represented in more than 30 countries and operates production facilities in Europe, America and Asia.
The Carl Zeiss Group is structured as six business groups in three strategic markets. These are Biosciences and Medical Technology, System Solutions for Industry and Optical Consumer Goods. We offer products and services for biomedical research and medical technology, system solutions for the semiconductor, automotive and mechanical engineering industries, as well as high quality consumer goods such as eyeglass lenses, camera lenses and binoculars.
What We Do Understanding everything that metrology technology offers requires experience. Your measuring task is what determines which tool will be used from the variety of available measuring machines, sensors, and software. And we can help you reach your goals with a measuring strategy for your products.
With our experience, we offer objective answers to optimize your processes from the CAD model to result management—comprehensive metrology support. We measure and program for you, take care of initial sampling and reverse engineering, take over defect recognition, assembly checks and offer the determination of measuring uncertainty. Be sure to find out about our CT scanning services.
